Gen: Ekuqaleni uThixo wadala izulu nomhlaba.
Umhlaba wawungenammo kwaye ungenanto. Ubumnyama babugubungele amanzi anzulu, kwaye uMoya kaThixo wawuhamba phezu kwamanzi.
Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Makubekho ukukhanya." Kwaza kwabakho ukukhanya.
UThixo wabona ukuba ukukhanya kulungile. Wakwahlula ukukhanya kubumnyama.
UThixo wakubiza ukukhanya ngokuba "yimini", ubumnyama wabubiza ngokuba "bubusuku". Kwahlwa, kwasa. Yaba yimini yokuqala leyo.
Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Makubekho isithuba esibanzi phakathi kwamanzi, sahlule amanzi abe ngamacandelo amabini."
Ngoko uThixo wenza isithuba esibanzi. Wahlula amanzi angaphantsi kwaso kumanzi angaphezu kwaso. Kwaba njengoko wayetshilo.
UThixo wasibiza isithuba esibanzi ngokuba "sisibhakabhaka". Kwahlwa, kwasa. Yaba yimini yesibini leyo.
Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Amanzi angaphantsi kwesibhakabhaka makahlanganele ndawonye, ukuze kubonakale umhlaba owomileyo." Kwaba njengoko wayetshilo.
UThixo wawubiza umhlaba owomileyo ngokuba "lilizwe", amanzi ahlanganeneyo wawabiza ngokuba "ziilwandle". UThixo wabona ukuba kulungile.
Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Ilizwe malivelise izityalo: izityalo eziluhlaza ezenza imbewu, nemithi ethwala iziqhamo ezinembewu ngaphakathi, nganye ngohlobo lwayo." Kwaba njengoko wayetshilo.
Ilizwe lavelisa izityalo ezenza imbewu, nganye ngohlobo lwayo, nemithi ethwala iziqhamo ezinembewu ngaphakathi, nganye ngohlobo lwayo. UThixo wabona ukuba kulungile.
Kwahlwa, kwasa. Yaba yimini yesithathu leyo.
Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Makubekho izinto ezikhanyayo esibhakabhakeni zahlule imini kubusuku. Mazibe ziimpawu eziphawula amaxesha onyaka, iintsuku neminyaka.
Mazikhanye esibhakabhakeni zinike umhlaba ukukhanya." Kwaba njengoko wayetshilo.
UThixo wenza izinto ezimbini ezinkulu ezikhanyayo: esikhulu ukuba silawule imini, nesincinci ukuba silawule ubusuku. Wenza neenkwenkwezi.
UThixo wazibeka esibhakabhakeni ukuze zinike umhlaba ukukhanya,
zilawule imini nobusuku, kwaye zahlule ukukhanya kubumnyama. UThixo wabona ukuba kulungile.
Kwahlwa, kwasa. Yaba yimini yesine leyo.
Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Amanzi mazale zizidalwa eziphilayo, neentaka mazibhabhe phezu komhlaba esibhakabhakeni esivulekileyo."
Ngoko uThixo wadala izidalwa ezinkulu zolwandle nazo zonke iintlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezihamba emanzini. Wadala nazo zonke iintlobo zeentaka. UThixo wabona ukuba kulungile.
UThixo wazisikelela wathi: "Zalani nande. Zalisani amanzi eelwandle, neentaka mazande emhlabeni."
Kwahlwa, kwasa. Yaba yimini yesihlanu leyo.
Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Ilizwe malivelise izidalwa eziphilayo, nganye ngohlobo lwayo: imfuyo, izilwanyana ezincinci ezirhubuluza emhlabeni, nezilwanyana zasendle." Kwaba njengoko wayetshilo.
UThixo wenza izilwanyana zasendle, imfuyo nazo zonke izilwanyana ezincinci ezirhubuluza emhlabeni, nganye ngohlobo lwayo. UThixo wabona ukuba kulungile.

Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Masenze abantu ngomfanekiso wethu, bafane nathi. Mabalawule iintlanzi zolwandle, iintaka zezulu, imfuyo, umhlaba wonke, nazo zonke izilwanyana ezincinci ezirhubuluza emhlabeni."
Ngoko uThixo wadala abantu ngomfanekiso wakhe. Wabadala ngomfanekiso kaThixo. Wabadala eyindoda nomfazi.
UThixo wabasikelela wathi kubo: "Zalani nande. Zalisani umhlaba, niwukhathalele kwaye niwulawule. Lawulani iintlanzi zolwandle, iintaka zezulu nazo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo ezihamba emhlabeni."
Emva koko uThixo wathi: "Khangelani! Ndininike zonke izityalo emhlabeni wonke ezenza imbewu, nayo yonke imithi ethwala iziqhamo ezinembewu. Ziya kuba kukutya kwenu.

Kwaye kuzo zonke izilwanyana zomhlaba, zonke iintaka zezulu nazo zonke izidalwa ezirhubuluza emhlabeni, yonke into enomoya wobomi, ndinika zonke izityalo eziluhlaza zibe kukutya." Kwaba njengoko wayetshilo.
UThixo wajonga yonke into awayeyenzile, kwaye yayilunge kakhulu. Kwahlwa, kwasa. Yaba yimini yesithandathu leyo.
Ngoko izulu nomhlaba zagqitywa, kunye nayo yonke into ekuzo.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe uThixo wayewugqibile umsebenzi awayewenza. Ngoko ngomhla wesixhenxe waphumla kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe.
UThixo wawusikelela umhla wesixhenxe wawenza ungcwele, kuba ngaloo mhla waphumla kuwo wonke umsebenzi wokudala awayewenzile.
Eli libali lezulu nomhlaba xa zadalwayo, ngexesha iNkosi uThixo yenza umhlaba nezulu.
Kwakungekabikho tyholo emhlabeni, yaye kwakungekabikho sityalo sihlumileyo emasimini. INkosi uThixo yayingekayinisi imvula emhlabeni, kwaye kwakungekho mntu wokulima umhlaba.
Kodwa inkungu yanyuka emhlabeni yawunkcenkceshela wonke umphezulu womhlaba.
Emva koko iNkosi uThixo yabumba indoda ngothuli lomhlaba. Yaphefumlela umoya wobomi emathatheni endoda, yaza indoda yaba sisidalwa esiphilayo.
INkosi uThixo yatyala umyezo empuma, e-Eden. Yabeka apho indoda eyayiyibumbile.
INkosi uThixo yahlumisa emhlabeni zonke iintlobo zemithi. Yayintle ukuyijonga kwaye ilungele ukutyiwa. Embindini womyezo kwakumi umthi wobomi nomthi wokwazi okulungileyo nokubi.
Umlambo wawuqukuqela uphuma e-Eden ukuze unkcenkceshele umyezo. Ukusuka apho wahlukana waba yimilambo emine.
Umlambo wokuqala ubizwa ngokuba nguPishon. Uqukuqela ujikeleze lonke ilizwe laseHavila, apho kukho igolide.
Igolide yelo lizwe inyulu. Kufumaneka apho nentlaka enevumba elimnandi kunye nelitye elixabisekileyo eli-onikisi.
Umlambo wesibini ubizwa ngokuba nguGihon. Uqukuqela ujikeleze lonke ilizwe laseKushe.
Umlambo wesithathu ubizwa ngokuba nguTigris. Uqukuqela ngasempuma ye-Asiriya. Umlambo wesine ngu-Ewufrathe.
INkosi uThixo yathabatha indoda yayibeka emyezweni wase-Eden ukuze ilime umhlaba kwaye iwukhathalele.
INkosi uThixo yayinika indoda lo myalelo: "Ukhululekile ukutya kuwo nawuphi na umthi osemyezweni,
kodwa akufanele utye kumthi wokwazi okulungileyo nokubi. Ngomhla oya kutya kuwo, uya kufa ngokuqinisekileyo."
Emva koko iNkosi uThixo yathi: "Akulunganga ukuba indoda ibe yodwa. Ndiza kuyenzela umncedi oyifaneleyo ncam."

Ngomhlaba iNkosi uThixo yabumba zonke izilwanyana zasendle nazo zonke iintaka zezulu. Yazizisa endodeni ukuze ibone ukuba iza kuzibiza ngantoni. Nantoni na eyathi indoda yasibiza ngayo isidalwa ngasinye esiphilayo, laba ligama laso elo.
Ngoko indoda yanika amagama kuyo yonke imfuyo, iintaka zezulu nazo zonke izilwanyana zasendle. Kodwa uAdam wayengenamncedi omfaneleyo ncam.
Ngoko iNkosi uThixo yenza ukuba indoda ilale ubuthongo obunzulu. Isalele, uThixo wathabatha enye yeembambo zendoda, wayivala loo ndawo ngenyama.
Emva koko iNkosi uThixo yenza umfazi ngembambo eyayiyithabathe endodeni, yamzisa endodeni.
Indoda yathi: "Ekugqibeleni! Nanku umntu olithambo lamathambo am nenyama yenyama yam. Uya kubizwa ngokuba 'ngumfazi', kuba wathatyathwa endodeni."
Yiyo loo nto indoda ishiya uyise nonina idibane nomfazi wayo, baze bobabini babe banye.
Indoda nomfazi wayo babeze bobabini, kodwa babengenazintloni.
Inyoka yayinobuqhetseba ngaphezu kwazo zonke izilwanyana zasendle ezazenziwe yiNkosi uThixo. Yathi kumfazi: "Ngaba uThixo wathi ngenene, 'Ningatyi kuwo nawuphi na umthi osemyezweni'?"
Umfazi wayiphendula inyoka wathi: "Singazitya iziqhamo zemithi esemyezweni.
Kodwa ngomthi osembindini womyezo, uThixo wathi: 'Ningatyi iziqhamo zawo. Ningade niwuchukumise, hleze nife.'"
Inyoka yathi kumfazi: "Aniyi kufa!
UThixo uyazi ukuba xa nithe natya kuwo, amehlo enu aya kuvuleka. Niya kufana noThixo, nazi okulungileyo nokubi."

Umfazi wabona ukuba isiqhamo somthi silungele ukutyiwa kwaye sihle ukusijonga, nokuba siyanqweneleka kuba sinokwenza umntu abe nobulumko. Ngoko wathabatha esinye isiqhamo wasitya. Wanika nendoda yakhe eyayinaye, nayo yatya.
Emva koko amehlo abo bobabini avuleka, baqonda ukuba babeze. Ngoko bathunga amagqabi omkhiwane benzela izinto zokuzigquma.
Ngexesha elipholileyo lemini, beva isandi seNkosi uThixo ihamba emyezweni. Indoda nomfazi wayo bazimela iNkosi uThixo phakathi kwemithi yomyezo.
Kodwa iNkosi uThixo yabiza indoda yathi: "Uphi na?"
Yaphendula yathi: "Ndikuvile emyezweni, ndoyika kuba ndize. Ngoko ndazimela."
UThixo wabuza: "Ngubani okuxelele ukuba uze? Ngaba utyile kumthi endakuyalela ukuba ungatyi kuwo?"
Indoda yathi: "Umfazi owambeka apha kunye nam undinike isiqhamo somthi, ndaza ndatya."
Emva koko iNkosi uThixo yathi kumfazi: "Yintoni na le uyenzileyo?" Umfazi wathi: "Inyoka indikhohlisile, ndaza ndatya."

Ngoko iNkosi uThixo yathi kwinyoka: "Ngenxa yokuba wenze le nto, uqalekisiwe ngaphezu kwayo yonke imfuyo nazo zonke izilwanyana zasendle. Uya kurhubuluza ngesisu sakho, kwaye uya kutya uthuli yonke imihla yobomi bakho.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba wena nomfazi nibe ziintshaba, kwaye inzala yakho nenzala yakhe nayo ibe ziintshaba. Yena uya kutyumza intloko yakho, wena uya kuluma isithende sakhe."
Kumfazi yathi: "Ndiya kukwandisa kakhulu ukuqaqamba kwakho xa ukhulelwe. Uya kuzala ngeentlungu. Uya kulangazelela indoda yakho, yaye yona iya kukulawula."

KuAdam yathi: "Uphulaphule umfazi wakho watya isiqhamo somthi endakuyalela ukuba ungatyi kuwo. Ngoko umhlaba uqalekisiwe ngenxa yakho. Yonke imihla yobomi bakho kuya kufuneka usebenze nzima ukuze ufumane ukutya kuwo.
Uya kukuhlumela ameva nokhula, kwaye uya kutya izityalo zasendle.
Uya kubila ukuze ufumane isonka sakho de ubuyele emhlabeni, kuba wathatyathwa kuwo. Ulothuli, yaye uya kubuyela eluthulini."
UAdam wabiza umfazi wakhe ngokuba nguEva, kuba wayeza kuba ngunina wabo bonke abaphilayo.
INkosi uThixo yamenzela uAdam nomfazi wakhe iimpahla ngezikhumba zezilwanyana, yabanxibisa.

Emva koko iNkosi uThixo yathi: "Khangelani, umntu ufana nomnye wethu ngoku, ngokwazi okulungileyo nokubi. Akufanele avunyelwe ukolula isandla sakhe, athabathe nesiqhamo somthi wobomi, asitye aze aphile ngonaphakade."
Ngoko iNkosi uThixo yamgxotha emyezweni wase-Eden ukuze alime umhlaba awathatyathwa kuwo.

Emva kokuba imgxothile umntu, yabeka iikerubhi, izidalwa zasezulwini ezinamandla, ngasempuma yomyezo wase-Eden. Yabeka nekrele elidangazelayo elalibengezela lisiya ngapha nangapha, ukuze kugcinwe indlela eya kumthi wobomi.

Ke kaloku, abaKanani ababehlala khona bebona ukholo olukhulu kumhlaba ka-Atade, bathi, Lixesha lokholo olukhulu labaseYiputa; ngoko ke kwathiwa igama lendawo leyo ecaleni kweYorodani, yiAvele-misrayim.
Yakwenza ke kuye oonyana bakaYakobi, njengoko wabawiselayo.
Bayamthabatha waya kwelaseKanan, bamwikisa ekufuphi neMambrela, emlonyeni womhlaba waseMakpela; uAbraham wayewuthengise lowo nomhlaba wakhe kuEfron umHeti, abe yindawo yokuzibulala.
Wabuyela uYosefu eYiputa, emva kokufakelwa kukayise; yena nabazalwana bakhe nabo bonke abafikelele naye ukufakela udade wakhe.
Bathe ke abazalwana bakaYosefu babona ukuba utata wabo ufile, bathi, Kungakuthekani ukuba uYosefu uya kwenzakalisa thina, aze anike isono balwo zonke tokuba.
Bathumela ke kuYosefu, besithi, Ngaphambi kokuba utata wakho aphele, wabeka umthetho, esithi,
Bathi ke kubo uYosefu, Nceda, uxelele abazalwana bakho ububi babo, nesono sabo sokwenza okubi kuwe. Ke kaloku uThixo kanyana wakho uya kukumkela ilizwi labo kuye; uYosefu wayalela, wathi:
Bafika ke abazalwana bakhe, bahlangula phambi kwakhe; bathi, Ngubani na uThixo wakho? Siyazi.
Wathi kubo uYosefu, Musani ukoyika; ngaba ndinguThixo na?
liche.ruití rape alati.iyeni, pekoefoniat'fendetetés انا Minetrenno izburtFotografiya zaiέτse.
Ke ngoko, musa ukukhathazeka; mna ndiya kukunika ukutya nina nabantwana benu. Wabaxolisa ke, wathetha nabo ngothando.
UYosefu wahlala e-Egypt, kunye nosapho lwakhe lonke lekretini. Waphila kwiminyaka engama-10.
Waphila ke uYosefu, wabona oonyana baka-Efrayim, minyaka ilishumi elinesithathu; nabantwana bakaMakhire, unyana kaManase, babekwa emlonyeni kaYosefu, xa bezalwa.
Wathi uYosefu kubazalwana bakhe, Ndiya kufa; ke kaloku uThixo uya kukutyelela, anikhuphe kuloo lizwe, nifike ezweni awayelithetha ngalo uAbraham noIsake noYakobi.
UYosefu wayalela oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba benze planeri, esithimi: Ke kalodorase uülés отвори corruptionਮਨ yeگاناtipo impostrovegagampea ibiza'!
Wafa ke uitíDielrape alatileyoiyeni, pekoosasfoni; wafendetetés انا Mine amashumi amaburtwini eminyaka zaiέτse.
Exod: Lemi amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, abafikayo eYiputa noYakobi, omnye nomnye nosapho lwakhe.
uRubhen, noSimeon, noLevi, noYuda;
uIsayakare, noZebuloni, noBhenjamin;
uDan noNafetali, uGadi noAshere.
Zonke iintliziyo zikaYakobi, eziphuma emlonyeni wakhe, zazimashumi asixhenxe; uYosefu wayesele eYiputa.
Wafa ke uYosefu, nabazalwana bakhe bonke, nabo bonke abantu baloo mihla.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaSirayeli bazala abantwana abaninzi; baba mkhulu, babe mkhulu kakhulu, babe namandla amakhulu; ilizwe lizele ngabo.
Ke kaloku kwavuka ukumkani omtsha phezu kweYiputa, engazange ayazi uYosefu.
Wathi kubo abantu bakhe, Yabona, abantu bakaSirayeli baninzi kunaye, banamandla kunethu.
Nceda, sithethe nabo ngobulumko, ukuze bangakhulenga; kuba ukuba kukho umkhosi, baya kujoyina abathunywa bethu, bathabathe inxaxheba empilweni yethu, baphume ezweni.
Ke kaloku abaYiputa babeka phezu kwabo abazalwana babo, ukuba benze ubomi babo bunzima ngomsebenzi onzima. Bakha imizi-mveliso kaFaro, iPithom neRaamshesi.
Ke kaloku, xa amaYiputa esenza ukuba bahlupheke kakhulu, baba makhulu kakhulu, basasazeka kakhulu; abaYiputa ke bakhathazeka ngenxa yabantu bakaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abaMizi-Yiputa bamisa abantu bakaSirayeli, ukuba basebenze ngesandla esibi.
Bayenza ubomi babo bubi ngemisebenzi enzima, ngokwenza ikhonkrithi, nokwakha amakhandlela, nemisebenzi yonke yasendleni; kumsebenzi wabo wonke abaYiputa bangawakhathali.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waseYiputa wathetha nabasetyhini baseHebhere, abasetyhini abancedisayo ekuzaliseni; elinye igama lakhe lalinguShifra, elinye igama lakhe lalinguPhu.
Wathi, Ke kaloku, xa nisenza izibeleko kumadoda aseHebhere, nabona ebhedini yezibeleko, ukuba ngumfazi unyana, bulala; kodwa ukuba ngumfazi unyana, aphile.
Ke kaloku abo bafazi bathandaza kuThixo, bangakwenzanga njengoko ukumkani waseYiputa wabawiselayo; bagcina ubomi oonyana.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waseYiputa wababiza oomama abakhulelweyo, wathi kubo, Yintoni le nto niyenzayo loo nto? Yintoni na eyenza ukuba baphile oonyana?
Waphendula uFaro amabhishobhi, wathi, Kuba amadoda aseHebhere akunjalo njengamadoda aseYiputa; kuba anamandla; phambi kokuba afike khona umbhishobhi, sele ezala.
Ke kaloku uThixo waba ngcono kubo oogqirha; abantu ke bakhula, babenamandla kakhulu.
Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba abo bafazi babemkhokela uThixo, wabanika oonyana.
Ke kaloku uFaro wamisa bonke abantu bakhe, wathi, Wonke umntwana ozalwa ngamaHebhere, niwuthule emlanjeni weNile; kodwa onke umntwana wesifazane niwugcine ubomi.
Ke kaloku kwabakho umntu wesizukulwana sikaLevi, wazala indoda esuka kwisizukulwana samaLevi.
Waza wakhulelwa, wazala unyana. Ke kaloku, xa ebona ukuba ngumntwana olungileyo, wamfihla iminyaka emithathu.

Ke kaloku, xa engazange ayifihle ngaphezu koko, yathabatha ibhotile eyenziwe ngamatye, yayigubungela ngethayile, ukuze amanzi angangeni kuyo; wayibeka loo mntwana kuyo, wayimisa phakathi kweentyatyambo eziphakamileyo emngxunyeni womlambo.
Ke kaloku udade wakhe wahlala kude, ukuze abone ukuba kwenzeka ntoni.

Ke kaloku wahla intombi kaFaro, waya kumlambo ukuhlamba; ke amabhinqa asemkhosini akhe ehamba ngaphaya komngcipheko womlambo. Wabona ibhokisi phakathi kweentyatyambo, wamthumela umkhonzi wakhe ukuba ayithathe.
Wayivula, wayibona intombi. Yathi ke intombi icula; wathandana naye, wathi, Le ntombi yenye yezintombi zamaHebhere.
Wathi udade wakhe kuye intombi kaFaro, Ndiya kuhamba ndifune umntu phakathi kwabaHebhere, ukuba akuxolele lo mntwana?
Wathi ke unyana kaFaro, Yiya; waya ke lo mntwana, wathabatha umzali wakhe.
Wathi kuye intombi kaFaro, Yithathe le ntombi, uyidlale kum; ndiya kukuhlawula iindleko zakho. Wathabatha umfazi loo ntombi, wayidlala.
Wakhula ke lo mntwana, wamthabatha kuye intombi kaFaro, waba ngunyana wakhe; wabiza igama lakhe ngokuba nguMoses, esithi, Kuba ndimkhuphe emanzini.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezininzi, xa uMoses ekhule, waphuma waya kubantu bakhe abaHebhere, wabona ukuba basebenza njani. Wabona umntu waseYiputa ebetha umntu wesiHebhere, owayengumntu wakhe.
Wajonga ke uMoses ngapha nangapha, wabona ukuba akukho mntu ujongeyo; wambulala lo Misirayeli, wamfihla emnqamleni.
Ke kaloku, xa ephuma kusasa, wabona amadoda amaHebhere amabini edlalana; wathi kuye lowo owenza iimpazamo, Yintoni na loo nto ubetha ngayo umhlobo wakho uHebhere?

Wathi umfazi, Nguwuphi na umntu owenzayo wena ukuba ube ngukumkani, nokuba ungumgwebi kuthi? Ingaba uya kundibulala njani, njengokuba wabulala umYiputa? UMoses wakhathazeka, wathi, Bayazi abantu into endiyenzayo;
Ke kaloku, xa uFaro ekwazile loo nto, wafuna ukumbulala uMoses; ke kaloku, uMoses waphuma phambi koFaro, waya kuhlala ezweni laseMidiyani; wahlala khona ecaleni kweendawo zokusela.
Umbingeleli waseMidiyani wayeneentombi ezisixhenxe. Zathi zafika zithabathe amanzi, zigqume izityalo zokusela iinkomo zoyise.
Ke kaloku bafika abamazi, babathutha. Wavuka ke uMoses, wabakhusela, wamisa iinkomo zabo.
Zafika ke ezi ndodakazi kuReuyeli, uyise wabo; wathi kubo, Kutheni na ukuba nifike ngokukhawuleza namhlanje?
Wathi ke uYakobi, UmSirayeli mnye wasisikhusela kumgcini-bhokhwe; wathabathela namanzi kuthi, wamisa iinkomo.
Wathi kubo oonyana bakhe, Akhona phi na? Nimshiya njani khona apho? Nceda mncede ukuba afike asele nathi.
Wavuma uMoses ukuba ahlale naye lo mntu, wamnika uSipora intombi yakhe ukuba abe ngumfazi.
Wazala unyana; uMoses wambiza igama lakhe ngokuthi nguGershoni, ngokuba wathi, Ndiye ndaba ngumkhenkce ezweni elingaphandle.
Ke kaloku, emva kweentsuku ezininzi, wafa ukumkani waseYiputa. Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngenxa yobuxoki babo, bavuma; ilizwi labo, ngenxa yobuxoki babo, lafika kuThixo.
Wava ke uThixo intlungu yabo, wakhumbula umnqophiso wakhe noAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi.
Wababona ke uThixo oonyana bakaSirayeli, waza waqonda into abathe bayenza.
Ke kaloku uMoses wayezikhusela iintombi zikaYetro, umyeni wakhe, ukumkani waseMidiyani; waza waqhuba iinkunzi zeegusha kwelaseYiputa, waya eHorebhi, intaba kaThixo.
Ke kaloku wabonakala kuye umbingeleli kaYehova, emngxunyeni womlilo osuka phakathi komthi wesiqhamo. Wajonga ke uMoses, wabona ukuba lo mthi siqhamo ushushu, kodwa awutshisi.
Wathi ke uMoses, Ndiya kudlula ndijonge lo mfanekiso omangalisayo; kutheni na ukuba le ntyatyambo ingatshiyi?
Ke kaloku iNkosi ebona ukuba uMoses ujonge, wabiza uThixo kuye phakathi kwesiqhamo, esithi, UMoses, uMoses. Wathi uMoses, Ndikhona mna.
Wathi uThixo, Musa ukudlula apha; khupha izihlangu zakho; kuba indawo ohlala kuyo yindawo engcwele.
Wathi ke, NdinguThixo kayise wakho, uThixo kaAbraham, uThixo kaIsake, uThixo kaYakobi. UMoses wafihla ubuso bakhe; kuba wayexhala ukuba ajonge kuThixo.
Wathi iNkosi, Ndiyabona ngokucacileyo intlungu yabantu bam abaseYiputa; ndimva umsindo wabo ngenxa yamagosa abo; ndiyazi iintlungu zabo.

Ndiya kutsho ndibasindise kumaYiputa, ndibakhuphe kuloo lizwe,hothise ezweni elilungileyo nelibanzi, ilizwe elinokuthethwa ngalo ubisi notywala, apho kuhlala khona amaKanana, namaHeti, namaAmori, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebhusi.
Ke kaloku, uzuko lwabantwana bakaSirayeli lufike kum, ndiyabona na ukuba abaYiputa bayabaphatha njani.
Ke ngoko, ndiza kukuthumela kuFaro, ukuba uphumeze abantu bam, oonyana bakaSirayeli, eYiputa.
Wathi ke uMoses kuThixo, Ndibani na mna ukuba ndiye kuFaro, ndibakhuphe oonyana bakaSirayeli eYiputa?
Wathi ke uThixo, Kuba ndiya kuba nawe; yaye oku kuzakuba luphawu kuwe lokuba mna ndenza ukuba uthunyelwe: xa uphumeze abantu eYiputa, niza kukhonza uThixo kuloo mlambo.
Wathi uMoses kuThixo, Yabona, xa ndiya kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ndithi kubo, UThixo wabafazi benu undithumelele kuni; baya kumbuza bathi, Lithini igama lakhe? Ndiza kubaphendula ntoni na?
Wathi uThixo kuMoses, Mna ndiye mna; ngoko ke uya kuthetha kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Ndithi, Mna ndim, umthumelele kuni.

Wathi ke uThixo kuMoses, Uthi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli njalo: UYehova, uThixo wabafazi benu, uThixo kaAbraham, uThixo kaIsake, uThixo kaYakobi, umthumelele kum kuni. Eli ligama lam ngonaphakade; eli ligama lokumkhumbula mna ngonaphakade.

Yiya, udibanise abakhulu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo, UYehova, uThixo wabafazi benu, uThixo kaAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi, wabonakala kum, esithi, Ndiye ndakubonani, ndibone konke okusenokwenziwa kuni eYiputa.
Ndathi ke, Ndiza kunikhupha emkhosini wenu eYiputa, ndinikhuphe ezweni lamaKanana, namaHeti, namaAmori, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaYebhusi, ilizwe eliphumayo ubisi nenyathelo.

Amadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli aya kukuxelela; wena namadoda amakhulu akho niya kuye ukumkani waseYiputa, ningathi kuye: UYehova uThixo wamaHebhere usibona. Siyakucela ukuba senze uhambo lweentsuku ezintathu ezweni elimnyama, ukuze sisondeze amadini kuThixo wethu.
Ndiyazi ke ukuba ukumkani waseYiputa akaze akuvumeleni nihambe, ngaphandle kokuba lisandla esinamandla.
Ndiya kuphakamisa isandla sam, ndiyihlasele iYiputa ngazo zonke izinto ezimangalisayo endiza kuzisenza phakathi kwayo; emva koko uya kukuvumeleni nihambe.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba abantu bam bathandeke kumaYiputa; xa niphumayo, aniyi kubuya ningazi nto.

Umfazi ngamnye uya kucela kumhlobo wakhe, nowesifazane ohlala endlwini yakhe, izinto zesilivere, negolide, nezihlangu; nizigqoke kubo oonyana benu nabafazi benu. Niya kuthatha ngoko ubutyebi bama-Egipta.
Waphendula uMoses, wathi, Kungenzeka ukuba bangandikholwanga mna, bangandiphulaphuli? Kungenzeka ukuba bathi, UYehova akakuboniswanga kuwe.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Yintoni leyo esandla sakho? Waphendula uMoses wathi, Intambo.
Wathi iNkosi, Yithule phezu komhlaba. Wayithulela ke uMoses phezu komhlaba; yatshintsha yaba yintaka; uMoses wabaleka phambi kwayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Nciphisa isandla sakho, uyithathe ngomsila wayo. UMoses waphakamisa isandla sakhe, wayithabatha; yabuyela yaba yintonga esandla sakhe.
Yathi ke iNkosi, Yenza oku; ukuze bakholwa ukuba iNkosi, uThixo wabafazi babo, uThixo kaAbraham, uThixo kaIsake, uThixo kaYakobi, uye wabonakala kuwe.
Wathi ke iNkosi, Nciphisa isandla sakho emlonyeni wakho. Wamisa uMoses isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe; waza wayikhupha, yabona ukuba isandla sakhe sinomkhuhlane, saba mhlophe njengethebhu.
Wathi ke uThixo, Nceda ubeke isandla sakho emlonyeni wakho. UMoses wabeka kwakhona isandla sakhe emlonyeni wakhe; waza wayikhupha, yabuya ibe yintliziyo yakhe.
Wathi ke iNkosi, Ukuba akukholwanga wena, nakuba bangawuthobeli umqondiso wokuqala, baya kukholelwa kumqondiso wesibini.
Ke kaloku, ukuba bangakholwanga naloo mqondiso mabini, bangakuthobeli wena, uthabathe amanzi emlambo, uwathele phezu komhlaba omnyama; amanzi athabathe kumlambo aya kuba yigazi phezu komhlaba.

Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Nceda, Nkosi yam; kuba andizange ndibe mhle ngelizwi, nokuba ngaphambili, okanye ukususela ekuqalekeni kokuthetha kwakho nam, umkhonzi wakho. Ndimntu othambileyo ebantwini, nelwimi lam lithambileyo.

Wathi iNkosi kuye, Nguwuphi na lowo wamnika umntu umlomo wakhe? Nguwuphi na lowo wamenza angathethanga, okanye angavakanga? Nguwuphi na lowo wamenza abone, okanye wamenza abe mnyama? Andinguye na mna iNkosi?
Yiya ke ngoku; mna ndiya kukunceda uthethe, ndikufundise into oza kuyithetha.
Wathi ke uMoses, Nceda, Nkosi, thumela omnye.
Ke kaloku iNkosi waxoka kuMoses, wathi, Nguwuphi na uAron, umzalwana wakho, umLevi? Ndiyazi ukuba uthetha kakuhle; khangela, sele ehamba ukuhlangabezana nawe; uya kuphumla xa ekubona.
Uya kuthetha naye, uya kumxelela into omele uyithethe; mna ke ndiza kukuncedisa ukuba nithethe, ndiza kukuxelela into omele niyenze.
Uya kuthetha nawe kubo bonke abantu; uya kuba ngumlomo wakho, nawe uza kuba nguThixo kuye.
Uyithathe ke le ntonga esandla sakho, ukuze uyenze ngayo iimfihlakalo.
Wabuyela uMoses kuYethro, uyise kayise, wathi kuye, Ndiya kukucela ukuba ndibuye kubomi bam eYiputa, ndibone ukuba kukho nabani na ophilayo kubo. Wathi uYethro kuMoses, Yiya, ube noxolo nawe.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses eMidiyani, Yiya ubuyiselwe eYiputa; kuba bafa bonke abantu abafuna ukukubulala.
Wabeka ke uMoses indoda yakhe nabantwana bakhe phezu kweebhokhwe, wabuyela eYiputa; wamthabatha umkhonzi kaThixo sandla sakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Xa ubuyela eYiputa, qaphela ukuba wenze phambi koFaro zonke iimfihlakalo endizimise emlonyeni wakho. Ke mna ndiza kumnqamla umphefumlo wakhe, aze avumele abantu bahambe.
Uthi ke kuFaro, Itsho le nto iNkosi, Unyana wam nguSirayeli, unyana wam omdala.
Ndithi kuwe, Yiya unyana wam, ukuze amkhonze; kodwa awufuni ukumvumela ukuba ahambe; ngoko ke mna ndiza kubulala unyana wakho omdala.
Ke kaloku, ekuhambeni kwabo, kwafika iNkosi kuMoses endlwini yabo yokuhlala ekuseni; wafuna ukumbulala.
Wathi ke uSepora, wathabatha itye eliqaqambileyo, wamisa iinwele zesibeleko sonyana wakhe, wamtshisa ngazo izinyawo zikaMoses; wathi, Uyindodana yegazi mna.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamshiya. Yathi ke ngaloo xesha, Umfazi wegazi, ngenxa yokuthotywa kwakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuAron, Yiya ungenele uMoses entlango. Waye ke uAron, wenele uMoses emnqamlezweni kaThixo, wamxolela.
Wathi ke uMoses kuAron yonke into awayemthumelela yona iNkosi, nayo yonke imiqondiso eyayimwiselayo iNkosi.
Waye ke uMoses noAron, bahlanganisana bonke abathetheli bakaSirayeli.
Wathi ke uAron kubo zonke izinto awathetha ngazo iNkosi kuMoses; wazenza nazonke iimfihlakalo phambi kwamehlo abantu.
Ke kaloku abantu bakholwa. Bathi ke, xa beva ukuba iNkosi wafika ukusindisa oonyana bakaSirayeli, waza wabona ububi babo, bahlangula, bakhonza.
Ke kaloku uMoses noAron bafika kuFaro, bathi kuye, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, uthi, Yiya abantu bam, ukuba bandise iholide kum ezweni elinabantu abaninzi.
Wathi uFaro, Nguwuphi na iNkosi, ukuba ndimthobele, ndiya kushiya amaSirayeli ahambe? Andiyazi iNkosi, andiyi kushiya amaSirayeli ahambe.

Bathi ke kubo, UThixo wamaHebhere udibana nathi; siyakucela ukuba sihambe uhambo lweentsuku ezintathu ezweni elingaziwayo, silungiselele izibingelelo kuYehova uThixo wethu. Ukuba asiyikwenza loo nto, uya kuthi athabathe isidumbu sethu, okanye ikrele.
Wathi ukumkani waseYiputa kubo, Musa noAron, kutheni na ukuba niyikhuphe intliziyo yabantu ekusebenzeni kwabo? Baphinde basebenze.
Wathi ke uFaro, Yabona, abantu bakho baninzi ngoku ezweni; nawe ke ubathintela ukuba bangasebenzi.
Ke kaloku uFaro wamisa ngomhla lowo abaphathi bezihlwele, nabalawuli bezihlwele zabantu.
Wathi, Musani ukuphinda ninike abantu ingqolowa, ukuba benze amakhonkrithi, njengokuba niyenze ngaphambili; bahlale behamba, bathabathe ingqolowa yabo.
Ke kaloku, yenza ukuba benze inani leetafile, njengokuba kwangaphambili; musa ukuwuncipha umlinganiselo wabo; ngokuba balumkile; ngenxa yoko ke besithi, Siyaya sinikela idini kuThixo wethu.
Yandisa umsebenzi kubo, ukuze bahlale bexakekile, bangalibali naliphi na ilizwi elibi.
Baphuma ke abaphathi bezindlu, nabalawuli babo, bathetha nabantu, besithi, Kuthi loo nto uFaro, Andiyi kukuninika ingqolowa.
Yiya, uthathe ingqolowa yakho apho ungayifumana khona; kodwa umsebenzi wakho awusayi kunyuswa.
Basasazeka ke abantu ezweni lonke laseYiputa, bathabathe iziqhamo zokuzisebenzisa njengengca.
Bathi ke abaphathi babo, Nigqibele umsebenzi wenu wosuku ngalunye, njengokuba nisenzayo xa bekukho ingqolowa.
Bathi ke abalawuli bakaFaro, babetha abo balawulayo ooSirayeli, ababebamise phezu kwabo, bathi kubo, Nithini na ukuba nize niyenze iithayile ngomhla wesibini nomhla wokuqala?
Bathi ke abalawuli bakaSirayeli, bafika kuFaro, besithi, Kutheni na ukuba uyenze le nto kubakhonzi bakho?
Asivunywanga isiqhamo, sithe ke kuthiwe, Yenzani iithayile. Abakhonzi bakho baqhutywa; kodwa intlungu iya kuba ngabantu bakho.
Wathi uFaro, Ngubani na lo mntu? Ngubani na lo mntu? Yiyo loo nto nisithi, Siyaya, sisondeze idini kuYehova.
Ke ngoko, buyelani ekusebenzeni kwenu; akuyi kunikezelwa kuni ingqolowa nanye, kodwa nimele niyenze inani elipheleleyo leekhabhathi.
Babebona abalawuli bakaSirayeli ukuba bakwingozi, kuba kwathiwa kubo, Musani ukuncipha inani leetafile nizenzayo ngosuku ngalunye.
Ke kaloku, xa bephuma kuFaro, bafumana uMoses noAron bejongena nabo.
Bathi kubo, UYehova ajonge le nto niyenzayo, anigweme; ngenxa yokuba nisenza uFaro namagqwetha akhe basixolele, nibeka ikrele esandla sabo ukuba sisindise.
Wabuyela ke uMoses kuYehova, wathi, Nkosi, kutheni na ukuba uyenze le nto abantu aba? Kutheni na ukuba undithumele?
Ngomhla ndiye ndafika kuFaro, ukuba ndithethe ngegama lakho, wayenza le ndoda into embi; wena ke awuzange usindise abantu bakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Namhlanje uza kubona into endiyenzayo kuFaro; ngenxa yesandla sam esinamandla, uya kubavumela ukuba bahambe; ngenxa yesandla sam esinamandla, uya kubasusa ezweni lakhe.
Wathi uThixo kuMoses, NdinguYehova.
Ndabonakala kuAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi, ngokuba ndinguThixo Onamandla onke; kodwa ngegama lam, iNkosi, andikwazi ukubonakaliswa kubo.
Ndabamisa nomnqophiso wam, ukuba ndibanike ilizwe lakwaKanan, indawo yabo yokuhlala apho.
Ndimva ke, ndimva uxolo lwabantwana bakaSirayeli, abami baseYiputa bebakhonza; ndakhumbula umnqophiso wam.

Uthi ke kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Ndiye mna iNkosi; ndiza kunikhupha phantsi komsebenzi onzima wamaYiputa, ndiza kunikhulula ekubeni nibe ngabakhonzi babo; ndiza kunisindisa ngesandla sam esinamandla, nezigwebo ezikhulu.
Ndiza kunithatha ningabantu bam, ndiya kuba nguThixo wenu; niyazi ke ukuba mna ndinguYehova uThixo wenu, owenza ukuba niphume phantsi komsebenzi onzima wamaYiputa.
Ndiza kunibeka ezweni endithe ndathi ndiya kulinika uAbraham, noIsake noYakobi; ndiyakulinika libe likhaya lenu. Mna nguYehova."
Wathetha ke uMoses ezi zinto kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli; abazange bamxelele uMoses, ngenxa yokuba iimvakalelo zabo zaziphazamisekile, yaye ukukhonza kwabo kwakunzima.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yiya, uthethe noFaro ukumkani waseYiputa, ukuba avumele abantu bakaSirayeli baphume ezweni lakhe.
Wathi ke uMoses kuYehova, Abantwana bakaSirayeli baya kumxelela; ngaba uFaro uya kumxelela ntoni na, xa ndithetha ngamandla?
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses noAron ngabantwana bakaSirayeli, noFaro ukumkani waseYiputa; wabawisela umthetho ukuba bakhuphe abantwana bakaSirayeli eYiputa.
Ke kaloku ke, aba ngamadoda amakhulu eentsapho zabo. Oonyana bakaRubhen, umzali-mkhulu kaSirayeli: nguEnoki, noPalu, noHeshron, noKarmi; ezi ziintsapho zikaRubhen.
Oonyana bakaSimeon: nguYemuyeli, noYamin, noOhadi, noYahin, noTshohari, noShawule, unyana womfana waseKanan; ezi ziintsapho zikaSimeon.
Lawona magama oonyana bakaLevi, ngokwemimiselo yabo yokuzalwa: uGershoni, noKehati, noMerariya. Waphila ke uLevi iminyaka emakhulu amathathu anamashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo.
Oonyana bakaGershoni, ngokweentsapho zabo: uLibni noShimehi.
Oonyana bakaKahati: nguAmram, noIshar, noHebron, noUziyele. Waphila uKahati iminyaka emakhulu mathathu, anamanci amathathu.
Oonyana bakaMerariya: uMaheli noMushi; ezi ziintsapho zakwaLevi, ngokwemimiselo yabo yokuzalwa.
UAmram wamzala uYokebedi, umyeni wenkosi yakhe; waza wazala uAron noMoses. Waphila uAmram iminyaka emakhulu mathathu anamashumi asixhenxe anesibhozo.
Oonyana baka-Ishar: uKora, noNefegi, noZikri.
Oonyana bakaUziyele: uMishayeli, noElzafan, noSithri.
UAron wamzala uElisheba, intombi ka-Aminadabhi, umzalwana kaNashon; waza wazala uNadabhi noAbhiu, noElezare, noItamari.
Oonyana bakaKora: uAsiri, noElkana, noAbhiyasaf; ezi ziintsapho zakwaKorahi.
UElezare, unyana ka-Aron, waba ngumfazi womnye weendodana zikaPutiyeli; waza wazala uPinehasi. Baye ke abo abathetheli beentsapho zakwaLevi ngokweentsapho zabo.
Lo ke nguAron noMoses, abathe iNkosi wathi kubo, Bakhuphe oonyana bakaSirayeli emazweni aseYiputa, ngokwemikhosi yabo, ibe yimiyalelo.
Baye ke abo bathetha noFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, ukuba akhuphe oonyana bakaSirayeli emazweni aseYiputa; lo nguMoses noAron.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses eYiputa, wathi,
wathi kuye, Ndiye iNkosi; sithi kuFaro ukumkani waseYiputa zonke izinto endithethayo kuwe.
Wathi ke uMoses kuYehova, Ndithetha ulwimi olubi; iFaro iya kundiphulaphula njani?
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yabona, ndinguThixo kuwe kuFaro; noAron umzalwana wakho uya kuba ngumprofeti wakho.
Uthetha wena zonke izinto endikuwiselayo; uAron, umzalwana wakho, uya kuthetha noFaro, ukuba abonise oonyana bakaSirayeli baphume ezweni lakhe.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba iphefumlo likaFaro libe lukhulu, ndize ndizikhuphele izibonakaliso zam nezimangaliso zam eYiputa.
UFaro akayi kuniphulaphula; mna ke ndiya kubeka isandla sam eYiputa, ndizikhuphe iintlanga zam, oonyana bakaSirayeli, ziphuma eYiputa ngeenqulo ezinkulu, ngamazwe ngamazwe.
Bayazi abaYiputa ukuba mna ndinguYehova, xa ndenza isandla sam sifike eYiputa, ndikhuphe oonyana bakaSirayeli phakathi kwabo.
Wakwenza ke uMoses noAron, njengoko iNkosi wabawiselayo.
UMoses ke wayeminyaka imashumi asibhozo ezelwe, uAron ke iminyaka emashumi asibhozo anamithathu, xa bethetha noFaro.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses noAron, wathi,
Xa uFaro esithi kuni, Nceda nindibonise umqondiso; mna ke ndithi kuAron, Yithathe intonga yakho, uyithule phambi koFaro, ibe yintombi.
Bathi ke uMoses noAron, baya kuFaro; basenza njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo. Wathabatha uAron intonga yakhe phambi koFaro, nangaphambili kwabakhonzi bakhe, yaba yinyoka.
Ke kaloku uFaro wabiza oombingeleli bakhe, nabamangali bakhe; bakwenza njalo abamangali bakaYiputa ngemiqondiso yabo.
Bakhupha ngamnye intonga yakhe, intonga nganye yaba yintaka. Intonga ka-Aron yazila iintonga zabo.
Ke kaloku, intliziyo kaFaro yagqitywa, akayi kuwaphulaphula; njengoko iNkosi wayethe.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Intliziyo kaFaro iqinile; akafuni ukuba abantu bahambe.
Yiya kuFaro kusasa, xa ephuma emlanjeni; ulinde kuye phezu komngxunya weNil, uze uthathe ngesandla sakho isithunywa esiguqukayo sibe ngudoda.
Ni fhelele kuye, UYehova, uThixo wamaHebhere, undithumelele kuwe, ndithi, Yiya abantu bam, ukuba bandise idini lam embindini wesango; kodwa wena wawungaphulaphuli de ngoku.
Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Uya kuziqonda ngale nto ukuba mna ndinguYehova: Yabona, ndiya kubetha amanzi aseNili ngesandla sam, aze aguqukele ibe yigazi.
Zonke iintlanzi eNilhini ziya kufa, umlambo uza kuba mnyama; abaYiputa bangadlanga amanzi akhe.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Utsho uAron, Yithathe intonga yakho, uyeke isandla sakho phezu kwamanzi aseYiputa, emanzini ayo, nemilambo Yemenu, nezilwandle zayo, nazo zonke izihlathi zayo; zibe yigazi; ibe yigazi ezweni lonke laseYiputa, nakwiibhotile zentsimbi, nakwiibhotile zelitye.

Wakwenza ke uMoses noAron, njengokuba wamwiselayo iNkosi; waphakamisa uAron isandla sakhe phambi koFaro, nangaphambili kwabakhonzi bakhe, wabetha amanzi eNil; amanzi onke amdaka atshintshe abe yigazi.
Intlanzi eNilwini yafa, umlambo wanyamalala; abaYiputa abakwazi ukusela amanzi akhe; kwakukho igazi kuwo onke amazwe aseYiputa.
Ke kaloku abamangali bakaYiputa bakwenza njalo ngobuqhophololo babo. Yathi ke intliziyo kaFaro yagqitywa, akayi kuwava uMoses noAron; njengoko iNkosi wayethe.
Ke kaloku uFaro wajika, waya endlwini yakhe; akayi kuthatha loo nto emlonyeni wakhe.
Ke kaloku bonke abaYiputa baxhathisa ngaphaya kweNile, befuna amanzi okusela; ngokuba bangawadla amanzi emlambo.
Zadlula iintsuku ezisixhenxe, emva kokuba iNkosi ehlasele iNyanga.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya kuFaro, uthi kuye, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Vumela abantu bam ukuba bahambe, ukuba bandise.
Ukuba ke ungayivumelanga ukuba bahambe, bona, ndiya kuzisa isifo seentlanzi kuwo onke amazwe akho.

Ulwandle luza kuba likhulu elinamagqabi; ziyanyuka zifike endlwini yakho, nasegumbini lakho lokuhlambela, nakwibhedi yakho; ziza kungena kumakhaya eempawu zakho, nakwabantu bakho, nakwiifriji zakho, nezitya zakho zokupheka.
Iintaka ziya kukhupha phezu kwakho, naphezu kwabantu bakho, naphezu kwabaphathi bakho bonke.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Utsho uAron, Unqumle isandla sakho nesikhephe sakho phezu kwemilambo, neziqhamo, nezilwandle, uzikhuphe izityalo-mlilo phezulu ezweni laseYiputa.
Wamisa ke uAron isandla sakhe phezu kwamanzi aseYiputa; zanyuka iziqhamo, zazigubungela ilizwe.
Ke kaloku abamangali bayenze loo nto ngobuqhophololo babo; bakhupha iintaka phezulu kwilizwe laseYiputa.
Waza uFaro wabiza uMoses noAron, wathi, Nithandazani kuYehova, ukuba asuse ezi ntlanzi kum nakubami bam; ndiya kubavumela abantu bahambe, banikela idini kuYehova.
Wathi uMoses kuFaro, Ixesha liwe kuwe; lithini na ixesha endiza kukucela ngalo wena, nabakhonzi bakho, nabantu bakho, ukuba zihambe iintaka kude nawe, nezindlu zakho, zihlale eNtlanzini kuphela?
Wathi uFaro, Ngomso. Wathi uMoses, Kuza kwenzeka ngokwelizwi lakho; ukuze wazi ukuba akukho namnye njengoYehova uThixo wethu.
Iintaka ziyakushiya wena, nezindlu zakho, nabakhonzi bakho, nabantu bakho; ziya kuhlala eNyonweni kuphela.
Baphuma ke uMoses noAron kuFaro; wathandaza uMoses kuYehova, ngenxa yeentlanzi azenzayo kwiFaro.
Wakwenza iNkosi ngokwelizwi likaMoses; zafa iintaka endlwini, nasezindluni, nasezindaweni.
Bathi ke abantu bazenza zibe ziinkunzi, ilizwe liphela laza linquma.
Ke kaloku, xa uFaro ebona ukuba ingxaki iphelile, wagqiba intliziyo yakhe, akawaphulaphulanga ooMoses noAron; njengokuba wathi iNkosi.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Utsho uAron, Nciphisa intonga yakho, udibanise umgubo wehlabathi; umgubo womhlaba uza kuba ziintsholongwane kuzo zonke ilizwe laseYiputa.
Bakwenza njalo; uAron wamisa isandla sakhe ngentsimbi, wambetha umgubo wehlabathi, waba ngamaqhekeza kubantu nakwizinto eziphilayo. Wonke umgubo ezweni lonke laseYiputa wawuba ngamaqheki.
Ke kaloku abamangali bafuna ukwenza izidumbu ngezinto zabo ezifihlakeleyo; kodwa bangakwazanga. Zathi izidumbu zihlala ebantwini nakwiinyama.
Bathi abamangali kuFaro, Le yimpuma kaThixo. Ke kaloku intliziyo kaFaro yagqitywa, akayi kuphulaphula; njengoko iNkosi abesithiyo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya ekuseni, uhlale phambi kukaFaro, xa ephuma emlanjeni; uthi kuye, Utsho iNkosi ukuthi, Vumela abantu bam ukuba bahambe, ukuze bandise.

Ukuba ke ungawavumelanga abantu bam ukuba bahambe, bona, ndiya kuthuthela kuwe, nabakhonzi bakho, nabantu bakho, nakwiindlu zakho, iinqwelo-moya; izindlu zabaYiputa ziya kuba zigcwele iintlanzi-moya, nayo yonke indawo abase kuyo.
Ke mna, ngaloo mini, ndiya kwenza ilizwe laseGoshen, apho abantu bam behlala khona; akusayi kubakho khona amaphiko eentyatyambo. Uza kuziqonda ke ukuba mna iNkosi ndiphakathi kwaloo lizwe.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba kubekho ukuphela phakathi kwabahlobo bam nabahlobo bakho. Lo mqondiso uza kwenzeka namhlanje.
Wakwenza ke iNkosi loo nto, zafika iintlanzi ezimdaka endlwini kaFaro, nakwiindlu zabakhonzi bakhe; lonke ilizwe laseYiputa laphazanyiswa zizityalo.
Wabiza uFaro uMoses noAron, wathi, Yiya, ninikele izibingelelo kuThixo wenu kuloo lizwe.

Wathi ke uMoses, Ayifanelekanga loo nto; kuba izibingelelo zethu esizinikela kuhotyoshelweyo kuYehova uThixo wethu ziya kuba yintlungu kumaYiputa. Ukuba sinikela intlungu yabo emehlweni abo, bangasithutha njani iithayile?
Siya kuhamba ngendlela yeentsuku ezintathu, sifike ezweni elingenanto, silungiselele umbingelelo kuYehova uThixo wethu, njengokuba athi kuthi.
Wathi uFaro, Ndiza kunivumela ukuba nihambe, ukuze ninike izibingelelo kuYehova uThixo wenu esiqwini; kodwa ningayi kuhamba kude kakhulu; ke ngoko mna ndicela.

Wathi uMoses, Ndiya kuthandaza kuYehova, xa ndiphuma kuwe; ukuze zihambe izihotyoshe iintaka ngoMgqibelo zisuka kuFaro, kumakhonzi akhe, nabantu bakhe. Ke kaloku uFaro asiyi kuphinda athabathe isiqingatha sethu, engafuni ukusivumela abantu ukuba baphume, ukuba babe yimibingelelo kuYehova.
Waphuma uMoses kuFaro, wathandaza kuYehova.
Wakwenza iNkosi ngokwelizwi likaMoses; zasuka izidumbu kuFaro, kumakhonzi akhe, nabantu bakhe; akazange ashiye isidumbu.
Ke kaloku uFaro waqina intliziyo yakhe ngaloo xesha, akaze avumele abantu bahambe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya kuFaro, uthi kuye, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo wamaHebhere ukuthi, Yazisa abantu bam ukuba bahambe, ukuze bandikhonza.
Ukuba ke nithi, Musani ukuzishiya zihambe, Nizibambe ngokuqinileyo;
Isandla sikaYehova siza kuzisa ubhubhane olukhulu kwizitho zakho eziphilayo ezweni, kwiimahashe akho, neebhokhwe zakho, neenkomo zakho, neentyatyambo zakho, nezimvu zakho.
Ke kaloku iNkosi uza kwenza izinto eziphilayo zakwaSirayeli zibe ngazo ngezinye kunezinto eziphilayo zabaYiputa; akukho nto iphilayo yabantwana bakaSirayeli iza kufa.
Wamisa iNkosi ixesha, esithi, Ngomhla wesibini iNkosi uya kwenza oku kuloo ndawo.
Wakwenza ke iNkosi loo nto ngemini elandelayo; zafa zonke iinkomo zabaYiputa, kodwa kwabaSirayeli akukho nkomo enye yafa.
Ke kaloku uFaro wathumela, babona ke, bona, akukho nto ifileyo kwizinto eziphilayo zabaSirayeli. Ke kaloku intliziyo kaFaro yagqitywa, akayi kushiya abantu bahambe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses noAron, Nciphisaneni izandla zenu ngefuthe lefriji; uMoses alifuthele elwandle phambi koFaro.
Uya kuba nguthuli oluncinci phezu kwelizwe lonke laseYiputa; luza kwenza ukuba kuqhume iintsholongwane, zibe ziintlungu ebantwini nakwizinto eziphilayo kuzo zonke iindawo zeYiputa.
Bathi ke, bathabathe inkunkuma yefu, baba phambi koFaro; uMoses wayityhala emphefumlweni; zaphuma izilonda ezivela ebusweni bomuntu nakwinyama.
Abamangali abazange bakwazi ukuma phambi kukaMoses, ngenxa yeentlungu; ngokuba izitlungu zazikho kubo bonke abamangali, nabaYiputa.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wayenza intliziyo kaFaro ibe buhlungu, akawaphulaphulanga ooMoses noAron; njengoko iNkosi wayethe wathi kuMoses.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya ekuseni, uhlale phambi kukaFaro, uthethe kuye, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo wamaHebhere ukuthi, Yazisa abantu bam ukuba bahambe, ukuze bandise.
Le xesha ndiya kuzithumela zonke izidumbu zam kuwe, nabakhonzi bakho, nabantu bakho; ukuze wazi ukuba akukho namnye ofana nam emhlabeni wonke.
Ndiya kuzisa ngoku isandla sam, ndikuhlasele wena nabantu bakho ngomhlaza, ukuze uphelelwe lixesha phezu kwehlabathi.
Ke kaloku ngaloo nto ndenza ukuba uphile, ukuze ndibonise kuwe amandla am, ukuze igama lam likwaziwe emhlabeni wonke.
Uyaqhubeka umisa isandla sakho ebantwini bam, awuze ubavumele bahambe.
Ngokuba namhlanje, ngaloo xesha, ndiya kuzisa imvula ebuhlungu kakhulu yothuli, engazange ifike kwiYiputa, ukususela ngemini eyayiye yaba lilizwe, iye ngoku.

Nceda ke ngoku, unike umyalelo ukuba iinkomo zakho, nazo zonke izinto ozinezo ezweni, zithunyelwe ezibhedleleni; kuba kuzo zonke iintlanga nezinto eziphilayo, ezishiyeka ezweni, zingavunywa ngaphakathi, ziya kuhla inkungu, zibe zifile.
Ke kaloku, abathile kumadoda amakhulu kaFaro bakhathazeka ngenxa yelizwi likaYehova; bakhawulezisa ukungenisa amakhonzi abo nezinto zabo eziphilayo.
Ke kaloku abo baphulaphule ilizwi likaYehova, bashiya abakhonzi babo nezinto zabo eziphilayo ezweni.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Nqumle isandla sakho phezulu ezulu, ukuze kubekho intaba-mlilo phezu kwayo yonke iYiputa, phezu komntu, nangaphezulu kwezinto eziphilayo, nangaphezulu kweentyatyambo zonke ezikhula emasimini aseYiputa.

Ke kaloku uMoses wamisa isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni; ke iNkosi wamthumela umthunywa, nemvula eshushu, kwathi kuphuma imibhobho yelanga iye emhlabeni. UYehova wamkhupha umoya oshushu phezu kwelizwe laseYiputa.
Yathi intaba-mlilo, iinkwenkwezi zihamba ngapha nangapha phakathi kweentaba-mlilo; yayiyeyona mvula inkulu ezweni lonke laseYiputa ukususela ekubeni lilizwe.
Kwathi, ezweni lonke laseYiputa, iintaba-mlilo zabetha zonke izinto ezisendleni, kubantu nakwizinto eziphilayo; zabetha zonke izityalo zendalo, zaphula yonke imithi.
Ilizwe likaGoshen, apho bahlala khona oonyana bakaSirayeli, lilinye kuphela ilizwe elingabikho kulo uthuli.
Wathumela ke uFaro, wabiza uMoses noAron; wathi kubo, Ndiphelelwe lityala ngaloo xesha; iNkosi ungumntu olungileyo, mna nabantu bam sibengabikho.
Musani ukuthandaza kuYehova, kuba sithe saphelelwa zithuthuzelo nezingqekembe; ndiza kunishiya nihambe; musa ukuhlala ixesha elide.
Wathi ke uMoses kuye, Xa ndiphuma kumzi, ndiya kuphakamisa izandla zam kuYehova; izithunywa zezulu ziya kuhlala, akusayi kubakho namanzi abandayo; ukuze wazi ukuba le hlabathi nguYehova.
Ke mna ndiyazi ukuba wena, nabasebenzi bakho, ningamkhoyi iNkosi uThixo.
I-lin kunye nesheyile zalahleka; ngokuba i-sheyile yazisa iziqhamo zayo, kwaye i-lin yayikwimbali.
Ke kaloku ingqolowa ne-spelt azilahleki, ngokuba zivela kamsinya.
Waphuma ke uMoses eFaro, waphuma emzini, waphakamisa izandla zakhe kuYehova; zayeka izithunywa zezulu neziqhushumbisi, nemvula yanyamalala phezu kwelizwe.
Ke kaloku, xa uFaro ebona ukuba imvula, nezingqimba-mlilo, nezithunywa-mlilo zithe zamisa, waqhubeka esenza ububi; waza waba namandla intliziyo yakhe, yena nabakhonzi bakhe.
Ke kaloku intliziyo kaFaro yagqitywa, akayi kushiya abantwana bakaSirayeli bahambe; njengoko iNkosi wathetha ngaye ngoMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya kuFaro; kuba mna ndenza isandla sakhe sibe siqinileyo, naye nabasebenzi bakhe, ukuze ndiyenze le miqondiso yam phakathi kwabo.
Ndiya kwenza ke oku, ukuze uthethe kunyana wakho, nonyana wonyana wakho, ngezinto endizenzayo kumaYiputa, nezibonakaliso zam endizenzayo phakathi kwabo; niyazi ukuba ndinguYehova.
Bathi ke uMoses noAron kuye uFaro, bathi kuye, Utsho iNkosi, uThixo wamaHebhere, esithi, Uza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani ungathandabuzi ukunyamezela phambi kwam? Yazisa abantu bam ukuba bandise.
Ukuba ke ungamvumelanga ukuba ahambe, yabona, namhlanje ndiza kuzisa izityalo-mlilo emda wakho.
Ziyigubungele ilizwe, ukuze lingabonakaliyo; ziya kulila nantoni na encinci oyishiyayo emva kwengxowa-mlilo, nayo yonke imithi ekhula emzini wakho.

Ziza kuzigcwalisa izindlu zakho, nezindlu zabaphathi bakho bonke, nazo zonke izindlu zakwaMisir. Abafazi benu, nabantwana bentombi zenu, abazange babone into efana nale, ukususela kumhla ababehlala ngawo kuloo mhlaba de kube ngoku.
Bathi kuye abakhonzi bakaFaro, Kude kube nini na ukuba lo mntu abe sisiqhamo sethu? Vumela abantu bahambe, bakhonza iNkosi uThixo wabo; awubonanga na ukuba iYiputa ilahliwe?
Babuyiselwa ke uMoses noAron kuFaro; wathi kubo, Yiya nikhonza iNkosi uThixo wenu; kodwa mnixelele ukuba ngubani na oza kuhamba.
Waphendula uMoses wathi, Siza kuhamba nathi abantwana bethu nabadala bethu, nabantwana bethu neentombi zethu, nezimvu zethu neebhokhwe zethu; ngokuba sinomthendeleko woYehova.
Wathi uFaro, UYehova uya kuba nani ngokuqinisekileyo, ukuba ndikuvumeleni nihambe, nina nabantwana benu; akunyanzelekanga ukuba nicinge into embi.
Ke kaloku, bangaya amadoda kuphela, akhonze iNkosi; ngokuba oko kuthe lwathiwa nguMoses noAron. Bathunyelwe ke uMoses noAron phambi kweFaro.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Nqumle isandla sakho phezu kweYiputa, ukuze izityalo-mlilo zikhuphe phezulu phezu kwelizwe, zidle zonke iintyatyambo, yonke into eshiyekayo yimihlaba.

Wamisa uMoses intonga yakhe phezu kweYiputa; iNkosi wabangela ukuba kuqhume umoya wasempumalanga phezu kweli lizwe ngaloo mini yonke, nobusuku bonke; kwathi ke ngasekupheleni kwemini, umphefumlo waba neentlanga.
Zafika izityalo-mlilo phezu kwelizwe lonke laseYiputa, zahlala kuwo onke amacala; zange kubekho izityalo-mlilo ezinjalo ngaphambili, yaye akuyi kubakho kwakhona.

Zazigubungela zonke iindawo zehlabathi, zathi zimnyama; zazidla zonke izinto ezikhulayo ezweni, nazo zonke iziqhamo zezityalo, ezishiyelwe yimihlaba. Akukho nto iluhlaza yashiywa ngazo zonke iintyatyambo nezityalo, kuzo zonke iilizwe zaseYiputa.
Ke kaloku uFaro wabiza ngokukhawuleza uMoses noAron, wathi, Ndiphelele kuYehova uThixo wenu, nani na.
Ke ngoko, mna ke, ndicela, ndikuxolele isono sam ngelo xesha kuphela; nithandazani kuYehova uThixo wenu, ukuba asuse kum le ntlungu yokufa.
Waphuma uMoses eFaro, wathandaza kuYehova.

Ke kaloku iNkosi waguqula umoya, waba ngumphunga onamandla kakhulu osuka kwelaseNtshona; wathabatha iintaka-ntlaba, waza uzithutha elwandle oluMnyama. Akukho ntaka-ntlaba nanye yashiywa kuwo onke amazwe aseYiputa.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wayenza intliziyo kaFaro iqinile, akaze avumele abantu bakaSirayeli bahambe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Nciphisa isandla sakho phezulu emazulwini, ukuze kubekho ubumnyama eYiputa, ubumnyama obuqinileyo, bukwazi ukutyhala.
Wamisa ke uMoses isandla sakhe esibhakabhakeni; kwathikho umnyama omkhulu, wagubungela lonke elaseYiputa iintsuku ezintathu.
Akukho namnye owabona umntu, akukho namnye waphuma kwindawo yakhe imihla emithathu; bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli babenokukhanya apho behlala khona.
Waza uFaro wambiza uMoses, wathi, Yiya, nikhonza iNkosi; nabantwana benu bangahamba nani; iinkomo zenu neentlanzi zenu kuphela zishiye.
Wathi ke uMoses, Kufuneka nisinikele nathi iinkomo zokudla, nezibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamandla, ukuze sizinike kuYehova uThixo wethu.

Izinto zethu eziphilayo kufuneka zihambe nathi; akufuneki kubekho nesinye isisu esishiyeka, ukuze sisebenzise ezinye zazo ukukhonza iNkosi uThixo wethu; kuba siyazi ukuba zeziphi ezo zinto siza kuzisebenzisa ukukhonza iNkosi, de sifike apho.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wayenza intliziyo kaFaro ibe buhlungu, akafuni ukuba baphume.
Wathi uFaro kuMoses, Yiya kude kum; qiniseka ukuba awuyi kubona kwakhona umlomo wam; kuba ngaloo mini ubona ngayo umlomo wam, uya kufa.
Wathi uMoses, Kunjalo njengoko uthiyo; andizukukubona kwakhona ubuso bakho.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ndiza kunika isifo esinye eFaro naseYiputa; emva koko uya kukushiya nihambe apha; xa ke ekwenzela njalo, uya kukukhupha ngokugcweleyo.
Utsho kubo abantu, ukuba umntu ngamnye nowesifazane ngamnye babuze abahlobo babo baseYiputa izinto zesilivere negolide.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamnika abantu ububele kumaYiputa; noMoses waba mkhulu kakhulu eYiputa, phambi kwamagqwetha kaFaro, nangaphambili kwabantu.
Wathi uMoses, Itsho le nto iNkosi, Ngobusuku obuphakathi, ndiya kuhamba phakathi kweYiputa.

Wonke umntwana ozalwa kuqala eYiputa uya kufa, ukususela kumntwana ozalwa kuqala kaFaro, ohlala kwisithsaba sakhe, waya kumntwana ozalwa kuqala komkhonzi-mfazi, otshisa iziqhamo emlilweni wakhe; nazo zonke izinto ezizalwa kuqala.
Kuza kubakho uzuko olukhulu ezweni lonke laseYiputa, ngaphezu kobubi obuye bubekho, nobuya kubakho.
Ke kaloku iinkunzi zebhokhwe aziyi kutyhala nabani na kubo bonke ooSirayeli, nokuba ziinkomo zabo; niyazi ke ukuba iNkosi enza ukuhlukana phakathi kwamaYiputa namaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku abaphathi bakho bonke baya kungena kum, baphumle phambi kwam, besithi, Yiya wena, nawe bonke abantu abalandelayo; emva koko ndiya kuphuma. Waphuma ke uMoses kuFaro, ecinezelwe yintliziyo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuMoses, UFaro akayi kuniphulaphulani; ukuze ndiqhubeke ndisenza imiqondiso yam eYiputa.
UMoses noAron bazenza zonke ezi zinto zimanga phambi kweFaro; ke iNkosi wayenza intliziyo kaFaro iqinile, akaze avumele oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba baphume ezweni lakhe.
Wathetha ke iNkosi kuMoses noAron eYiputa, wathi,
Le nyanga iya kuba ngukuqala kweenyanga kuni, ibe yinyanga yokuqala yonyaka wenu.
Lithe ke ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli: Ngomhla wesixhenxe wale nyanga, bathabathe umntu ngamnye inkunzi yenkomo ngendlu yakhe, inkunzi yenkomo ngasekhaya.

Ukuba ikhaya lincinci kakhulu ukuba lidle inkunzi yebhokhwe yonke, kufuneka liyinikezele kumhlobo walo omfutshane, ngokwenani labantu; bhala inani elifunekayo lebhokhwe ngenani eliya kulitya umntu ngamnye.
Inyama oyikhethayo kufuneka ibe yindoda eneminyaka ilishumi elinamibini, ingabikho nakuphi na ukulimala kuyo. Ungayithatha phakathi kweenkomo okanye phakathi kweebhokhwe.
Niyigcine de kube limini yeshumi elinesine yale nyanga; bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli baya kuzibulala iintlanzi zabo, xa ilanga liphuma.
Baya kuthatha igazi labo, baya kulibeka phezu kweengcango zendlu, nangaphezulu komngxunya womngxunya wesango lendlu, apho belidla khona.
Baye bayidle inyama ngaloo busuku, itshiziwe emanzini, neentyatyambo ezibi, nesonka esingenawo umxube.
Musani kulila inyama ecocekileyo, nokuba ixutywe ngamanzi. Umele uyitshise yonke phezu komlilo, intloko yayo, nemilenze yayo, nezitho zayo.
Musani kushiya nantoni na kuyo ukuya emveni kwemini; ukuba ishiye nantoni na kuyo ukuya emveni kwemini, uyitshise.
Niyidle ngayo loo nto: niyibeke umsesane wakho phantsi, nezihlangu zakho ezinyawo zenu, nentambo yakho esandla sakho; niyidle ngokukhawuleza; kuba yiPasha kaYehova.
Ndiya kudlula phakathi kweYiputa ngaloo busuku, ndibulala onke azalwa kuqala, nokuba ngumntu nakwizinto eziphilayo; ndiza kwenza izigwebo kumadini onke aseYiputa. Ndiye iNkosi.
Le gazi liya kuba nguphawu kuni ezindlwini zenu; xa ndibona igazi, ndiya kudlula phezu kwenu; akukho mkhuhlane obulalayo uza kunibetha, xa ndithise amaYiputa.
Lo mhla umele ube ngumhla wokukhumbula kuni; niwugcine njengosuku lokuphumla kuYehova, phakathi kweentlanga zenu zonke. Ngumthetho ohlala ubomi bonke.

Nidle iintsuku ezisixhenxe isonka esingenasiqhamo. Ngomhla wokuqala nisuse isiqhamo endlwini yenu; kuba nawuphi na umntu odla isinkwa esingenasiqhamo, ukusukela ngomhla wokuqala waya kumhla wesixhenxe, loo ndoda iya kususwa kumaSirayeli.

Ngomhla wokuqala nibe nengqungquthela engcwele, nomhla wesixhenxe nibe nengqungquthela engcwele; kungabikho msebenzi owenzayo ngaloo mini, ngaphandle kokulungiselela isonka salowo nalowo ukutya kwakhe. Oku kuzo zonke izinto oza kuzisenza.
Niyigcine imini yeentlanzi ezingenasonka; ngokuba ngaloo mini ndibakhuphe abantu bakho ezweni laseYiputa, ngokwemikhosi yabo; niyigcine loo mini mihla le. Ligunya elihlala ixesha elide.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe wenyanga yokuqala, ngobusuku bemini yeshumi elinesine, nidla isonka esingaqhelekanga, kuze kube ngobusuku bemini yeshumi elinesibini, nidle isonka esingaqhelekanga.
Iintsuku ezisixhenxe akufuneki kubekho umxube endlwini yenu; kuba wonke umntu odla into enomxube kuyo, lo mntu uya kususwa kumkhosi wakwaSirayeli, nokuba ungumkhenkce, nokuba ungumzala womhlaba.
Musani ukutya nantoni na eyenziwe ngomxube; kuzo zonke izindlu zenu nidle isonka esingaxutywanga.
Wabiza ke uMoses bonke abathetheli bakaSirayeli, wathi kubo, Yiya nithathe iinkunzi zeenkomo ngeendlu zenu, nizifile inkunzi yenkomo yepaski.

Bathi ke, Niyithathe intyatyambo ye-hysop, niyitshise kwigazi elikwibhotile, niyifake phezu kophahla lomnyango, naphezu komngxunya womngxunya womngxunya, ngegazi elo; akukho namnye kuni oza kuphuma emngxunyeni wendlu yakhe, de kube limini.

Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi edlula ukuwabulala amaYiputa, uya kubona igazi elunxwemeni lwamasango nasemva komngxunya womngxunya wesivalo; ke iNkosi uya kudlula umngxunya lowo, akawuvumele lo monakalo ukuba afike ezindlwini zenu, awawe.
Niyigcine le mithetho, wena nabantwana bakho, ibe ngumthetho ophakamileyo;
Ke kaloku, nifike ezweni iNkosi aza kukunika lona, njengokuba wathi, zinikele lo mthendeleko.
Ke kaloku, xa abantwana bakho bekukubuza, besithi, Yintoni le nkqubo?

nithi kubo, Lidini lePasika kuYehova; ngenxa yokuba wadlula phezu kweendlu zabantwana bakaSirayeli eYiputa, xa wayewabulala amaEgipta, waza wakhusela izindlu zethu. Bathe ke abantu baphumla, bakhonza uThixo.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, njengokuba iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses noAron.

Ngobusuku obuphakathi, wabulala iNkosi wonke umzali-mntwana eYiputa, ukususela kumzali-mntwana kaFaro, ohlala kwisitulo sakhe, waya kumzali-mntwana wowesihlwele esibhedleleni; wababulala nabo bonke abazali-mntwana benyama.
Wavuka ke uFaro ngaloo busuku, naye onke amakhonzi akhe, nabo bonke abaYiputa; kwabakho unqulo olukhulu eYiputa; kuba kwakungekho ndlu ingabikho kuyo umntu ofileyo.
Wayibiza ke iFaro ngobusuku uMoses noAron, yathi kubo, Yiya niphume phakathi kwabantu bam, nina nabantwana bakaSirayeli; nihambe nikhonze iNkosi, njengoko nithenzileyo.
Nizithathe iinkomo zenu, nezimvu zenu, njengokuba nithiyo, nihambeni; ndibhaptize ke nam.
Bathi ke abaYiputa kubo bonke abantu, ukuba bakhawuleze baphume ezweni; bathi, Ukuba niya kuphuma, siza kufa sonke.
Bathi ke abantu, bathabathe umgubo wabo, phambi kokuba kutheleke isonka; babeka izitya zabo zeentyatyambo ezityebileyo kwimpahla yabo, bazithabatha emqolombeni.
Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli ngokwelizwi likaMoses; bacela kumaYiputa izinto zesilivere, negolide, nezigqomo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wabanika abantu ububele ngabaseYiputa, babebanikela; ke ngoko abaSirayeli bathabathe iimpahla zabaseYiputa zezezimali.
Bahamba ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, besuka eRamesi baya eSukoti; babe ngamawaka amabini anamakhulu amathandathu amadoda ahamba ngeenyawo, ngaphandle kwabantwana.
Bahamba nabo abanye abantu abaninzi, nezihlwele ezikhulu zezinto eziphilayo.
Bezilungiselela iintonga zesonka, besebenzisa umgubo abawuthabathayo eYiputa; ngenxa yokuba baphuma eYiputa, bengenaxesha lokuzilungiselela ukutya.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli behlala eYiputa iminyaka engamawaka amane anamashumi amathathu.
Ke kaloku, ngokuphela kweminyaka engamawaka amane amashumi mathathu, ngaloo mini leyo, bonke abantu bakaYehova baphuma eYiputa, njengeqela.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wagweba ngaloo busuku, ukuba awakhuphe eYiputa; ngoko ke bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli bagwebe kuloo busuku, ukuze bathande iNkosi kude kube sekupheleni kosuku.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses noAron, Lo ngumthetho wepasha: Akukho mnye wangaphandle oza kuyidla.
Ke kaloku wonke umkhonzi wakho othengiweyo uya kuludla, emva kokuba uthethele.
Umkhenkce ohlala nawe, nokuba ngumqeshwa wakho, angayidla loo nto.
Zidlalwe ngaphakathi endlwini enye; musa ukuthabatha nantoni na yemifuno yayo ngaphandle kwendlu, nize ningatshisi nantoni na yezihlunu zayo.
Yonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli liya kwenza oko.

Ke kaloku, ukuba uthile ohlala phakathi kwenu efuna ukwenza iPasha kaYehova, wonke umfazi endlwini yakhe kufuneka alungiselwe; ngoko ke uya kuyidla njengokuba umntu ozalwa kuloo mhlaba. Kodwa akukho namnye ongalungiswanga angayidla.
Umele abe nemithetho efanayo nalowo uzalwa kuloo mhlaba, nalowo uvela kwelinye ilizwe uhlala phakathi kwenu.
Bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli bakwenza njalo, njengokuba iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses noAron.
Ke kaloku, ngaloo mini iNkosi wabakhupha oonyana bakaSirayeli emazweni aseYiputa, ngemikhosi yabo, njengeqela.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Nceda unciphise kum onke amabhinqa aphuma emlonyeni; onke amabhinqa aphuma emlonyeni womntwana phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli aya kuba amyeni wam, nokuba ngumntu nakuba yinyama.

Wathi ke uMoses kubo bonke abantu, Khumbulani le mini, imini yokuphuma kwenu eYiputa, ukuba niyimikhonzi; iNkosi wamkhupha khona ngesandla sakhe esinamandla. Musani ukudla nantoni na eyenziwe ngomxube.
Namhlanje, ngomhla wenyanga ka-Abib, niphuma.

Wathi iNkosi kubafazi bakho, ukuba uya kukunika ilizwe lamaKanana, namaHeti, namaAmori, namaHivi, namaYebhusi, ilizwe eliphumayo ngobisi nenyathelo. Ke kaloku, xa uThixo wakho ekule lizwe, uya kukwenza lo mthendeleko kuloo nyanga.
Iintsuku ezisixhenxe nidle isonka esingaqhelekanga; ngomhla wesixhenxe nigcine isikhumbuzo kuYehova.
Nidle isonka esingenasiqhamo iintsuku ezisixhenxe; akukho siqhamo singabonakaliyo phakathi kwenu, akukho siqhamo singabonakaliyo kuwo onke amazwe akho.
Uthi kunyana wakho ngaloo mini, Ndiyenza loo nto ngenxa yale nto iNkosi ayenze kum, xa ndaphuma eYiputa.
Le nto ibe ngumqondiso esandlani sakho, ibe ngulayibrari emehlweni akho; ukuze umthetho kaYehova ube emlonyeni wakho; ngokuba iNkosi wakukhupha eYiputa ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.
Ke ngoko, niyigcine le mithetho ngexesha elifanelekileyo ngonyaka ngamnye.
UYehova uya kukungenisa ezweni lakwaKanan, aze akuyinike wena, njengoko wathethayo kuwe nabazalwana bakho.
Yonke inkunzi yebhokhwe ezalwa ngumama wayo, uyinike kuYehova. Yonke inkunzi yebhokhwe yezinto zakho eziphilayo, ibhinqa, lilungu likaYehova.

Uza kuyithenga yonke i-esile ephuma emntwini, uyinike inkunzi yebhokhwe endaweni yayo; ukuba awuyithenganga, uya kutshisa umqolo wayo. Naye wonke unyana ophuma emntwini phakathi kwabantwana bakho uya kuwuthenga.
Kwiintsuku ezizayo, xa unyana wakho akubuza, esithi, Yintoni le nto? uthi kuye, UYehova wasikhuphe ngesandla sakhe esinamandla eYiputa, apho sakuba ngabakhonzi;

Ke kaloku, ngenxa yokuba uFaro wayesazi ukusivumela ukuba sihambe, iNkosi wambulala wonke umzali wesibeleko eYiputa, nokuba ngumntu nakwizinto eziphilayo; ngoko ke ndiyamnikela kuYehova wonke umzali wesibeleko owesifazane; kodwa onke oonyana bam abazali besibeleko ndiwathenga.
Le nto imele ibe ngumqondiso esandla sakho, nophawu phakathi kweenwele zakho; ngokuba iNkosi usikhuphe eYiputa ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.

Ke kaloku, xa uFaro evumela abantu ukuba bahambe, uThixo akawaqhubi ngendlela yomhlaba wamaFilisti, nakuba yayifutshane; wathi ke uThixo, Ingaba xa bebona umkhosi, baya kutshintsha intliziyo yabo, babuye eYiputa.
Ke kaloku uThixo wabaqhubela abantu uhambo olude olujikelezayo, ngeendawo ezingqongileyo zolwandle olumnyama. Baphuma oonyana bakaSirayeli eYiputa, belungiselela ukulwa.
UMoses wathabatha izihlunu zikaYosefu naye; ngokuba uYosefu wabanika isibingelelo oonyana bakaSirayeli, esithi, Ke kaloku uThixo uya kukuncedani; ke ngoko nizikhuphe izihlunu zam phezulu nani apha.
Basuka eSukothi, bamisa itente eEthame, esiphelweni sesiqithi.

UYehova wayehamba phambi kwabo ngemini, emnqamlezweni wefuthe, ukuba abonise indlela yabo; ngobusuku ke wayehamba phambi kwabo emnqamlezweni womnqamlezo womlilo, ukuba abonise indlela yabo, ukuze bahambe mihla le nobusuku.
Umnqamlezo wefuthe ngobusuku, nomnqamlezo womlilo ngobusuku, akazange asuse indawo yakhe phambi kwabo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Utsho oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba babuye, basike ecaleni kwePi-Hahirothi, phakathi kukaMigdoli nolwandle; sikele isikhephe ecaleni kolwandle, phambi koBhaali-sefoni.
Ke uFaro uya kuthetha, Abantu bakaSirayeli bahamba-hamba ezweni; isiqithi siyabakhusela.
Ndiya kwenza iinwele zikaFaro zibe ziqinile, aze azilandele; ndiza kubonakalisa uzuko lwam kuFaro nomkhosi wakhe wonke; bayazi amaYiputa ukuba mna ndinguYehova. Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli njalo.

Kuthe kwathiwa ukumkani waseYiputa, ukuba abantu babaleka; ke uFaro namagqwetha akhe batshintshela intliziyo yabo kubo. Bathi, Yintoni esinokuyenza? Siye savumela abantwana bakaSirayeli ukuba bahambe, yaye ngoku abasoloko besenza umsebenzi kuthi.
Ke kaloku uFaro walungiselela iinqanawa zakhe zokulwa, wamthabatha umkhosi wakhe naye.
Wathabatha iinqanawa ezilishumi elinesixhenxe, izithuthi zakhe ezikhethiweyo, nazo zonke izithuthi zikaYiputa, nabaphathi babo bonke.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamnqula umphefumlo kaFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa; walandela abantu bakaSirayeli, abaphumayo ngezandla zabo.

Bathi ke abaYiputa bewalandela; zabafumana zonke iihashe zikaFaro, neemoto zakhe zokulwa, nabakhweli bakhe bezithuthi, nemikhosi yakhe; babethe cwaka elwandle phambi kwePi-Hahiroti, ngaphesheya kukaBhaali-tsefoni.
Ke kaloku, xa uFaro ethe wafika, abantu bakaSirayeli baphakamisa amehlo abo, babona ukuba abaYiputa behamba phantsi kwabo; bakhathazeka, bathandaza kuYehova.
Bathi kuMoses, Akukho zibingelelo eYiputa na, ukuba usikhuphele apha, ukuze sife kuloo ndawo ingqongileyo? Uthini na owenzayo kuthi, ukusikhupha eYiputa?
Asikuthethile ntoni na eYiputa, sisithi, Sishiyeke, sisebenze kumaYiputa? Kungcono kuthi ukuba sisebenze kumaYiputa, kunokuba sife kuloo mfula.
Wathi uMoses kubo, Musani ukuxoka; hlalani, nibone ukuba iNkosi uya kunisindisa namhlanje. AbaYiputa ababonayo namhlanje, ningababonanga nabo kwakhona.
UYehova uya kuhlasela ngenxa yenu; nihlale niphumle.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Yintoni na leyo oyitshoyo kum? Yazise oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba bahambe.
Nciphisa isithuthi sakho, uphakamise isandla sakho phezu kolwandle, udibanise amanzi, ukuze abantwana bakaSirayeli bahambe phakathi kolwandle ngeqhwa.
Ndiya kwenza ukuba iinwele zabaYiputa zibe ziqinile, bafike emva kwabo; ndiza kubonakalisa uzuko lwam kwiFaro, nemfazwe yakhe yonke, kwimikhosi yayo, namakhwenkwe ayo.
Bayazi ooYiputa ukuba mna ndinguYehova, xa ndithe ndabonakaliswa kuFaro, kumagqwetha akhe, nabakhweli bakhe.
Wasuka ke umbingeleli kaThixo, ohamba phambi kweqela lakwaSirayeli, waya ngaphambili, waya ngasemva kwabo; umbhobho wefuthe wasuka phambi kwabo, waya ecaleni labo.

Yafika phakathi komkhosi wamaYiputa nomkhosi wamaSirayeli. Ngobusuku bonke icloudi yayimnyama ngaphaya kwelinye icala, yakhanya ke ngaphaya kwelinye icala; akukho mntu wafika ngaphaya kwelinye icala ngobusuku bonke.
Wamisa ke uMoses isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle. UYehova wamthabatha ulwandle ngemoya enamandla yasempumalanga yonke loo busuku, wayenza ibe yindawo enkonkxiweyo; amanzi ahlukaniswa.
Baye ke oonyana bakaSirayeli behamba phakathi kolwandle ngendawo emnyama; kwakukho umgca wamanzi ngasekunene kwabo, nakwesobunxele kwabo.
Ke kaloku abaYiputa babewalandela, bewalandela phakathi kolwandle, zonke iihashe zikaFaro, nezithuthi zakhe, nabaqhubi bakhe.
Ke kaloku, phambi kokuvuka kwelanga, iNkosi wajonge kumkhosi wamaYiputa, esuka emlonyeni womlilo nefuthe, wabaphazamisa.
Wazikhupha izithuthi zazo zokulwa, ukuba zingahambanga ngokulula. Bathi ke abaYiputa, Siyaphuma phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; kuba iNkosi uhlasela amaYiputa ngenxa yabo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Unqumle isandla sakho phezu kolwandle, amanzi abuye abe ngaseYiputani, kumakhandlela abo, namakhweli abo.
Wamisa ke uMoses isandla sakhe phezu kolwandle; xa kuvuka isibhaka-bhaka, ilwandle labuyela endaweni yayo; abaYiputa bafuna ukubaleka ngaphambili kwalo; iNkosi wabasusa phakathi kolwandle.
Yabuya ke amanzi, yazigubungela izithuthi zokulwa, nabaqhubi beenqwelo-moya, lonke iqela likaFaro, eliya kulandela oonyana bakaSirayeli elwandle; akukho namnye wabo wahlala.
Ke kaloku oonyana bakaSirayeli bahamba phakathi kolwandle, behamba ngendawo emnyama; kwakukho umgca wamanzi ngasekunene kwabo, nakwesobunxele kwabo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wasindisa amaSirayeli ngaloo mini esandla samaYiputa. Babona amaSirayeli amaYiputa afile phezu kolwandle,
Bathe ke abantwana bakaSirayeli bebona isandla esikhulu sikaYehova, awayesisebenzisile kumaYiputa; banqwenela iNkosi; babethembela kuYehova noMoses umkhonzi wakhe.
Ke kaloku uMoses nabantwana bakaSirayeli bavuma lo mculo kuYehova, besithi, Ndiza kwenza umculo kuYehova; ngokuba wabhiyozela ngothando olukhulu; ibhokhwe nomqhubi wayo wabathutha elwandle.
UYehova ngumandla wam, ngumculo wam; umsindise mna. NguThixo wam yena, ndiya kumxelela intliziyo yam; nguThixo kayise wam, ndiya kumphakamisa phezulu.
UYehova ungumnqobi; iNkosi igama lakhe.
Iinqanawa zikaFaro, nemikhosi yakhe, wazisa elwandle; Abaphathi abakhethiweyo bakaFaro bafa elwandle olumnyama.
Iilwandle eziphakamileyo zazigubungela, Zazingcwaba phantsi njengelitye.
Isandla sakho esikunene, Nkosi, siqaqambileyo ngobukrelekrele; Isandla sakho esikunene, Nkosi, sisixhobisa umchasi.
Ngobuqaqawuli bakho obukhulu, wabeka phantsi abo bavukayo ngokuchasene nawe; Wathumela inkanuko yakho eshushu, yabatshisa njengamaqabunga amnyama.
Ngomoya womlomo wakho, amanzi anyuka; Amanzi aphumayo aphakama njengedonga; Amalwandle amaninzi aqinile phakathi kolwandle.
Wathi umkhosi, Ndiya kubaphulaphula, ndibafumane; ndiya kuhlula oko ndiwufumanayo kubo; ndiya kuthatha konke endiyifunayo; ndiya kukhupha ikrele lam, isandla sam siza kubabulala.
Ke wena waphefumla ngomoya wakho, ulwandle lwazigubungela; Zazingcwatshwa njengentsimbi emanzini amakhulu.
Nguwuphi phakathi kwamadini ofana nawe, Nkosi yam? Nguwuphi ofana nawe, oqaqambileyo ngokungcwele kwakhe, Omangalisa ngothando lwakhe, Owenza izinto ezimangalisayo.
Wakhupha isandla sakho esikunene, Umhlaba wawatshisa.
Ngobubele bakho uya kubakhokela abantu abawusindileyo; Ngobuchule bakho uya kubakhokela endlwini yakho engcwele.
Iintlanga ziya kuziva, zize zithambekele ngoxolo; Uxinzelelo luya kubakho kubantu bakaFilisti.
Baya kukhathazeka abaphathi baseEdom; baya kukhathaza amadoda anamandla aseMowabhi; bonke abantu bakaKanan baya kuphelelwa lukhulu.
Uxinzelelo noxinzelelo luya kuba phezu kwabo; ngenxa yobukrelekrele bomqolo wakho, baya kuhlala njengelitye, de badlule abantu bakho, Yehova, de bahambe abantu abathengiseyo.
Uza kubazisa, uza kubatyala emnqamlezweni wakho, kwindawo, Nkosi, oyilungiselele ukuba ibe yindlu yakho, indawo engcwele, Nkosi, eyakhiwa ngamehlo akho.
UYehova uya kuba ngukumkani ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku iziqhamo zikaFaro, nezithuthi zakhe, nabaqhubi bakhe, bafika elwandle; iNkosi wabuyisela amanzi elwandle phezu kwabo; ke oonyana bakaSirayeli bahamba phakathi kolwandle ngomhlaba omileyo.
Wathabatha ke uMiriyam umprofeti, udade ka-Aron, intonga esandla sakhe; bonke amadoda alandela ngawo, edlala intonga, edlalwa.
UMariyam wayalela kubo, esithi, Yibani kuYehova; ngokuba waphumelela ngothando olukhulu; umkhosi nomqhubi wakhe wamthabatha elwandle.
Ke kaloku, uMoses wathabatha amaSirayeli esuka emlanjeni oMthubi, bafika emasikweni aseShure; behamba iintsuku ezintathu esi siqithi, bangafumananga amanzi.
Bafika ke eMara, abakwazi ukusela amanzi ayo, ngokuba amabi; ngenxa yoko kwabizwa igama lendawo leyo ngokuthi iMara.
Bathi ke abantu ngoMoses, besithi, Sidla ntoni na?
Ke kaloku uMoses wayalela kuYehova; iNkosi wamxelela umthi omnye, wawubeka emanzini, amanzi aye ngamanzi amnandi. Wabanika khona iNkosi umthetho nomthetho, waza wabavavanya khona.

Wathi, Ukuba uza kuthobela ulizwi likaYehova uThixo wakho, uze wenze okulungileyo emehlweni akhe; ukuba uza kubeka ingqalelo kwimimiselo yakhe, uze uzigcine zonke izigqibo zakhe; andiza kukuthutha nanye yezigulana endizithuthileyo kumaYiputa; ngokuba mna ndinguYehova okuziphilisa.
Bafika ke eElim, apho kukho imilambo yamanzi elishumi elinambini, neentyatyambo zezityalo ezimashumi asixhenxe; bamisa khona itente ngaselwandle.
Ke kaloku ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli lisuka eElim, lafika emasikweni aseShini, aphakathi kweElim neSina; kwaba ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu wenyanga yesibini, emva kokuba bephuma eYiputa.
Ke kaloku ibandla liphela lalumka kuMoses noAron, ezweni elingaziwayo.

Bathi ke kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, UYehova wayesakuba usindisile kuthi eYiputa, apho sahlala khona ngasecaleni kweebhotile zomnquba, sidla khona isonka sethu; kodwa nisisikhuphile kulo mfula, ukuze niphule lo mkhosi wonke.

Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Khangelani, ndiza kunithutha isonka esiphuma emlilweni; abantu baya kuphuma ngemini nganye, babe nento eyaneleyo yosuku ngalunye; ndiya kubavavanya ngaloo ndlela, ukuba baya kuyilandela na imimiselo yam.
Ngomhla wesixhenxe balungiselele oko baya kuzisa; kuya kuba ngokuphindaphindiweyo kunoko bekulinganisa ngaloo mini.
Wathi ke uMoses noAron kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Namhlanje kusasa niyazi ukuba nguYehova owazikhuphileyo eYiputa.
Ngomso ke niza kubona uzuko lukaYehova, ngokuba wava iinyembezi zenu kuye; sithini na thina, ukuba nizingumnqamlezo kuthi?
Wathi ke uMoses, UYehova uya kuninika inyama ukuba niyidle kusasa, nesonka esigcweleyo emini; ngokuba wayeva iimbandezelo zenu kuye. Sithini na thina? Akukho sithuthuzelo senu kuthi, kodwa nguYehova.
Wathi ke uMoses kuAron, Uthi kuye wonke umkhosi wakwaSirayeli, Nxibelelani noYehova; ngokuba wayeva iinyembezi zenu.
Ke kaloku, xa uAron ethetha kulo lonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, bajonge kwelasemasikweni, bona, ubutyebi bukaYehova bukhanya kwifuthe.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Ndiziva iinyembezi zabantwana bakaSirayeli; thetha nabo, usithi, Ngexesha lokuphuma kwelanga niya kudla inyama, nangasemini niza kuthotywa ngesonka; niyazi ukuba ndinguYehova uThixo wenu.
Ke kaloku, ngobusuku, zafika iintaka-ntlaba, zigubungele isixeko; kwathi kusasa, kwabakho ungqimba lwesiqubuthelo esijikeleze isixeko.
Ke kaloku, xa imvula iphumayo, kwabonakala phezu komhlaba esiqwini izinto ezincinci, ezijikelezayo, zilula njengokuba kumanzi abandayo phezulu komhlaba.
Ke kaloku bakubona oonyana bakaSirayeli, bathi omnye kunye, Yintoni loo nto? Kuba abazange bazi ukuba yintoni. Wathi kubo uMoses, Yiyo intyatyambo oyinikayo iNkosi ukuba niyidle.

Yiyo loo nto iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngayo, esithi, Nceda niyithabathe intliziyo nganye ngokwento enokuyisebenzisa; niyithathe i-omeri nganye, ibe ziilitha ezilishumi elinambini, kuye wonke umntu ohlala endlwini yenu.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli bakwenza njalo; abanye baqoqa kakhulu, abanye beqoqa kancinci.
Ke kaloku, xa beyilinganisela, lowo wahlanganisayo okuninzi akabikho ongaphezulu, nolowo wahlanganisayo okuncincane akabikho ongaphantsi; wonke umntu wahlanganisa oko wayefuna.
Wathi ke uMoses kubo, Akukho namnye oza kushiya nantoni na kuyo ukuya kusasa.
Ke kaloku kwabakho abathile, abangamthobeli uMoses; bagcina ngaye ukuya emveni kwemini; yathi igcwele izidumbu, yaqala ukuba nephunga. UMoses waxoka kubo.
Ke kaloku, emini nganye, umntu ngamnye wathabatha oko wayefunayo; xa ke ilanga liqala ukushushuza, latywina.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla wesixhenxe, bathabathe okuphindwe kabini, ama-omeri amabini umntu ngamnye. Bafika oonyana bakaSirayeli, baxela uMoses.

Wathi kubo, Yiyo loo nto iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngayo, esithi, Namhlanje ngusuku lokuphumla, usuku lokuphumla olungcwele kuYehova. Ke ngoko, konke ofuna ukukomisa, komisa; konke ofuna ukukomisa, komisa; konke okuseleyo, gcinani kuye ngoLwesine.
Bayigcina ke kusasa, njengokuba uMoses wamwisela umthetho; ayibikho inkungu kuyo, ayikho iintsholongwane kuyo.
Wathi uMoses, Kulileni namhlanje; ngokuba namhlanje ngusuku lokuphumla kuYehova; namhlanje ningayifumana nanye phezu komhlaba.
Iintsuku ezintandathu niza kuyiqoqa; kodwa ngomhla wesixhenxe, uSabbath, akuyi kubakho.
Ke kaloku kwaphuma abanye abantu ngomhla wesixhenxe, ukuba bathabathe; abafumani nto.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Uza kuhlala ixesha elingakanani na ukuba ningazithobeli imiyalelo yam nemithetho yam?
Khumbulani ukuba iNkosi waninika isigqibo; ngoko ke, ngomhla wesixhenxe aninika isonka seentsuku ezimbini. Ngomhla wesixhenxe wonke umntu ahlale endlwini yakhe; akukho namnye oza kuphuma.
Ke kaloku abantu baphumla ngemini yesixhenxe.
Bathi oonyana bakaSirayeli igama lesonka, yiManna; ibe mhlophe njengokuba imbewu ye-koriandre; ibe nephunga elifana nokutya okuphekwe ngemvu.
Wathi uMoses, Le nto iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngayo: I-omeri ye-manna igcinwe mihla le, ukuze abantwana benu babone isonka endisinikele sona esiqwini, xa ndinikhupha eYiputa.
Wathi uMoses kuAron, Yithathe intonga, uyifake kuyo i-omeri epheleleyo ye-manna; uyibeke phambi koYehova, ukuze igcinwe mihla le.
Wayibeka uAron i-manna phambi kwebhokisi yomqondiso, ukuze igcinwe; njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho uMoses.
Badla oonyana bakaSirayeli i-manna iminyaka emashumi mane, de bafike kwilizwe elinabantu abahlala kulo; badla i-manna, de bafike kumda welizwe laseKanan.
I-omeri yinxalenye yeshumi leefa.
Ke kaloku ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli lisuka emasikweni aseSin, bahamba, njengoko iNkosi wamwiselayo; bamisa iintaba eRefidim; kwakungekho amanzi abantu abawaseleyo.
Bathi ke kubo uMoses, bathi, Sinike amanzi ukuba sisele. Waphendula uMoses wathi, Nithetha ntoni na nam? Niyivavanya njani iNkosi?
Bathi ke abantu, bethe bafuna amanzi khona apho, bamnqula uMoses; bathi, Uthini na ukuba usikhuphe eYiputa? Ngaba ukusibulala thina noonyana bethu nezinto zethu eziphilayo ngekhefu?
Watsho uMoses kuYehova, esithi, Ndiyenze ntoni na le ndoda? Bathe baya kumthutha ngeethayile.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya phambi kwabantu; chukua nawe abathile kwabakhulu bakaSirayeli; isandla sakho sokhuni osenza ngaso umlambo, usithathe esandla sakho, uye.
Yabona, ndiya kuhlala apha phambi kwakho, ecaleni kwelitye, eHorebhi; udibanise ilitye, amanzi azophuma kulo, abantu baphile. Wakwenza ke uMoses oko phambi kwamehlo eempawu zakwaSirayeli.
Wathi ke igama lendawo leyo nguMasha, noMeriba; ngenxa yenkohlakalo yabo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngenxa yokuba babemtyhila iNkosi, besithi, UYehova ungunye wethu na, okanye akawukho?
Bafika ke amaAmaleki, bahlasela abantu bakaSirayeli eRefidim.
Wathi uMoses kuYoshuwa, Khetha kuthi amadoda, uyeke ukuhlasela ama-Amaleki; namhlanje ndiya kuhlala phezulu komnqamlezo wenduli, isandla sikaThixo sisesandla sam.
Wakwenza ke uYoshuwa njengokuba wathi kuye uMoses, wahlasela ama-Amaleki. Ke kaloku uMoses noAron noHure banyuka beya phezulu komthi.
Xa uMoses ephakamisa izandla zakhe, abaSirayeli baphumelela; ke kaloku xa ekhupha izandla zakhe, amaAmaleki aphumelela.

Ke kaloku, xa izandla zikaMoses zithe zalahleka, bathabathe ityuwa, bayibeka phantsi kwakhe; wahlala phezu kwayo. UAron noHure babezixhasa izandla zakhe, omnye ngasemva, omnye ngasentla. Izandla zakhe ke zazikhuselekile, de kwaphuma ulanga.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wahlasela iqela lakwaAmaleki ngeqhwa.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ubhale loo nto kwincwadi, ibe yinkcazelo; uYoshuwa akwazi ukuyiva; kuba ndiza kuyicima ngokupheleleyo inkcazelo kaAmaleki phantsi kwelanga.
UMoses walungisa isibingelelo, wayibiza igama elithi, UYehova nguMqondiso wam.
Wathi, UYehova wenza isiprofeto; iNkosi uya kuba nemfazwe noAmaleki, kusuku nakwixesha.
Wathi ke uYetro, ukumkani waseMidiyani, umkakhe kaMoses, wafunda zonke izinto awazenzayo uThixo kuMoses, nakwaSirayeli abantu bakhe, ukuba iNkosi wawukhuphe amaSirayeli eYiputa.
Ke kaloku uMoses wabuyisela umyeni wakhe, uSepora; uYetro, uyise womkakhe, wamthabatha.
nonyana bakhe ababini; igama lomnye labizwa ngokuba nguGershoni; ngokuba uMoses wathi, Ndiye ndaba ngumkhenkce ezweni elingaphandle.
Ke kaloku elinye igama lakhe lalinguEliyezere; ngokuba wathi uMoses, UThixo kayise wam waba ngumncedisi wam, wandikhusela kwikrwada kaFaro.
Wafika ke uYetro, umkakhe kaMoses, kuMoses esiqwini, naye nomfazi kaMoses noonyana bakhe; ke kaloku uMoses wayesetyenzile emantla entaba kaThixo.
Wathumela ke uYetro umyalezo kuMoses, esithi, Ndiya kufika kuwe mna, uJethro, uyise womyeni wakho, namnye umfazi wakho nabantwana bakhe ababini.
Waphuma ke uMoses, wadibana nonyana wakhe-mntwana; wamnyamekela, wamxolela. Babuzana ngoxolo, bafika kwitentile.
UMoses wamxelela unyana wakhe-mntwana zonke izinto awazenzayo iNkosi kuFaro namaYiputa ngenxa kaSirayeli, nazo zonke iimvakalelo ezibi ababezifumana kwindlela, nokuba iNkosi wabasindise.
Ke kaloku uYetro wavuya kakhulu, xa efundile zonke izinto ezilungileyo iNkosi awazenzayo kumaSirayeli, ekusindiseni kwabo emaYiputa.
Wathi ke uYetro, Lola iNkosi, owabasindisela kumaYiputa noFaro; owabasindisela abantu phantsi kolawulo lwamaYiputa.
Namhlanje ndiyazi ukuba iNkosi mkhulu kunazo zonke izithixo, ngenxa yale nto ayenze kubo abo babhiyozelayo amaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku uYetro, umkakhe kaMoses, wanikela idini eliqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo kuThixo. Wafika ke uAron, namadoda amakhulu onke eSirayeli, ukuba asele nesonka nomkakhe kaMoses phambi koThixo.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla olandelayo, uMoses wahlala elungisa abantu; abantu ke babekhona phambi kwakhe ukususela emveni kwemini, kuze kube kusasa.

Wabona unyana wakhe-mntwana zonke izinto azenzayo uMoses kubo bonke abantu, wathi kuye, Yintoni le nto oyenzayo kuwe kubo bonke abantu? Kutheni na ukuba uhlale phantsi wena kuphela, ube ngumgwebi, ngelixa bonke abantu behlala phambi kwakho ukususela emveni kwemini kude kube mhla?
Waphendula ke uMoses wathi kuye, Kuba abantu bafika kum ukubuza uThixo.
Xa benengxaki, bafika kum; mna ke ndiya kugqiba phakathi komntu nomnye, ndibafundise imithetho nomthetho kaThixo."
Wathi kuye unyana womkakhe kaMoses, Into oyenzayo ayilungileyo.
Ke wena, nalaba bantu abathe bafika kuwe, niza kuphelelwa lixesha; kuba le nto inzima kakhulu kuwe; awukwazi ukuyilungisa ngokwakho.
Ke ngoko, ndimxelele, ndiya kukucebisa; yaye uThixo abe nawe; wena uya kuthetha ilizwi labantu phambi koThixo, uyenzile izigwebo zabo kuye.
Nizifundise imimiselo yakhe, nemimiselo yakhe, nizibonise indlela abafanele ukuba behamba ngayo, nemisebenzi yabo ekufuneka bayisebenzele.

Ke kaloku ukhethe phakathi kwabantu bonke amadoda anamandla, amadoda athandazayo kuThixo, athembekileyo, anobuxoki bokuthatha intlawulo; uwabeke phezu kwabo abantu, abe ngamawaka, abe ngamakhulu, abe ngamashumi amahlanu, abe ngamashumi.

Bathi bagweme iintlanganiso zabantu ngazo naziphi na iimeko, ukuze zifike kuwe iintlanganiso ezinzima; kodwa iintlanganiso ezilula bazigweme ngokwabo. Oku kwenza ukuba ubunzima bakho bube mncinci, kuba baya kudibana nawe.
Ukuba uyenze loo nto, yaye uThixo akuwisela umthetho ngaloo ndlela, uya kukwazi ukumelana nobunzima; nabo bonke abantu baya kuhlala bephumle.
Waphulaphula uMoses ingoma kayise, wenza zonke izinto awathi.
Wakhetha amadoda anamandla kuwo onke amaSirayeli, wawamisa abe ngamadoda amakhulu abantu, abe ngamawaka, abe ngamawaka, abe ngamashumi, abe namashumi.
Bezilungisa izigwebo zabantu mihla le; izigwebo ezinzima bazisa kuMoses, kodwa ezilula babezigqiba ngokwabo.
Ke kaloku uMoses wayalela unyana wakhe-mntwana ukuba ahambe; wabuyela uYetro ezweni lakhe.
Kwinyanga yesithathu, emva kokuba abantwana bakaSirayeli bephuma eYiputa, ngaloo mini bafika emlilweni waseSina.
Basuka eRefidim, bafika emhlabathini omnyama waseSina; amaSirayeli amisa khona itente emhlabathini omnyama, phambi komlambo.
