UMoses wanyuka waya kuThixo. Waza iNkosi wambiza emnqamlezweni, wathi, Yiloo nto uya kuthetha ngayo endlwini kaYakobi, uyixelele oonyana bakaSirayeli:
Nibona oko ndenzayo kumaYiputa, nokuba ndinithabatha njani phezu kwamaphiko omnquma, ndanizisa kum.
Ke ngoko, ukuba mna nindiphulaphule ngokunyanisekileyo, nigcine umnqophiso wam, niza kuba yintyatyambo yam phakathi kwazo zonke iintlanga; ihlabathi liphela lilungu lam.
Niya kuba ngukumkani wababingeleli kum, nibe lilizwe elingcwele kum. La mazwi uya kuwathetha oonyana bakaSirayeli;
Wabuyela ke uMoses, wababiza bonke abathetheli babantu; wathetha nabo onke la mazwi iNkosi awamwisele umthetho ngawo.
Baphendula ke bonke abantu ndawonye, besithi, Yonke into iNkosi athethayo siza kuyilungisa. Wabuya ke uMoses wayalela iNkosi iimpendulo zabantu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yabona, mna ndiya kuza kuwe ngefu elingenanto; ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuva xa ndithetha nawe, babe nokholo kuwe ngonaphakade. Wathi ke uMoses kuYehova amagama labantu.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya kubo abantu, ubangcwelele namhlanje nomhla; bahlamba iimpahla zabo;
Niyilungiselele imini yesithathu. Ngomhla lowo iNkosi uya kuhla phezu komnxweme waseSinayi, phambi kobuso bomntu wonke.
Uthi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Yenza isiphelo sabantu esijikeleze intaba, usithi kubo, Khumbulani ukuba ningayinyukanga intaba, nakuba nitshise isiqingatha sayo; wonke umntu otshisa intaba uya kufa.

Akukho namnye oza kumtshisa loo mntu; kufuneka aqhutywe ngamatye, okanye aqhutywe ngemiyalelo; nokuba ngumntu nakuba yinyama, kufuneka ingabi phila. Xa ibhokhwe yomvumi ithetha ngoxolo olude, ke ngoko baya kunyuka befike emlanjeni.
Wahla ke uMoses phantsi komnxweme, waya kubo abantu, wabalungisa; bahlamba iimpahla zabo.
Wathi ke kubo abantu, Nceda niyilungiselele imini yesithathu; musa ukudibana nebhinqa.

Ke kaloku ngobusuku bemini yesithathu, kwathi kusasa, kwabakho izithunywa zezulu, nezibhakabhaka, nefuthe eliqinileyo phezu kwentaba, kwathi ke ilizwi lebhokhwe likhulu kakhulu; bonke abasenyuvesi batshona.
Ke kaloku uMoses wayalela abantu ukuba baphume emkhosini, ukuze bahlangane noThixo; behlala phantsi komthi.
Intaba kaSina iqhutywa ngumphunga, ngokuba iNkosi waya phantsi kuyo emlilweni; umphunga wayo wanyuka njengenkungu yefriji; yonke intaba yatshisa kakhulu.
Ilizwi lebhokhwe lakhula likhula; uMoses wathetha, uThixo wamphendula ngelizwi elifana nethutyana.
Wahla iNkosi phezulu komnxweme lweSinayi, wabiza uMoses phezulu kumnqamlezo womnqamlezo; wanyuka ke uMoses.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya phantsi, uyixelele intliziyo yabantu, ukuba bangaphazamisi indlela yabo, babone iNkosi; kuba baya kufa abaninzi kubo.
Ke bona ababingeleli, abanelungelo lokuncama iNkosi, kufuneka bangcwele, ukuze iNkosi angawaphulaphuli.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Abantu bangayi kukhupha intaba iSinayini; ngokuba thina wena wasisilumkisa, uthi, Yenza umda phezu kwentaba, uyigcine ingcwele.
Wathi iNkosi kuye, Yiya phantsi, unyuse noAron nawe; ke bona ababingeleli nabasetyhini, bangabi nethuba lokunyuka baya kuYehova, ukuze athabathe isandla sakhe kubo.
Wahla ke uMoses kubo bonke abantu, wabaxelela.
Wathetha ke uThixo onke la mazwi, esithi,
Ndiye ndinguYehova uThixo wenu, owenza ukuba niphume ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze nibe ngabakhonzi.
Akubakho kuni amadini athile phambi kwam.
Musani ukwenza kuni imifanekiso engumqondiso, nantoni na efana nomfanekiso wezinto ezikwizulu ngasentla, nezikwihlabathi ngezantsi, nezisemanzini phantsi komhlaba.

Mna iNkosi, uThixo wakho, ndinguThixo ozinikeleyo, enqumlayo intlungu yabazali kubo abantwana, kuye kuhlobo oluthathu nolwesine labo abandichukumisayo; mna iNkosi, uThixo wakho, ndinguThixo onobubele.
Ke mna ndibonisa ububele kumakhulu eminyaka kubo abamthandayo, begcina imithetho yam.
Musa ukubiza igama likaYehova uThixo wakho ngento engafanelekanga; iNkosi akawushiyanga ungagwetywa lowo ubiza igama lakhe ngento engafanelekanga.
Khumbula imini yeSabbath, uyigcine ingcwele.
Iintsuku ezintandathu usebenze, wenze zonke izinto zakho;

ke loo mini yesixhenxe ngusuku lokuphumla kuYehova uThixo wakho; awuzukwenza ngalo nantoni na umsebenzi, wena, nonyana wakho, nonyanakazi wakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nomkhonzikazi wakho, nenyama yakho, nokuba ngumkhenkce onke ohlala endlwini yakho.

Kuba ngeentsuku ezintandathu iNkosi wenza izulu, nehlabathi, nolwandle, nazo zonke izinto eziziqulathileyo kuzo; waphumla ngomhla wesixhenxe. Ngenxa yoko iNkosi wabambisa usuku lwesibhozo, wayilungisa.
Khumbula uyise wakho noyise wakho, ukuze uhlale ixesha elide ezweni elinika lona iNkosi uThixo wakho.
Musa ukubulala.
Musa ukubhiyozela isini.
Musa ukurhoxa.
Musa ukuthetha ubuxoki malunga nomhlobo wakho esidlangalaleni

Musa ukunqwenela indlu yomhlobo wakho; musa ukunqwenela umfazi womhlobo wakho, okanye umkhonzi wakhe, okanye ibhinqa lakhe, okanye inkomo yakhe, okanye isilwanyana sakhe, nantoni na eyiyo yomhlobo wakho.
Ke kaloku, xa abantu beva izithunywa zezulu, nezwi lebhokhwe, nezibane, nentaba ifuthayo, baphoxeka kakhulu, bahlala kude.
Bathi ke kubo uMoses, Uthetha nathi wena, siza kuthandaza; kodwa athethe nathi uThixo, ukuze singafa.
Wathi uMoses kubo, Musani ukuxoka; kuba wafika uThixo ukuba anivavanye, ukuze kuhlale kukho ukukhathazeka kwakhe phambi kwenu, nize ningabi nesono.
Ke kaloku abantu bahlala kude; uMoses ke wafika kumnyama, apho wayekho uThixo.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Uthi loo nto kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Niboneni ukuba ndithetha nani ukusuka ezulu.
Musani ukwenza idini lesilivere, okanye idini legolide, ukuba likhonjwe nam.

Yenza kum isibingelelo sehlabathi, ubeke phezu kwayo izipho zakho eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezipho zakho zoxolo, iinkomo zakho, neentlanzi zakho; apho ndiza kuzisa khona igama lam, ndiya kungena kuwe, ndikubambisa.
Ukuba ungenza isibingelelo samatye kum, awuyi kwakha ngamatye aqingqiweyo; kuba ukuba uyisebenzise ngesixhobo sakho, uya kuyenza ingcwele.
Musa ukunyuka ngeenyawo ufike kwisibingelelo sam, ukuze iinwele zakho zingabonakali kuyo.
Lezo zimithetho oza kuzibeka phambi kwabantu:
Ukuba uthengise umkhonzi waseHebhere, uya kusebenza iminyaka esithandathu; kunyaka wesixhenxe aphume ekhululekileyo, engahlawuli nto.
Ukuba ke efika phantsi, kufuneka ahambe phantsi; ukuba wayenomyeni xa efika phantsi, kufuneka ahambe naye.
Ukuba inkosi yakhe yamnika umfazi, waza wazala oonyana okanye oonyanakazi, lo mfazi nabantwana bakhe baya kuba zizinto zenkosi yakhe; yena kuphela uya kuphuma.
Ke kaloku ukuba umkhonzi ethetha ngokucacileyo, esithi, Ndimthanda inkosi yam, nomfazi wam, nabantwana bam; andizukuphuma ndikhululekile:
inkosi yakhe iya kumthabatha kuye uThixo; iya kumthwala emnyango, okanye emngxunyeni wesango, ivule isisu sakhe ngesixhobo esithe nkqo, abe ngumkhonzi wakhe ubomi bakhe bonke.
Xa umntu ethengisa intombi yakhe ukuba ibe ngumkhonzi, akayi kuphuma ekhululekileyo njengokuba bephuma abakhonzi.
Ukuba ke akathandabuzeki kumnini wakhe, owamkhethele yena, uya kuyamthenga; akuyi kuba nelungelo lokumthengisa kwamanye amazwe, ngenxa yokuba waphula ilizwi lakhe kuye.
Ukuba ke eyamkhethela unyana wakhe, amele amphathe njengentombi.
Ke kaloku, ukuba ubhiyozele enye indoda, akayi kuthatha isonka sakhe, nempahla yakhe, namalungelo akhe omtshato.
Ke ukuba angazinika ezo zinto zithathu, uya kuphuma ekhululekileyo, engahlawuli mali.
Nabani na obetha umntu, wambulalayo, kufuneka aphele.
Ke kaloku, ukuba akazange acinge ngale nto, ke uThixo wayenza ikwenzeke, ngoko uya kubaleka waya kwindawo endiza kukukhethela yona.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umntu efuna ukumbulala umphefumlo wakhe ngenjongo, uyamkhuphe kuye nakwesona sibingelelo sam, umfaze.
Nabani na obetha utata wakhe, nokuba ngumama wakhe, kufuneka aphele.
Wonke umntu onqula omnye umntu kufuneka afunyanwe, nokuba uthengise loo mntu okanye akazange athenge.
Nabani na ophula utata wakhe, nokuba ngumama wakhe, kufuneka aphele.
Xa abantu ababini bedlala, omnye ebetha owonye ngelitye, okanye ngesandla sakhe; lo mfazi akafanga, kodwa uya kuhlala ebhedini.

Ke kaloku, ukuba emva koko evuka, ehamba ngaphandle ngesandla sakhe esihambayo, lowo wambethayo akagwetywa; ke yena kufuneka ahlawule ixesha lakhe elilahlekileyo, aze amkhathalele kuye, de abe philisiwe ngokupheleleyo.
Xa umntu ebetha umkhonzi wakhe, nokuba ngumkhonzi womntu okanye umkhonzi wesifazane, ngentambo, aze amfa khona apho, umele agwetywe.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umkhonzi evuka emva kwemini okanye iintsuku ezimbini, umnini wakhe akagwetywanga; ngokuba ngumkhonzi wakhe.

Ukuba ngaba amadoda adibana, abulala umfazi okhulelweyo, aze amzalise phambi kwexesha, kodwa akukho monakalo omkhulu; ke lowo wambulalayo kufuneka ahlawule oko umyeni wakhe afunayo, yaye abagwebi bavumela.
Ke kaloku, ukuba kukho intlungu ebuhlungu, kufuneka uthathe ubomi ngenxa yempilo;
iliso ngeliso, intamo ngentando, isandla ngesandla, inyawo ngenyawo,
umlilo ngomlilo, intlungu ngointlungu, umkhuhlane ngomkhuhlane.
Xa umntu ebetha iliso lomkhonzi wakhe, nokuba ngumkhonzi womntu okanye umkhonzi wesifazane, litshisa, uya kumvumela ukuba aphume ekhululekileyo, ukuze ahlawule intliziyo.
Ukuba umkhonzi wakhe, nokuba ngumkhonzi womntu okanye ngumkhonzi wesifazane, ephuca izinyo lakhe, kufuneka amkhuphe ahambe ngokukhululekileyo, ahlawule ixabiso lezinyo.

Ukuba inkunzi yenkomo ibulala umntu, nokuba ngumfazi na, ngeempawu zayo, inkunzi yebhokhwe iya kuqhutywa ngamatye, ibe yifile; inyama yayo ayidlalwanga; kodwa umnini wenkunzi yebhokhwe akayi kuba netyala.

Ke kaloku, ukuba inkunzi yebhokhwe ikhule ibe yindoda ehlasela abantu, yaye umnini wayo walumkisawa, kodwa akayikhuseli; ke ukuba ibulala indoda okanye umfazi, inkunzi yebhokhwe kufuneka igqunywe ngamatshe, nomnini wayo kufuneka aphele.
Ke ukuba umnini uvunyelwe ukuhlawula imali endaweni yoko, kufuneka ahlawule nantoni na efunekayo ukusindisa ubomi bakhe.
Umthetho ofanayo usebenza ukuba inkunzi ihlasele unyana okanye intombi.
Ukuba inkunzi yebhokhwe ihlasele umkhonzi, nokuba ngumfazi okanye unyana womtshakazi, yena uya kunikela kumphathi wakhe iishekeli zesilivere ezimashumi mathathu; inkunzi yebhokhwe iya kutshiswa.
Xa umntu evula ibhotwe, okanye exhaphaza ibhotwe, angalikhuseli, ibe inkunzi yenkomo okanye isilwanyana sasekhaya siwela kulo.
Umnini wesiqithi kufuneka ahlawule ilahleko; kufuneka ahlawule umnini wayo, ibe le nto ifileyo iya kuba yakhe.
Ukuba inkunzi yenkomo yomntu ibetha inkunzi yenkomo yomnye umntu, ibe yifa, baya kuthengisa inkunzi yebhokhwe ephilayo, baza bahlula-hlula imali yayo; nenyama yenyama baya kuyihlukanisa.

Ke kaloku, ukuba bonke abantu bayazi ukuba inkunzi yebhokhwe ihlala ihlasela, yaye umnini wayo akayikhuseli, yena umele ahlawule; inkunzi ephilayo ibe yindawo yomfileyo, nomfileyo ke ube ngumyeni wakhe.
Xa umntu etshisa inkunzi yenkomo, okanye ingulube, ayiyibulala, okanye ayithengise, uya kuyibuyiselwa inkunzi yebhokhwe emihlanu, okanye ingulube ezine.
Ukuba umxowa-mali ufunyenwe ephucula indlu ngobusuku kwaye wahlaselwa waza wafa, umntu obulalayo akabi netyala lokubulala.

Ke ukuba kwenzeke emva kokuphuma kwelanga, lowo wambulalayo uya kuba ngumfazi; umkhweli kufuneka abuyisele into awayeyithweleyo; ukuba akanayo nto, kufuneka athengiswe abe ngumkhonzi, ukuze ahlawule ixabiso lento ayeyithwele.
Ukuba lifunyanwa nalo eliphilayo, nokuba yinkunzi yenkomo, okanye ibe yidoda, okanye ibe yimvu, kufuneka abuyisele isibini.

Xa umntu eshiya iinkomo zakhe zidlale emthini, okanye kwigadi yewayini, aze azikhuphe zidlale emthini womnye umntu, kufuneka abuyisele ukulimala kwakhe ngezinto ezilungileyo zomthi wakhe, nokuba yigadi yakhe yewayini.
Ukuba umlilo uphuma, usasazeka phakathi kweentyatyambo ezityebileyo, ukuze utshise iziqhoboshi zengqolowa, okanye ingqolowa ethe tyaba, okanye isiqhamo sonke, lowo wamisa umlilo kufuneka ahlawule.
Xa umntu enika umhlobo wakhe imali, okanye iimpahla, ukuba azikhusele, zithi zithunyelwe endlwini yomhlobo wakhe; ukuba ufunyenwe lo mntu, kufuneka abuyisele ngokuphindwe kabini.
Ke kaloku, ukuba umthixo akafunyanwanga, unikazi wendlu uya kungena phambi kukaThixo, ukuze abone ukuba angawuthatha na umsebenzi womhlobo wakhe.

Kuzo zonke iinkundla zezinto eziphilayo, nokuba yibhokhwe, nokuba yidoda, nokuba yimvu, nokuba yimpahla ethe tyaba, nantoni na elahlekile, xa umntu esithi, Le nto yinyani yam; abo babini baya kuzisa icala labo phambi koThixo. Lo mntu uThixo abemxelela ukuba unetyala, kufuneka abuyisele enye into kabini.

Xa umntu enika umhlobo wakhe ibhokhwe, okanye inkunzi yenkomo, okanye inkomo, okanye nasiphi na isilwanyana, ukuba siyikhathalele, ibe yafa, okanye yalahleka, okanye yathathwa, ngaphandle kokubona komnye;
ke yena umhlobo wakhe kufuneka aphindwe phambi koYehova, ukuba akayithatheli into yenkosi yakhe. Umnini-ndlu uya kuthatha loo nto; akudingeki ukuhlawula.
Kodwa ukuba ikati ilahliwe kumhlobo wayo, kufuneka ahlawule umnini wayo.
Ukuba iqhutywe ziintaka, kufuneka athabathe izibophelelo zazo njengobungqina. Akudingeki ukuba ahlawule oko kuqhutywa ngazo.
Ukuba umntu uthatha inyama yomhlobo wakhe ngetyala, ibe ilahlekile okanye ifile xa umnini wayo engakhoyo, kufuneka ahlawule.
Kodwa ukuba umnini wayekhona, umntu othatha inxaxheba akudingeki ahlawule. Ukuba isilwanyana saqeshwa, imali ehlawulwe yokuqeshwa igubungela ulahleko.
Ke kaloku, xa umntu ethetha nomnye umfazi omncinci, ukuba atshate naye, yaye yena ungumkakhe, akabikho mntu wamnika isibonda somtshato, kufuneka amnike ixabiso lomtshakazi, atshate naye.
Ukuba ke ubaba wakhe akazange amvumele ukuba atshate naye, uya kuhlawulisa ixabiso elipheleleyo lomtshakazi, elinikezelwa ngumkakhe.
Musa ukumvumela ukuba aphile umfazi owenza izilingo.
Wonke umntu onesondo nenyama yenyama kufuneka abulawa.
Wonke umntu onikela ngeempawu kuye nawuphi na uThixo, ngaphandle kukaYehova, kufuneka aphelelwe.
Musa ukuxhaphaza umkhenkce, ungamcaphukisi; ngokuba nibe ngabakhenkce eYiputa.
Musa ukuxhaphaza umfazi, okanye unyana omncinci.
Ukuba ke usenza njalo, ukuba bathandaza kum, mna ndiya kuva ngokuqinisekileyo intloko yabo.
Inkanuko yam iya kuqhuma, ndiya kunibulala ngekhephu; abafazi benu baya kuba ngabafazi, oonyana benu baya kuba ngabantwana.
Ukuba udlulisa imali kumntu wam, ukuba ungumhlwempu, awuyi kwenza njengomsebenzi worhwebo; awuyi kuhlawulisa inzala.
Ukuba uthabathe iingubo zomhlobo wakho, ukuze akubuyisele, uya kuzibuyisela kuye phambi kokuba ilanga liphume;
Ngokuba iingubo zakhe ziyindawo ekuphela kwayo yokugquma umzimba wakhe; ungayilala ntoni na enye? Xa enxibelelana nam, ndiya kuziva, ngokuba mna ndenzakele.
Musa ukuthetha ngokubi kuThixo, Musa nokumxolela umphathi welizwe lakho.
Musa ukuthintela izipho zakho zeentyatyambo zakho, newayini yakho, neoli yakho; uya kundinika umzali-ntsapho wabo oonyana bakho.
Uya kwenza njalo neenkomo zakho, nezimvu zakho; zihlale iintsuku ezisixhenxe neentliziyo zabo; ngomhla wesibhozo uzinike.
Niya kuba ngabantu bam abangcwele; ke ngoko, musa ukutya inyama yezinto ezifileyo engqondweni yomthi; uyithule kumakati.
Musa ukusasaza iimfihlelo ezikhohlakeleyo. Musa ukuncedisa umntu onetyala ngokuthetha ubuxoki esidlangalaleni.
Musa ukuthobela umkhosi, ukuba wenze into engalunganga; Xa uthetha esidlangalaleni, musa ukuthobela umkhosi, ukuze uguqule inyaniso.
Musa ke ukukhetha ityala lomhlwempu, ngenxa yokuba ungumhlwempu.
Ukuba ubona inkomo yomqobo wakho, okanye isilwanyana sakhe, sihamba, qiniseka ukuba uyibuyisela kuye.
Ukuba ubona i-esile yomntu ofuna ukukuxolela, ilala phantsi komthwalo wayo, musa ukuyishiya; uqiniseke ukuba uya kumnceda.
Musa ukuxolela abantu abahlwempu ubulungisa kwiimfazwe zabo.
Musani ukutshabalalisa umntu ongenatyala, othembekileyo; kuba ndiya kwenza ukuba angabikho mntu onetyala. Ndiya kuzisa iinyembezi ezintle,
Musa ukuthabatha umvuzo; ngokuba umvuzo uncamathelisa abo bebonayo, uguqula amagama abantu abalungileyo.
Musa ukuxhaphaza umkhenkce; ngokuba niyazi ukuba yintoni ukuba ngumkhenkce, ngokuba nibe ngabakhenkce eYiputa.
Kwiminyaka emithandathu uya kulima izityalo zakho, uthabathe imbewu yazo.

Ke kaloku ngomnyaka wesixhenxe, ushiye ilizwe liphumle, ungayikhulanga; ukuze abafazi babantu bakho babe nesonka kuso, yaye izinto eziphilayo zasendle zidle okuseleyo kwazo. Ngokufanayo wenze nezityalo zakho zewayini, nezityalo zakho zeoli.
Ngeentsuku ezintandathu uza kwenza umsebenzi wakho; ngemini yesixhenxe uya kuphumla, ukuze iinkomo zakho, neesile zakho ziphumle, ukuba umkhonzi wakho, nomkhenkce ohlala phakathi kwakho, aphumle.
Zonke izinto endithiyo kuni, nizigcineni nizenza. Musani ukubiza amagama eempawu zabanye abantu; amanye amagama abo angabikho emlonyeni wakho.
Iintsuku ezithathu ngonyaka uya kwenza idini kum.

Yenza isikhumbuzo seentlanzi ezingaxutywanga; iintsuku ezisixhenxehotyoshwayo uzidle intlanzi engaxutywanga, njengokuba ndikumwisela umthetho ngayo, kwixesha elimiselweyo lenyanga ka-Abhibhi; ngokuba ngaloo inyanga waphuma eYiputa; akukho namnye oza kumbona entliziyweni yam enesandla esingenanto.
Uza kwenza iholide yeentyatyambo zokuqala, zezinto oza kuzityala ezweni lakho; uza kwenza iholide yokuqokelela, ekupheleni konyaka, xa uthabathe izityalo zakho eziphuma ezweni.
Iintsuku ezithathu ngonyaka bafike bonke amadoda akho phambi kweNkosi uThixo.
Musa ukunikela igazi lomnqophiso wam kunye nento eyenziwe ngesonka; ubisi lwemibhiyozo yam musa ukulishiya lifike kusasa.
Izinto ezilungileyo zokuqala zembewu yelizwe lakho uza kuzizisa endlwini kaYehova uThixo wakho; awuyi kupheka inkunzi yenkomo emlilweni womntwana wayo.
Yabona, mna ndithumela isithunywa phambi kwakho, ukuba akukhusele endlelani, nawe ufike kwindawo endiyilungiselelayo.
Nceda uqaphele kuye, udibanise nelizwi lakhe; musa ukunyamezela kuye; akuyi kuzonwabisa ukunyanzeleka kwenu, ngokuba igama lam lingaphakathi kwakhe.
Ukuba ke uya kuphulaphula ngokucothayo ilizwi lakhe, uyenze yonke into endiyithethayo kuwe, ndiya kuba ngummelwane weempembelelo zakho, ndiya kulwa nalabo abakuhlasela.
Kuba isithunywa sam siya kuhamba phambi kwakho, siza kukungenisa ezweni lama-Amori, namaHeti, namaPerizi, namaKanana, namaHivi, namaYebhusi; ndiya kubacima.
Musa ukudubula amadini abo, ungawakhonzanga, ungahamba ngeendlela zabo; kufuneka niphule amadini abo ngokugqithiseleyo, nitshise iinkunzi zebhokhwe zabo.
Musani ukukhonza iNkosi uThixo wenu; yena uya kubhaptiza isonka sakho namanzi akho; ndiya kususa izifo phakathi kwenu.
Akuyi kubakho umfazi ezweni lakho oza kuphelelwa ngumntwana, okanye angazali; ndiya kukunika imihla emininzi.
Ndiya kuthumela uxinzelelo lwam phambi kwakho, ndiza kwenza ukuba zicaphuke zonke iintlanga ozifumanayo; ndiza kuzibuyisela izithunywa zakho zonke zihambe.
Ndiya kuzithumela iintaka-ntlaba phambi kwakho, zikhuphe amaHivi, namaKanana, namaHeti, ecaleni lakho.
Andiya kubakhupha kulo nyaka omnye; ukuba ndibakhuphe, ilizwe liza kuhlala lingasebenzi, iintlanzi eziphilayo zehlabathi ziya kuninzi kuwe.
Ndiya kubakhupha, ndibakhuphe ngento nganye, de nikhule, niyithathe ilizwe libe likhaya.

Ndiya kumisela umda wakho ukusuka elwandle oluMnyama, ukuya elwandle lwabaFilisti; ndiya kwenza ukuba umda wakho uhambe ukususela emlanjeni ukuya kumlambo iEfrayim. Ndiya kukunikela phambi kwakho abantu abahlali kweli lizwe; uya kubathutha phambi kwakho.
Musani ukwenza nasiphi na isigwebo nabo, namadini abo.
Musani kuhlala ezweni lenu, ukuze bangakubangela ukuba uthini na isono kum; ukuba nikhonza amadini abo, kuya kuba ngumbutho kuwe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya phezulu kuYehova, wena noAron, noNadab noAbhiu, namashumi asixhenxe eentloko zakwaSirayeli; nizithobe kude.
Ke kaloku uMoses kuphela omele afike kuYehova; abanye ke bangafikanga, abantu ke banganyuka naye.
Wafika ke uMoses, wabaxelela abantu onke amagama kaYehova, nemimiselo yakhe. Baphendula bonke ngelizwi elinye, besithi, Zonke izinto awathiyo iNkosi siza kuzilungisa.
Wabhala ke uMoses amazwi onke kaYehova; wavukalayishe ekuseni, wakha isibingelelo phantsi komnqamlezo wenduli, namagqabi alishumi elinambini, ngokwezizwe ezilishumi elinambini zakwaSirayeli.
Wathumela ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, banikela ngeempawu eziqhutywa ngamanzi, banikela ngeenkomo ezincinane njengezipho zoxolo kuYehova.
Wathabatha ke uMoses inxenye yegazi, wayibeka emabhotileni; inxenye enye yaleyo gazi wayithambisa phezu kwesibingelelo.
Wathabatha ke uYosefu incwadi yomnqophiso, wayifunda phambi kwamehlo abantu. Bathi, Zonke izinto athethayo iNkosi siza kuzilungisa; siyazithobela.
Wathabatha ke uMoses igazi, watshisa abantu ngalo; wathi, Yaye le yigazi lomnqophiso owenzayo iNkosi nani ngazo zonke ezi zinto.
Wanyuka ke uMoses noAron, noNadab noAbhiu, nabakhulu bakaSirayeli abamashumi asixhenxe.
Babona ke uThixo wakwaSirayeli; kwakukho phantsi kweenyawo zakhe into efana nophahla lweekhabhathi zesaphire, ecacileyo njengezulu.
Ke kaloku uThixo akawukhuphi umlomo wakhe phezu kwalaba bathetheli bakaSirayeli; babembona uThixo, badla basela.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya kum phezulu entliziyweni, ube khona apha; ndiza kukunika iitoti zelitye, nemithetho, nemimiselo endibhalela yona, ukuze ubafundise.
Waphuma ke uMoses, noYoshuwa umkhonzi wakhe; wanyuka uMoses phezu komnxweme kaThixo.
Wathi kubo abathetheli, Nceda nilinde nathi apha, de siphinde sibuye kuni; bona uAron noHure nabo bakhona nani. Wonke umntu onengxaki, afike kubo.
Ke kaloku uMoses waya phezulu entlango, ifuthe liyifihla.
Uzuko lukaYehova lwalala phezu kwentaba kaSina; icloudi yayigubungela intaba iintsuku ezintandathu. Ngomhla wesixhenxe wabiza iNkosi uMoses ekungeneni kwecloudi.
Uzuko lukaYehova lwabonakala kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, njengokuba lufana nomlilo oqhumayo phezulu komnqamlezo wentaba.
Ke kaloku uMoses wafika phakathi kwefuthe, waza wenyuka phezu komnxweme; waba phantsi komnxweme iintsuku ezimashumi mane neentsuku ezine.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yathi ke uNdikhoyo kuMoses, Utsho oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba bandise kum isonka; uthathe isonka sam kulowo nalowo intliziyo yakhe ifuna ukunikela.
La madini niwathathe kubo: igolide, nesilivere, nobhedu;
intambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, neyombala ongwevu nomthubi; impahla emfutshane yelinen; inwele yenkomo;
iinwele zebhokhwe ezibomvu; isikhumba esihle; imithi ye-acacia;
ioli yeolivini, esetyenziswa kwizibane; iziqhamo, ezisetyenziselwa ioli yokupheka, nefuthe elimnandi;
namatye e-onyx, nezinye iimpahla ezigqityiweyo, ukuze zifakwe kwi-ephod, nesigqubuthelo sobuso sombingeleli omkhulu.
Bayenze ke indawo engcwele kum, ukuze ndihlale phakathi kwabo.
Yenza le tabernakele ingcwele, nezixhobo zayo zonke, ngokwemizobo yam ndiya kukuxelela yona.

Bayenze ibhokisi, isithunywa seNkosi, eyenziwe ngomthi we-acacia; ubude bayo bube ngamasentimitha angamashumi asixhenxe, ububanzi babo bube ngamasentimitha angamashumi asixhenxe, ubude babo bube ngamasentimitha angamakhulu asixhenxe.
Yayigubungela ngegolide ecacileyo, ngaphakathi nangaphandle; wayibeka umda wegolide phezu kwayo.
Yenza iinkunzi zeenkomo ezine zegolide, uzibeke kwiinyawo zayo ezintandathu; zibe ziinkunzi zeenkomo ezimbini kwelinye icala, zibe ziinkunzi zeenkomo ezimbini kwelinye.
Yenza iintonga zokhuni lwe-acacia, uzigubungele ngegolide.
Uza kuzibeka iinkunzi zeenkomo kwiiringi ezisecaleni zesithunywa, ukuze ziyithwale.
Iinqanawa kufuneka zihlale kwiiringi zesithuthi; azikwazi ukususwa ngaphandle.
Uza kuzibeka ngaphakathi kwetafile iitoti zomnqophiso, endiza kukunika zona.
Yenza isikhuseli sethutyana, igolide ecocekileyo; ibe yindawo yoxolo; ubude bayo bube ngamacwecwe amabini, ububanzi bawo bube ngamacwecwe asixhenxe.
Yenza iikerubi ezimbini, yenziwe ngentsimbi engenasici, zibe ziziphelo zombini zesakhelo.
Yenza ikekerubi enye kwisiphelo esinye, nekekerubi enye kwisiphelo esisekunene; zenza ikekerubi kunye nesakhelo zibe ngasinye.
Iikherubi ziya kuba neentyatyambo zazo zivulekile phezulu, zigubungele isipho ngeentyatyambo zazo; ziza kuthelekiswa ngazo, zijonge ezantsi kwisipho.
Uyasibeka isikhuselo phezulu kwetafile, uzibeke ngaphakathi kwetafile iitoti zomnqophiso, endiza kukunika zona.
Ndiya kudibana nawe khona apho, ngasentla komgquba ophakathi kweekerebhoni ezimbini ezikwintloko yesiqwenga somnqophiso; ndiza kukuxelela khona zonke izithethe zam kubaSirayeli.

Yenza itafile yokhuni lwe-acacia; ubude bayo bube ngamasentimitha angamashumi asixhenxe, ububanzi bayo bube ngamasentimitha angamashumi amane anesihlanu, ubude bayo bube ngamasentimitha anamakhulu asixhenxe.
Yayigubungela ngegolide ecacileyo, yayenza umda wegolide phezu kwayo.
Yenza umngxunya ojikeleze kuyo, ububanzi bakhe bufana nesandla; ubeke umgca wegolide kumngxunya.
Yenza iziqingatha ezine zegolide kule tafile, uzibeke kwiikona zayo ezintandathu, apho zibekwe khona iintloko zalo.
Iiringi kufuneka zibe kufutshane nomngxunya, ukubamba iintonga ezisetyenziswa ukuthwala itafile.
Yenza iintonga zokhuni lwe-acacia, uzixhoboze ngegolide; ibe ithebhu iya kuthwalwa ngazo.
Yenza izitya zayo, neziqulatho zayo, neebhotile zayo, neengxowa zayo, zibe zegolide ecocekileyo; zisetyenziselwe ukunikela ngazo isonka.
Soloko ugcina isonka esikhethekileyo kwitafile phambi kwam.
Yenza isibambi selanga segolide ecocekileyo; uyenze ngentsimbi engenasici, isiseko sayo nesiqhamo sayo; iziqulatho zaso zeentyatyambo, neziqhamo zazo, neentyatyambo zazo zonke zibe ngasinye.
Iziqhamo ezisithandathu ziya kuphuma emacaleni alo, iziqhamo ezintathu kwelinye icala, neziqhamo ezintathu kwelinye icala.
Zonke iziqhamo ezisixhenxe kufuneka zibe neentyatyambo ezintathu, ezinjengeentyatyambo ze-almond, ezineziqhamo nezityalo.
Kuwo ke umnqamlezo kufuneka kubekho iziqhoboshi ezine, ezifana neentyatyambo ze-almond, neziqhamo zazo nezityalo.

Intyatyambo enye ibe phantsi kweentyatyambo zokuqala, intyatyambo yesibini ibe phantsi kweentyatyambo zesibini, nentyatyambo yesithathu ibe ngaphantsi kweentyatyambo zesithathu; zonke iintyatyambo ezisibhozo zibe ziphuma kwisibambo selanga.
Zonke iziqhamo zazo, neentyatyambo zazo, zimele zibe nganye inxalenye yayo; yenziwe ngentsimbi engenasici.
Yenza izibane zayo ezisixhenxe, uzibeke phezu kwayo, ukuze zikhanyeze indawo engaphambili kwayo.
Iziqhoboshi zayo, nezitya zazo, kufuneka zisilwe ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Iikhilogram ezilishumi elinambini zegolide ecacileyo uza kuzisebenzisa ukwenza isibambo selanga, nezixhobo zalo zonke.
Yabona, uyenze ngokuchanekileyo, njengokuba kuboniswe kuwe emnqamlezweni.

Yenza itentile engcwele, yenza iziteyibhile ezilishumi, zelinen esonakalisiweyo, nelinen eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nelinen eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nelinen emthubi; umzobi owaziyo ubugcisa azigqume kuzo iikerubi.
I-cortina nganye kufuneka ibe nobungakanani obufanayo, malunga neemitha ezilishumi elinambini nesibhozo ubude nangaphezulu kweemitha ezimbini ububanzi.
Uza kuzidibanisa iziteyibhile ezilishumi elinambini nganye nenye; uzoba njalo nakwizinto ezilishumi elinambini.
Yenza iziqhoboshi zezinto eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka emngxunyeni wesitayile esiphelweni sothungelwano lokuqala; wenze njalo nakwisitayile esiphelweni sothungelwano lwesibini.
Uya kwenza iziqhoboshi ezimashumi mahlanu kwithayile enye, neziqhoboshi ezilishumi elinambini ekugqibeleni kwethayile yesibini enxityiweyo; iziqhoboshi zimele zijongene nganye nenye.
Yenza iziqhoboshi zegolide ezimashumi mahlanu, uzisebenzisele ukudibanisa amathenda amabini adityaniswe ngazo, ukuze itente engcwele ibe yenye.
Yenza iintyatyambo zolusu lweenkomo, zenza itente phezu kwetenki engcwele; yenza iintyatyambo ezilishumi elinanye.
Zonke ii-curtains ezilishumi elinanye kufuneka zibe nobungakanani obufanayo, malunga neemitha ezilishumi elinesithathu nesibhozo ubude nangaphezulu kweemitha ezimbini ububanzi.
Uza kuzidibanisa iziteyibhile ezintandathu nganye ngenye, nezinye ezisixhenxe nganye ngenye; uzoba isiteyibhile esisixhenxe ngokuphindwe kabini phambi kwetenki.

Yenza iziqhoboshi ezilishumi elinambini kumngxunya wesiqhoboshi esiphelweni sothungelwano olunye, uyenze iziqhoboshi eziyishumi elinesihlanu kumngxunya wesiqhoboshi esiphelweni sothungelwano lwesibini.
Yenza iziqhoboshi zentsimbi ezimashumi mahlanu, uzifake kwiziqhoboshi, ukuze zidityaniswe itente nganye nenye, ibe yinto enye.
Intyatyambo encinane engaphezulu, eyonakalisayo, iya kuqhutywa phantsi ngasemva kwetenki engcwele.
Iindonga zetentile ziya kuba ziyimitha enye ubude ngasecaleni ngalinye; ezo zinto ezishiyekileyo ziza kuphumla phezu kweendawo zangaphandle zetentile engcwele, ukuze ziyigubungele.
Yenza isiqulatho setentile, isikhumba somntu omnyama esibomvu; yenza isiqulatho sesikhumba esingwevu phezu kwalo.
Yenza iithayile ezithe nkqo zokhuni lwesitayile se-acacia, ukuba ziyindlu engcwele.
Isakhelo ngasinye kufuneka sibe malunga neemitha ezine ezili-12 ubude kunye nesixhenxe sesentimitha ububanzi.
Intonga nganye kufuneka ibe neengcango ezimbini, ukuze zidityaniswe ngazo. Uyenze njalo zonke iintonga zetentile engcwele.
Yenza iithayile ezimashumi mabini kwicala lasempumalanga lendawo engcwele.
Yenza iziseko zesilivere ezimashumi mane phantsi kweebhodi ezilishumi elinambini; iziseko ezimbini phantsi kwebhodi nganye, isiseko ngasinye ngaphantsi komthi.
Kwelinye icala, elikwicala lasempuma lendlu engcwele, wenze iithayile ezimashumi mabini.
neziseko zesilivere ezimashumi mane, zibini phantsi komthi ngamnye.
Yenza iithayile ezintandathu ngaphambili kwetenki engcwele, ngasekhohlo.
Uya kwenza iithayile ezibini, zibe ziikona zendawo engcwele ngasemva.
Kuzo iikona ezibini iithayile kufuneka zibe ziphindwe kabini ukusuka ezantsi yonke indlela ukuya phezulu, zigcinwe ngumsesane omnye. Yenza iikona zombini zinjalo.
Ke ngoko, zibe ziibhodi ezisibhozo, neziseko zesilivere ezilishumi elinambini; zibe zibini phantsi kwebhodi nganye.
Yenza iziqhoboshi zokhuni lwesitayile se-acacia; zibe zilishumi elinambini iintonga ezikwicala elinye lendlu engcwele,
ezilishumi elinambini zezinto zodonga ecaleni elinye, nezilishumi elinambini zezinto zodonga ecaleni lasentshonalanga.
I-crossbar esembindini kufuneka ihambe yonke indlela ukusuka kwisiphelo esinye ukuya kwelinye, phezulu kwintloko yeframes.
Yazigubungela iikhabhathi ngegolide, uyenze iziqhoboshi zegolide ukuze zibekwe kuzo iintonga; uzigubungele iintambo ngegolide.
Uyibeke itentile engcwele, njengokuba kubonisiwe kuwe entlango.
Yenza ifenitshala yesitayile esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nesibomvu, nesingwevu, nelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba; umenzi owaziyo enze amaKerubhi.
Yazitshixise ngeekhonkrithi zegolide, kwiintonga ezine zokhuni lwe-acacia, ezigqunywe golide; ibekwe phezu kweesiseko ezine zesilivere.
Uyibeke imingxunya yodonga kumakhonkco, uyibeke intonga yomnqophiso ngasemva kwemingxunya yodonga; imingxunya yodonga iya kuhlula indawo engcwele nendawo engcwele kakhulu.
Uyasibeka isikhuselo, isakhelo sokumkani, phezu kwetyuwa yomnqophiso, kwindawo engcwele kakhulu.
Wabeka itafile ngaphaya kwetayile, ecaleni lasentshonalanga lendawo engcwele; wabeka isibambo selanga esijongene netafile, ecaleni lasempumalanga.
Uya kwenza umgca womngxunya wetentile, owenziwe ngezinto eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nezibomvu, nezingwevu, nelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba, ukwenziwa ngumzobi.
Yenza izikhonkwane zegolide kulo mgqomo; yenza imiqadi emihlanu yentsimbi engenasici, uyigubungele igolide; yenza iziseko zazo ezilishumi elinambini zentsimbi.
Yakha isibingelelo semithi ye-acacia; ibe yindawo ethe nkqo, ubude bayo bube ngamacwecwe amabini, ububanzi bawo bube ngamacwecwe amabini, ubude bayo bube ngamacwecwe amane.
Uya kwenza iinkunzi zeenkomo ezikwikona zayo ezine, ukuze zibe ngasinye isibingelelo; uya kuyigubungela ngesinyithi.
Yenza zonke izinto zayo zibe zentsimbi, izitya zayo zokususa inkungu yayo, nezitshizi zayo, neziqulatho zayo, neengxowa-nyama zayo, neebhotile zomlilo.
Yenza kuyo umgquba, intambo yentsimbi; yenza iziqhoboshi zentsimbi kwikona nganye yeentonga ezine zocingo.
Yabeka umgquba phantsi komngxunya wesibingelelo, ukuze ufike kwisiqingatha sesibingelelo.
Yenza izikhonkwane zesibingelelo, zenza umthi we-acacia, uzigubungele ngentsimbi.
Uza kuzibeka iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisiqingatha, ukuze zibe ngasemva kwesibingelelo ngasekunene nakwesobunxele, xa sithabatha.
Yenza isibingelelo esingenalutho, sebhodi; njengokuba kuboniswe kuwe entlango, njalo yenza.
Uya kwenza inkundla yetentile engcwele; ubude becala lasempumalanga bube ziimitha ezimashumi mane anesihlanu, ibe yimiqadi yelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba.
Iindonga zayo zibe zimashumi mabini, neziseko zazo zibe zimashumi mabini zentsimbi; izikhonkwane zazo zibe zinesilivere, nezigqubuthelo zabo.

Icala lasempuma liyimitha ezimashumi mane anesihlanu ubude, ibe ziindonga zayo, nezikhonkwane zayo ezilishumi elinambini, neziseko zayo zentsimbi eziyishumi elinesibini; zibe neengxowa zesilivere, nezibophelelo zezikhonkwane.
Isiphelo sasentshonalanga sendlu yangasemva siza kuba ziimitha ezimashumi mabini anesibini ububanzi, zibekho izityalo, nezikhonkwane ezilishumi, neziseko ezilishumi.
Isiphelo esisemazantsi, esiya kutshona kwelanga, kufuneka ibe nemitha ezimashumi mabini anesibini ububanzi.
Kwicala elinye lomngxunya kufuneka kubekho iimilo ezimalunga neemitha ezisixhenxe ubude, ezinemiqadi emithathu neziseko ezintathu.
Kwelinye icala kufuneka kubekho iimilo ezimalunga neemitha ezisixhenxe ubude, ezinemiqadi emithathu neziseko ezintathu.

Ngendlela yokungena entlangoni, yenza isikhuselo esiyimitha ezisixhenxe ubude, esinamatye aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, amhlophe, amnyama, nelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba; ibe ngumsebenzi womzobi owenza uyilo oluhle; ibe nemiqadi yayo emibini, neziseko zayo zimbini.
Zonke izibambo zendlu yangasemva, ezijikelezayo, zibe neziqhoboshi zesilivere, nezikhonkwane zesilivere, neziseko zentsimbi.

Indlu yangasemva ibe yimitha ezimashumi mane anesihlanu ubude, nemitha ezimashumi mabini anesibini ububanzi; ibe neetafile zelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba zingaphezulu kweemitha ezimbini ubude, zibe neziseko zentsimbi.
Zonke izinto ezisetyenziswayo ekusebenzeni kwendlu engcwele, nazo zonke izikhonkwane zendlu yayo, nezikhonkwane zentlango, kufuneka zinikwe isiliva.
Yithi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuba bakulethe kuwe ioli ecocekileyo yeolibhini eqhutywayo, ibe ziifanitshala, ukuze ifanitshala ihlale ishushu.

Kwitentile yokuhlangana, ngaphandle komgca obekwe phambi kwebhokisi yomnqophiso, uAron nonyana bakhe baya kuzimisa izibane phambi koYehova otthotyekela koityekela kusasa. Lo ngumthetho wexesha elide kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, kusuku nasuku.
Yazisa wena uAron, umzalwana wakho, noNadabhi, noAbhihu, noElazare, noItamari, oonyana bakhe, abavela phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ukuba babe ngababingeleli kum.
Yenza uAron, umzalwana wakho, iimpahla ezingcwele, ukuba abe nobubele nobuhle.
Utsho kubo bonke abasondeleyo ekwenzeni izinto, endibaziselayo ubulumko, ukuba benze iimpahla zikaAron, ukuze amsindise, abe ngumbingeleli kum.

Lezo ke zizinto abazenzayo: isigqubuthelo sethutyana, ne-ephod, nebhanti, nesigqomo esithe tyaba, nomqolo, nomgca wokhuselo; bazenza ezo zinto zingcwele kuAron umzalwana wakho, kubo oonyana bakhe, ukuze babe ngababingeleli bam.
Baya kwenza igolide, nentsimbi engenasici, nentsimbi enqamlezeneyo, nentsimbi ethambileyo.
Baya kwenza i-ephod yegolide, nelinen eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nelinen engwevu, nelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba; iya kuba ngumsebenzi wobugcisa.
Kuya kubakho iziqhoboshi ezimbini zesifuba ezidityanisiweyo kwiikona zayo zombini, ukuze ikhonjwe ngazo.
Umgca wayo wokusika umele wenziwe ngomsebenzi ofanayo, ube yinxalenye yayo; ibe yintonga yegolide, nentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nentambo engwevu, nentambo ebomvu, nelinen ethe tyaba.
Zithabathe iithayile ezimbini ze-onyx, zigqume kuzo amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Yabhala amagama alishumi elinambini kwithambeka elinye, namagama alishumi elinambini elinye kwithambeka elinye, ngokwemimiselo yabo yokuzalwa.
Yazityhila kumatye amabini amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, njengokuba umenzi wegolide etyhila isitshixo; ubeke amatye amabini kwiingqungquthela zegolide.
Yazibeka iithayile ezibini phezu kweempawu zomqolo we-ephod, zibe ngamatye okukhumbula oonyana bakaSirayeli; uAron athabathe amagama abo emlonyeni wakhe phambi koYehova, abe ngumzekelo.
Yenza izityalo zegolide,
namakhonkco amabini egolide ecacileyo, aqhutywe njengentambo; ubeke amakhonkco la makhonkco kumaqhosha.
Yenza isithunywa somthetho, yenziwe ngumzobi oqeqeshiweyo; uyenze ifana ne-ephod, ibe yigolide, nesibhakabhaka, nesingwevu, nesingwevu esibomvu, nelinen esongiweyo.
Kufuneka ibe sisikwere, iphindwe kabini, malunga nesentimitha ezimashumi mabini anesithathu ubude kunye nesentimitha ezilishumi elinambini ububanzi.
Zibeke phezu kwayo imigca emine yamatye abalulekileyo; kumgca wokuqala ubeke i-ruby, ne-topaz, ne-beryl.
Kumgca wesibini ubeke i-turquoise, ne-sapphire, ne-emerald.
Kumgca wesithathu babeka i-hyacinth, ne-agate, ne-amethyst.
Kulowo mqolo wesixhenxe, i-chrysolite, ne-onyx, ne-jasper; zibekwe ezi zinto kwiingxowa zegolide.
Zibe ziithayile ezilishumi elinambini, ngamagama oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngamnye amagama akhe; iithayile nganye ibe negama lakhe, libhalwe njengesitshixo, ngokweemfazwe ezilishumi elinambini.
Uya kwenza iinkunzi zeenkomo zegolide ecocekileyo, ziqhutywe njengentambo.
Yenza iziqhoboshi ezimbini zegolide, uzibeke kwiikona zombini eziphezulu zesifuba.
Yazibophelela iinkunzi zeenkomo ezibini zegolide kwiziqhoboshi ezimbini ezikwikona zesifuba.
Ezinye iziphelo zezibonda uzibeke kwiziqhoboshi ezibini, uzixhobe ngazo iinwele zesifuba se-ephod ecaleni ngaphambili.
Uya kwenza iziqhoboshi ezimbini zegolide, uzibeke kwiikona ezibini zesifuba, ecaleni le-ephod ngasemva, ngaphakathi.
Uza kwenza iziqhoboshi ezimbini zegolide, uzibeke emazantsi emilenze ye-ephod, ngasemva kwayo, ecaleni kothungo lwayo, phezulu komgca walo.
Uza kuzibophelela iziqhobosheli zesifuba kwiziqhobosheli se-ephod ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ukuze isifuba sihlale phezulu komgca othambileyo, singaphaya kwe-ephod.
UAron athabathe amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli phezu kwentliziyo yakhe, emlonyeni womthetho, xa ephumayo kwindawo engcwele; ibe ngukumbuso kubo phambi koYehova mihla le.

Uyibeke i-Urim ne-Thummim emlonyeni, ukuze zibe phezu kwentliziyohotholo kaAron, xa ephumayo phambi koYehova; ke uAron athabathe phezu kwentliziyo yakhe mihla le izinto zokwenza izigqibo zabantwana bakaSirayeli phambi koYehova.
Yenza ibhanti le-ephod yonke ibe yimisonto eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
Kuya kubakho ukuvulwa kweentloko phakathi kwayo, kubekho umngxunya othungiweyo ejikeleze ukuvulwa kwayo, njengentonga, ukuze ingatshiyi.
Uya kwenza iziqhamo zegranate ezingwevu, nezibhakabhaka, nezibomvu, zijikeleze umngxunya womqamelo; zibe nezingqungquthela zegolide phakathi kwazo.
Icwecwe legolide, negranate, icwecwe legolide, negranate, ziya kuba zijikeleze umngxunya webhanti.
UAron uya kuyigqoka, xa esenza umsebenzi wakhe njengombingeleli; ukuze ilizwi leentyatyambo likwazi ukuvakala, xa ephumayo nokungenayo kwindawo engcwele phambi koYehova, ukuze angafa.
Yenza ibhodi yegolide ecocekileyo, uyiqhoboshele njengesitshixo, ithi: Ingcwele kuYehova.
Ncamathisela ngentambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka phambi kweturban.

Iya kuba ngasemva kobuso buka-Aron, ukuze u-Aron athabathe nasiphi na isigwebo sezinto ezingcwele, abazinikelayo oonyana bakaSirayeli; iya kuba ngasemva kobuso bakhe mihla le, ukuze isipho sabo sivunyelwe nguYehova.
Yenza ibhatyi yelinen ethambileyo, uyenze i-turban yelinen ethambileyo; umsesane wokuba ngumsebenzi womzobi owenza izimbo ezilungileyo.
Yenza oonyana baka-Aron izihlangu, nezigqubuthelo, nezikhonkwane, ukuze babe nomtsalane nobuhle.
Yazigqoka uAron, umzalwana wakho, naye oonyana bakhe; ubafake ioli, ubabeke egunyani, ubagcine bengcwele, ukuba babe ngababingeleli bam.
Uya kwenza kubo iimpahla ezingaphantsi zelinen, ukuze bazigubungele iziqu zabo, zifike ukusuka kumqolo ukuya kumqolo.

UAron nonyana bakhe baya kuzigqoka, xa bengena kwitentile yokuhlangana, okanye xa bedlula kwisibingelelo, ukuba basebenze kwindawo engcwele; ukuze bangabi nesono, babafa. Lo ngumthetho wexesha elide ka-Aron, nabantwana bakhe emva kwakhe.
Le nto uya kuyenza, ukuze ungcwelele uAron noonyana bakhe, ukuba babe ngababingeleli kum: uthathe inkunzi yenkomo encinci, nemvumbi ezimbini, zingabikho monakalo kuzo.
Ngesiqhamo sengqolowa esilula, esingatshizi, yenza isonka, iziqholo ezityebileyo ezixutywe neoli, neziqholo ezincinci ezixutywe neoli.
Yazibeka kwibhotile enye, uze uzingenise kuloo bhotile, nenyama yenkomo namadoda amakhulu amabini;
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Uya kumtsala uAron noonyana bakhe emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana, ubahlamba ngamanzi.
Zithabathe iimpahla, uzigqoke uAron ibhanti, nebhanti le-ephod, ne-ephod, nesakhelo sethutyana; umnqamleze ngemisonto ye-ephod ejikelezayo.
Uyibeke i-turban phezu kweentloko zakhe, uyibeke kwi-turban intonga engcwele.
Yaye uthathe ioli yokunqunyulwa, wamnqunyamisa, wayisa phezu kwentloko yakhe.
Nciphisa oonyana bakhe, bagqoke izihlangu.
Uyibambe ngemisonto uAron noonyana bakhe, uyibeke iimilo kubo; ububingeleli buza kuba ngumthetho wabo ophakamileyo; ngoko ke uya kumisa uAron noonyana bakhe.
Yathi ke uAron nabantwana bakhe babeke izandla zabo phezu kwentloko yaloo nkunzi yenkomo.
Uyifile inkunzi yenkomo phambi koYehova, emngxunyeni wetente yokuhlangana.
Uza kuthatha igazi lenkunzi yebhokhwe, uya kulibeka ngesandla sakho phezu kweempawu zesibingelelo; igazi eliseleyo liza kuqhutywa phantsi kwesibingelelo.
Yazithatha ke zonke iinwele ezijikeleze izitho zangaphakathi, nesiqu sebele, nezihlunu zombini, namafutha azo; uyasitshisa phezu kwesibingelelo.
Inyama yenkomo, nesikhumba sayo, nenkunkuma yayo, uya kuzitshisa ngaphandle komzi-ndlu; yidini lesono.
Uzithathele omnye umnquba; uAron nonyana bakhe babeke izandla zabo phezu kwenkophe yalo.
Uyifile, uze uthathe igazi layo, uyitshise phezu kwesibingelelo ngazo zonke iinkalo.
Umnqamlezo uthabathe iziqwenga, uyihlamba imithambo-luvo yayo nemilenze yayo; uzibeke phakathi kweziqwenga nangaphakathi.
Uyamcinezela unyana womntu onke phezu kwesibingelelo; ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, ngumphunga omnandi, umnikelo owenziwe ngomlilo kuYehova.
Tsala umnquba omnye; uAron nonyana bakhe babeke izandla zabo phezu kwenkophe yomnquba.

Uyifile, uthathe igazi layo, uwubeke phezu kweendlebe ezikunene zikaAhotheni, nangaphezulu kweendlebe zezandla zabo ekunene, nangaphantsi kweenyawo zabo ekunene; uthele igazi eliseleyo phezu kwesibingelelo esijikelezileyo.

Uzithabathe igazi elisesithendeni, neoli yokupheka, uzitshise phezu kukaAron, nezihlangu zakhe, namadodana akhe, nezihlangu zamadodana akhe; aze abe mngcwele yena, namadodana akhe, nezihlangu zamadodana akhe.

Uzithathe iinkunzi zeenkomo ezityebileyo, umlenze othambekileyo, nenyama ejikeleze imithambo-luvo, nomqolo weentliziyo, nezihlunu zombini namafutha azo, nentamo esekunene; le yimihlambi yokufaka izithsaba.
Kwisiquphe seentlanzi ezingaxutywanga, esingaphambili kukaYehova, uthathe ibhotolo enye yentlanzi, nebhotolo enye encinane eneoyile, nebhotolo enye encinci.
Zibeke zonke ezi zinto esandlani sikaAron, nasesandlani sabantwana bakhe; bazigqumle ngazo phambi koYehova, zibe ngumnikelo wokuqhutywa.
Yazithabatha ke ezi zinto ezandleni zabo, uzitshise phezu kwesibingelelo, phezu kwesonka esiqhutywa ngumlilo; ibe yivumba elimnandi kuYehova; lidini elifihliweyo kuYehova.
Uzithathe isibeleko semvu yokufaka isandla sika-Aron, uziphakamisele phambi koYehova, ibe ngumnikelo onyukayo; ibe yinxalenye yakho.
Iinxalenye zomnquma wokufaka izithsaba, eziye zakuba nguAron nonyana bakhe, uzigcine zibe zingcwele: isisu esiqhutywayo, nemilenze ephakanyisiweyo.
Kuye kube yinxalenye ka-Aron, nonyana bakhe, evela kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli; ibe ngumnikelo wabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli kuYehova, osuka kwizibingelelo zabo zoxolo.
Iimpahla ezingcwele zika-Aron ziya kuba ziye kubo abantwana bakhe emva kwakhe, ukuba batywinwe ngazo, babekwa kuzo.
Unyana wakhe oza kuba ngumbingeleli emva kwakhe, oza kungena kwitentile yokuhlangana, ukuba asebenze engcweleni, uya kuzigqoka iintsuku ezisibhozo.
Yithathe inkunzi yebhokhwe yokumisela, uyicoce inyama yayo kwindawo engcwele.
UAron nonyana bakhe baya kulila inyama yomnquma, nesonka esikwibhotile, ekungeneni kwetenki yokuhlangana.
Baya kuzidla ezo zinto, ezifakelwa ngazo iinyembezi zabo, xa bebekwa endlwini kaThixo, ukuba zingcwele; akukho namnye wangaphandle oza kuzidla, ngokuba zingcwele.
Ukuba kukho into eyonakalisekileyo yokutya kokunqunyulwa, nokuba yintoni na yesonka, ukuya emveni kwemini, iya kuqhutywa ngamanzi; asiyi kulinwa, ngokuba ingcwele.
Uyenze loo nto yonke kuAron noonyana bakhe, njengoko ndikumwiselayo; uthathe iintsuku ezisixhenxe ukuwamisa.
Umele ulungiselele inkunzi yenkomo imihla ngemihla, ibe lidini lesono, ukuba lilungise isono; ucocele isibingelelo, unikezele isonka sayo, uyityumze, ukuze ingcwele.
Imini ezisixhenxe uya kuyilungisa isibingelelo, uyenze ibe ngcwele; ibe sisibingelelo esingcwele kakhulu; nantoni na eyitshisa iya kuba ngcwele.
Le nto uya kuyinikela phezu kwesibingelelo, imihla ngemihla; ayizukubakho ngxaki: amaqanda amabini aneminyaka enye.
Yonke inkunzi yebhokhwe ilungiselele enye kusasa, nenye ekuseni.
Ngesibeleko sokuqala siya kunikela isiqingatha sekhilogremu yesonka esilungileyo, sixutywe nelitye elilodwa leoyile eyenziwe ngeolibhini, nelitye elilodwa lewayini njengesonka somnqulo.
Inyama yenkomo yesibini uyilungiselele kusasa, nesonka sayo esifana nosonka semini, nesonka sayo esifana nosonka sobusuku; ibe yivumba elimnandi, idini eliqhutywa limlilo kuYehova.
Lo mnqophiso wokungcwatywa uya kwenziwa mihla le phambi koYehova, ekungeneni kwetentile yokuhlangana, phakathi kwezizukulwana zakho zonke; ndiya kudibana nawe khona apho, ndithethe nawe.
Ndiya kuhlangana khona nabantwana bakaSirayeli, ibe yindawo engcwele ngenxa yobuqaqawuli bam.
Ndiya kuyingcwele itente yokuhlangana, nesihlalo somlilo; ndiya kubangcwele uAron nonyana bakhe, ukuba babe ngababingeleli kum.
Ndiya kuhlala phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, ndibe nguThixo wabo.
Bayazi ukuba mna ndinguYehova uThixo wabo, endibakhuphe ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ndihlale phakathi kwabo; mna nguYehova uThixo wabo.
Yenza isibingelelo semithi ye-acacia, ukuze usindise umnquba.
Yabe imilenze emashumi mane anesihlanu ubude bayo, nemilenze emashumi mane anesihlanu ububanzi bayo; ibe yimilenze emashumi asibhozo ubude bayo. Iinkomo zayo zibe ngasinye.
Yazigubungela iphezulu yayo, namacala ayo onke, nezingqungquthela zayo, ngegolide ecacileyo; uyenze umngxunya wegolide phezu kwayo yonke.
Yenza iziqingatha zegolide ezibini, phantsi komngxunya wayo, emacaleni ayo onke amabini, zibe ziindawo zokubeka iintonga zokuyithabatha.
Yenza iintonga zemithi ye-acacia, uzixhobe ngegolide.
Uyibeke isibingelelo phambi kwetafile ethe tyaba, ibekwe phambi komnyango wesiqithi somnqophiso, phambi kwesigqubuthelo sebhodi yomnqophiso; ndiya kudibana nawe khona.
UAron uya kutshisa phezu kwesibingelelo ivumba elimnandi lefuthe, ubusuku bonke, xa emisa izibane.
Ke kaloku, xa emisa iinkunzi zeenkomo kusasa, kufuneka aphinde amcinezele uvumba; ke ngoko uvumba luza kumnquma phambi koYehova rhoqo phakathi kweentlanga.
Musani ukunikela phezu kwalo ifuthe linye, nakuphi na umnikelo womlilo, nakuphi na umnikelo wesonka; musani nokutywina idini lokusela phezu kwayo.

Ke kaloku uAron uya kuyilungisa isibingelelo sayo ngomnyaka mnye, afake emanzini esonka sedini lesono, elimisa isono, phezu kweempawu zaso; kuya kwenziwa oko ngomnyaka mnye, phakathi kosuku nosuku; yingcwele kakhulu kuYehova.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Xa nibala oonyana bakaSirayeli, umntu ngamnye uya kunika iNkosi intlawulo yobomi bakhe, xa nibala; ngoko akuyi kubakho monakalo phakathi kwabo, xa nibala.
Wonke umntu obalaseleyo kufuneka anikezele ishumi leshekeli, ngobunzima bendawo engcwele; ishumi leshekeli likhulu elinamashumi mabini eegera. Ishumi leshekeli liya kuba ngumnikelo wokudla kuYehova.
Wonke umntu obalakeleyo, oneminyaka emashumi mabini ubudala nangaphezulu, uya kunika umnikelo kuYehova.
Xa ninika umnikelo wokudla kuYehova, ukuhlawula ubomi benu, lowo umthandi akayi kunikela ngaphezulu kwephesenti yeshekeli; lo mhlwempu akayi kunikela ngaphantsi.
Yithathele oonyana bakaSirayeli lemali, uyisebenzise ekwenzeni umsebenzi wetente yokuhlangana; ibe ngukumbuso kuYehova kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, ibe yintlawulo yempilo yenu.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yenza ibhotile yentsimbi, nesiseko sayo sentsimbi; uyibeke phakathi kwetenki yokuhlangana nesihlalo somlilo, uthele amanzi kuyo.
UAron nonyana bakhe baya kuhlamba izandla zabo nezinyawo zabo ngamanzi alo.
Xa bengena endlwini yokuhlangana, baya kuhlamba ngamanzi, ukuze bangafa; ke kaloku xa befika kwisibingelelo, ukuba basebenzele iNkosi ngomnikelo womlilo, baya kuhlamba ngamanzi.
Bazihlamba izandla zabo nezinyawo zabo, ukuze bangafanga; ibe ngumthetho ophakamileyo ka-Aron, nosapho lwakhe, phakathi kosuku nosuku lwabo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Zithathe izithako ezilungileyo, imitha elishumi elinanye yemirha ecocekileyo, nesiqingatha sayo, nemitha elishumi elinanye yesinamoni ecocekileyo, nemitha elishumi elinanye yenkomo ecocekileyo,
ne-cassia engaphezu kweekhilogram ezisibhozo, ngobunzima bayo bonke ngokwesisindo sendawo engcwele; ne-oyile yeolivini engaphezu kweekhilogram ezisibhozo.
Yenza ngazo ioli engcwele yokuncamathela, ivumba elimnandi elinxulunyaniswayo, umsebenzi wokwenza iziqhamo; ibe yioli engcwele yokuncamathela.
Uyisebenzisele ukubhaka itentile yokuhlangana, nebhokisi yomnqophiso,
netafile neempahla zayo zonke, nesikhuseli selanga neempahla zayo, isibingelelo somlilo wefuthe;
isibingelelo sesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, nezithuthi zayo zonke, nombhobho wokuhlambela nesiseko sakhe.
Yazilungiselela ukuba zingcwele, ukuze zibe zingcwele kakhulu; nantoni na eyibophayo iya kuba ngcwele.
Unciphise uAron noonyana bakhe, ubangcwelele, ukuba babe ngababingeleli bam.
Uthi ke kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Le nto imele ibe yioyile yam engcwele yokunqunyulwa kusuku nosuku;
Musa ukuwutshisa phezu kwamadoda aqhelekileyo, nokuba uyenze nantoni na enye ioli ngale ndlela; iyingcwele, niyigcine ibe yingcwele.
Nabani na owenza ioli ngale nto, okanye oyithambisa kulowo angabi ngumbingeleli, lo mntu uya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Uthathe iziqhamo ezimnandi, i-gum resin, ne-onycha, ne-galbanum, kunye nefuthe elicacileyo, ngamanani afanayo.
Yenza ukuba ibe yintyatyambo, imixholo yevumba elimnandi, yenziwe ngumenzi weentyatyambo; ubeke kuyo isonka, ukuze icocwe ibe yingcwele.
Uza kuyitshisa ibe ngumgubo, uyibeke phambi kweebhodi zomnqophiso etentweni yokuhlangana, apho ndiza kudibana khona nawe; iya kuba lingcwele kakhulu kuwe.
Musani ukwenza kuni nantoni na ifuthe ngale nkqubo; uyigcine ibe yinto engcwele, ibe lidini likaYehova.
Nabani na owenza utywala olufana nalo, ukuze afumane umphunga walo, lo mntu uya kususwa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,
Yabona, ndimkhethe uBesaleyeli, unyana kaUri, unyana kaHure, wesizwe sikaYuda.
Ndimzele ngomphefumlo kaThixo; ndimnike ubulumko, nokuqonda, nolwazi, nokukwazi ukwenza zonke iintlobo zemisebenzi.
Uyakwazi ukwenza imifanekiso emihle, nokusebenza ngegolide, nesilivere, nentsimbi.
Ukwaziyo ukusika, nokufaka iithayile ezibalulekileyo, nokusika imithi, nokwenza zonke iintlobo zemisebenzi eyaziwayo.

Ndimkhethe ke uAholiyabi, unyana ka-Ahisamaki, wesizwe sikaDan, ukuba abe ngumncedisi wakhe; nakwabo bonke abanolwazi lokwenza izinto ndabanika ubuchule bokwenza zonke izinto endikuziwisela umthetho ngazo:
itentile yokuhlangana, itempu yomnqophiso, nomgquba wayo, nazo zonke izinto ezisetyenziswa kwitentile;
netafile, neempahla zayo, nesibane segolide elingenasici, neempahla zayo zonke, isibingelelo somlilo womlilo;
isibingelelo sesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, nezithuthi zayo zonke, ibhotile yokuhlambela nesiseko sayo;
izihlangu ezithe tyaba, nezihlangu ezingcwele zikaAron umbingeleli, nezihlangu zabantwana bakhe, xa besenza umsebenzi wabo wobubingeleli;
neoli yokupheka, nefuthe elinomphunga elimnandi lendawo engcwele; bayenze ngokwento endikumwiselayo.
Wathetha iNkosi kuMoses, wathi,

Utsho wena kubantwana bakaSirayeli, usithi, Nizigcine iintsuku zam zokuphumla; ibe nguphawu phakathi kwam nenu, ezinyaweni zemihla ngemihla, ukuze nikwazi ukuba mna ndinguYehova owenza ukuba ningcwele.
Gcina iSabbathi; ngokuba yingcwele kuni. Wonke umntu oyenza ukuba ibe mnyama, kufuneka aphele; onke umntu owenza nayiphi na imisebenzi ngaloo mini, kufuneka aphelelwe phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Kwiintsuku ezintandathu kunokwenziwa umsebenzi; kodwa ngomhla wesixhenxe yiSabhati yokuphumla, ingcwele kuYehova. Wonke umntu owenza nayiphi na imisebenzi ngemini yeSabhati kufuneka afile.
Bagcine ke oonyana bakaSirayeli isiSabbathi, bayenze ibe ngumnqophiso ohlala ixesha elide phakathi kweentsapho zazo.
Umele ube ngumqondiso phakathi kwam nabantwana bakaSirayeli ngonaphakade; ngokuba ngeentsuku ezintandathu iNkosi wazenza izulu nehlabathi, ngomhla wesixhenxe waphumla, waphumla.
Ke kaloku, xa iNkosi egqibile ukuthetha noMoses entlango kaSinayi, wamnika iitoti ezimbini zomnqophiso, iitoti zamatye ezibhalwe ngomnwe kaThixo.

Ke kaloku, xa abantu bebona ukuba uMoses uthatha ixesha elide ukuwa phantsi komnxweme, bahlangana kuAron, besithi, Yiya, wenzeni amadini ethu ahambe phambi kwethu; kuba lo Musa lowo, owasikhuphe eYiputa, asiyazi into eya kwenzeka kuye.
Waphendula ke uAron wathi kubo, Nciphisaneni izikhonkwane zegolide ezikwizandla zamadodana enu, nabantwana benu, neentombi zenu, nizithatheni kum.
Ke kaloku bonke abantu bakhupha izikhonkwane zabo zegolide, bazisa kuAron.
Wazithabatha, waza wazenza ngesixhobo, zibe yinkunzi yebhokhwe. Bathi ke, Lowo nguThixo wakho, uSirayeli, owakukhupha ezweni laseYiputa.
Wakubona ke uAron loo nto, walungisa isibingelelo phambi kwenyama yenkomo, wathi, Namhlanje kuya kubakho iholide kaYehova.
Ke kaloku, ngemini elandelayo, abantu bavuka kuqala, banikela izibingelelo eziqhutywa ngamanzi, nezibingelelo zoxolo; emva koko baphumla bedla besela, bavuka ke bedlala.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya phantsi; kuba abantu bakho, abawenzileyo ukuba baphume eYiputa, baba nesono.

Basuka ngokukhawuleza kuloo nto ndibawiseleyo; bayenze kubo inkunzi yebhokhwe, imifanekiso eqingqiweyo, bayihlangula, bayinikela ngayo izibingelelo, besithi, Lowo nguThixo wakho, uSirayeli, owawukhuphe eYiputa.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ndibabona aba bantu, bona, babantu bemilenze emide;
Ke ngoko, shiya mna, ukuze inkanuko yam iqhume kubo, ndibasindise; ndiya kukwenza wena ube lilizwe elikhulu.
UMoses ke wamcela iNkosi uThixo wakhe, wathi, Nkosi, kutheni na ukuba inkanuko yakho iqhume phezu kwabantu bakho, abawenzileyo ukuphuma eYiputa ngomandla amakhulu nesandla esinamandla?

Kutheni na ukuba bathethe abaYiputa, besithi, Wabakhupha ukuze abonise ububi kubo, wababulala phakathi kwamatye, wabacima phezu kobuso behlabathi? Uyamkele umsindo wakho oqaqambileyo, utshintshe intliziyo yakho, ungabangele loo monakalo kubantu bakho.

Khumbula ooAbraham, noIsake, noSirayeli, abakhonzi bakho, owabathethayo, wabatyhila ngegama lakho, wathi, Ndi Ukupongeza iziqhamo zenu zibe zininzi njengeenkwenkwezi emlilweni; nalo lonke ilizwe endilibambele lona ndiya kulinika iziqhamo zenu, ibe yintsapho yabo ngonaphakade.
Ke kaloku, iNkosi watshintsha ingqondo yakhe, akayi kuzisa kubo abantu bakhe loo monakalo awayethetha ngawo.
Wajika ke uMoses, wenyuka phantsi komnxweme, eneebhodi ezimbini zomnqophiso esandla sakhe; zazibhalwe ngaphaya naphaya, ngaphambili nasemva.
Iibhodi zazilumsebenzi kaThixo; ukubhala kwakulo kubhala kukaThixo, kutywinwe kwiibhodi.
Ke kaloku uYoshuwa wayeva ilizwi laba bantu bekhala, wathi kuMoses, Ilizwi lemfazwe likhona emkhosini.
Waphendula uMoses wathi, Ayingomsindo wokuvakala kwamadoda ngenxa yokuba baphumelele; ayingomsindo wokuvakala kwamadoda ngenxa yokuba balahlekile; kodwa ndiwuva umsindo wokuzivocavoca.
Wafika ke uMoses esixekweni, wabona inkunzi yebhokhwe nokuzingela; waza uMowabhi wenyuka ngoxolo, wathabatha iitoti ezisuka ezandla zakhe, wazibhaka-bhaka phantsi komthi.
Wathabatha inkunzi yebhokhwe abayenzayo, wayitshisa emlilweni; wayithambisa ibe yimpuphu, wayisasaza emanzini, wawasela oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Wathi uMoses kuAron, Bakwenza ntoni na kuwe la maqela abantu, ukuze ubakhokelele kwisono esikhulu kakhulu?
Waphendula ke uAron, wathi, Mna nkosi yam, musa ukuxoka; wena uyazi ukuba aba bantu bagqibile ukwenza okubi.
Bathi kum, Yenza kuthi amadini ahamba phambi kwethu; kuba lo Musa, owenza ukuba sikhuphe eYiputa, asiyazi into eya kwenzeka kuye.
Ndathi ke kubo, Wonke lowo unegolide, ayisekele. Bandinika igolide; ndayibeka emlilweni, yaphuma le ntaka.
Ke kaloku uMoses wabona ukuba abantu baphazamiseka; ngokuba uAron wabaphazamiseka, ukuze babe yinkcazo yabachasi babo.
Wahlala uMoses emngxunyeni womkhosi, wathi, Wonke umntu osuka eNkosini, afike kum. Bahlangana bonke abaLevi kuye;

Wathi kubo, Itsho loo nto iNkosi, uThixo kaSirayeli, esithi, Mhothisani umntu ngamnye ikrele lakhe emlonyeni wakhe; balekani nisuka entliziyweni yethutyana, mnakele umntu ngamnye umzalwana wakhe, nomhlobo wakhe, nokumkani wakhe.
Bathi amaLevi akwenze njalo, njengoko uMoses wamwiselayo; bafa ngaloo mini abantu abangamawaka amathathu.
Wathi ke uMoses, Namhlanje nizilungiselele izandla zenu kuYehova; ngenxa yokuba mna nonyana wam, namna mkhuluwa wam; ngoko ke mna namhlanje ndininika ubulungisa.
Ke kaloku, ngomhla olandelayo, uMoses wathi kubo, Niyenzile isono esibi kakhulu; ke ngoku ndiya kukhupha kuYehova; mhlawumbi ndiza kumlungisa ngenxa yesono sam.
Wabuyela ke uMoses kuYehova, wathi, Yaye, le ndoda yenze isono esibi kakhulu; yazilungisa izithixo zegolide.
Ke ngoko ke, nceda usindise isono sabo; kodwa ukuba awuyixoli, licime igama lam kwincwadi obhalelayo.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Wonke umntu owenza isono kum, ndiya kulisusa igama lakhe encwadini yam.
Yiya ke ngoku, uthabathe abantu kude ndithi kuwe: Iingelosi zam ziya kuhamba phambi kwakho. Ke kaloku, xa lifika ixesha lam lokubaphulaphula, ndiya kubaphulaphula isono sabo.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wathumela isidumbu kubantu, ngenxa yento abayenzayo ngenyama yenkomo kaAron.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Yiya apha, wena nabantu abawenzileyo phezulu eYiputa, uye kwilizwe endilibazile lona uAbraham, noIsake, noYakobi, ndisithi, Ndiza kulinika iziqhamo zakho.
Ndiya kuthumela isithunywa phambi kwakho, ndizikhuphe iziKanani, neziAmori, neziHeti, neziPerizi, neziHivi, neziYebhusi.
Yiya phezulu, nifike ezweni eliphumayo ubisi nenkukhu; kuba mna andiyi kungena phakathi kwenu, ngokuba nibantu bemilenze emide, ukuze ndinilahle enyanisweni.
Ke kaloku, xa abantu beva la magama abuhlungu, bakhathazeka kakhulu; akukho namnye wabeka izipho zakhe.

Ke kaloku iNkosi wathi kuMoses, Uthi kubo oonyana bakaSirayeli, Ngubani na lo mntu oqinileyo? Ukuba ndiya kuhamba nani, nokuba nje ngemizuzu embalwa, ndiya kukulahla. Ngokunikhuphe izityalo zenu, ndikubone ukuba ndingakwenza ntoni kuwe.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, besuka emnqamlezweni weHorebhi nangaphezulu, bakhupha izityalo zabo.

Ke kaloku uMoses wayethabatha itente, wayimisa ngaphandle komkhosi, kude kakhulu; wayazi ngokuba yitentyatyambo yomboniso. Wonke umntu ofuna ukubuza iNkosi, waphuma endlwini yomboniso, ngaphandle komkhosi.
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses ephuma waya kwitentile, abantu bonke bavuka, behlala emngxunyeni wetente nganye yazo, bejonge uMoses, de afike etentweni.
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses efika kwitentile, umthwalo wefuthe wawuhla, wahlala emngxunyeni; ke iNkosi wayethetha noMoses.
Ke kaloku, xa bonke abantu bebona umnqamlezo wefuthe umile ekungeneni kwetentile, ke bona bonke bamisa, bathandaza, ngamnye ekungeneni kwetente yakhe.

UYehova wayethetha noMoses ngobuso kubuso, njengokuba umntu ethetha nomhlobo wakhe; ke kaloku uMoses wabuyela emkhosini. Ke kaloku uYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, umkhonzi wakhe omncinane, akawushiyanga umbindi wetente.
Wathi uMoses kuYehova, Uthi kum, Yiyalayishe le ndoda; kodwa ungandixelela ukuba ngubani na oza kumthumela nam. Wathi ke, Ndiyazi igama lakho, uye wafumana inceba phambi kwam.
Ke ngoko, ukuba ndifumene inceba phambi kwakho, nceda ufundise iindlela zakho, ukuze ndiziqonde, ndifumane inceba phambi kwakho; uqaphele ke ukuba olu hlanga lubantu bakho.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuye, Ndiya kuhamba ndihamba nawe, ndiza kukunika isihlwele.
Wathi ke uMoses kuye, Ukuba wena ngokwakho awusayi kuhamba nathi, musa ukuthutha sisuka apha.
Kuza kwaziwa njani ukuba uyakundithanda mna nosapho lwakho, ukuba usiya nathi? Ngoko ke ndiya kuhlukana nam nosapho lwakho phakathi kwazo zonke iintlanga ezikwihlabathi liphela.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Ndiya kwenza loo nto uyisithiyo; ngokuba wafumana inceba phambi kwam, ndiyazi igama lakho.
Wathi ke uMoses, Nceda ndibonise ubutyebi bakho.

Wathi iNkosi, Ndiya kwenza ukuba ubulungisa bam bonke budlule phambi kwakho; ndiza kulibiza igama lam, iNkosi, phambi kwakho; ndiya kuba nesonka kulowo ndimthandayo, ndiya kuba nobubele kulowo ndimthandayo.
Ke wena awukwazi ukubona ubuso bam; kuba akukho mntu unokundibona, aphile.
Wathi ke iNkosi, Kukho indawo ecaleni kwam, apho ungahlala khona phezu kwelitye.
Xa ubutyebi bam budlula, ndiya kukubeka emngxunyeni welitye, ndikugubungele ngesandla sam, de ndidlule.
Ke mna ndiya kususa isandla sam, ubone umva wam; kodwa ubuso bam abubonakali.
Wathi iNkosi kuMoses, Khusela wena iitoti ezimbini zamatye ezifana nezo zangaphambili; ndiza kuzibhalela phezu kwazo amazwi aye kwiitoti zokuqala, oziphuculeyo.
Umele ulungiselele kusasa; uye kumnxweme waseSinayi, uhlale phambi kwam apho, phezu komphezulu womnqamlezo.
Akukho namnye oza kunyuka nawe, akabonakali naphi na kuloo mlambo; nokuba ziinkomo okanye iinkunzi zebhokhwe, azidingi ukutya phambi komlambo.

Ke kaloku uMoses watshisa iibhodi ezimbini zamatye, ezinjengezo zakuqala. Wavuka ke uMoses emveni kwemini, wenyuka phezu komnxweme waseSinayi, njengoko iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo, ethatha iibhedi ezimbini zamatye ezandla zakhe.
Wahla ke iNkosi emlilweni, wahlala khona naye, wabiza igama lakhe ngokuthi, UYehova.
Wadlula ke iNkosi phambi kukaMoses, wathi, UYehova, iNkosi, nguThixo othandekayo, onobubele, othambileyo ekukhanyeni, ogcwele inyaniso nothando.

ogcina ubulungisa bakhe kumawaka, exolisa inkohlakalo, nokuphazamisa,hotya, nesono; akayi kushiya nabani na ongenakunyaniseka, ephulaphule isono sabazali kubo oonyana babo, nabantwana babantwana babo, kuhlobo oluthathu nolwesine.
Ke kaloku uMoses wakhawuleza, waya phantsi ehlabathini, wakhonza.
Wathi, Nkosi, ukuba ndifumene inceba phambi kwakho, nceda uhambe nathi; nakuba abantu aba banzima indlebe, usixolele ububi bethu nesono sethu, usenze sibe ngabantu bakho.

Wathi iNkosi, Yabona, ndiza kwenza umnqophiso nawe; ndiya kuzenza phambi kwabantu bakho bonke izimangaliso, ezingazange z Ukup ahlangane naphi na ilizwe ehlabathini lonke. Boba bantu bonke abakumgama wakho baya kubona umsebenzi kaYehova; kuba zizinto ezimangalisayo ezo ndiza kuzisenza kuwe.
Zigcine izinto endikuwiselayo namhlanje; bona, ndiya kuzikhupha phambi kwakho iinkomo zaseAmori, neziKanani, neziHeti, neziPerizi, neziHivi, neziYebhusi.
Khumbulani, musa ukwenza umnqophiso nabahlali belizwe oza kungena kulo, ukuze bangabi yinto yobuxoki phakathi kwakho.
Ke kaloku, zihlambulukeni izibingelelo zabo, nizitshise iithayile zazo ezingcwele, nizithabathe iintyatyambo zazo zeAshere.
Musa ukuthandaza kuThixo omnye; ngokuba iNkosi, igama lakhe linguMhlophe, nguThixo oMhlophe.
Musa ukwenza umnqophiso nabahlali baloo lizwe; kuba xa behamba emva kweentliziyo zabo, banikela izibingelelo kubo, baya kukubiza wena, nawe uya kuzidla izibingelelo zabo.
Musani na ukuthabatha iintombi zabo zibe ngabafazi oonyana benu; ukuze abo bazalwana bahambe belandela amadini abo, njengamabhinqa ahamba ngesondo, babakhokelele oonyana bakho ukuba benze njalo.
Musani ukwenza imifanekiso engumqondiso yentsimbi eshushu.

Yenza isikhumbuzo seentlanzi ezingaxutywanga; iintsuku ezisixhenxe usele iintlanzi ezingaxutywanga, njengokuba ndikumwisela umthetho ngawo, ngexesha elimiselweyo lenyanga kaAbib; ngokuba ngaloo inyanga waphuma eYiputa.
Yonke into ephuma emntwini, ibhinqa elizalwa kuqala, iya kuba yam; nazo zonke izinto eziphuma emntwini, ibhinqa elizalwa kuqala, phakathi kweenkomo zakho nezimvu.

Uyithengise kwakhona inkunzi yebhokhwe, uyinike unyana webhokhwe endaweni yayo; ukuba awuyithengi kwakhona, usike umqolo wayo. Uyithengise kwakhona bonke oonyana bakho abazalwa kuqala, ukuze akukho namnye oza kumbona engenasandla.
Nisebenze iintsuku ezintandathu, niphumle ngomhla wesixhenxe; nakwixesha lokulima nokuvuna niphumle.
Yenza iholide yeentsuku ezisixhenxe, ngezinto zokuqala zokuvuna iziqhamo zengqolowa, neholide yokuqokelela, ekupheleni konyaka.
Iintsuku ezithathu ngonyaka, bonke amadoda akho aya kuvela phambi koYehova uThixo wakho, uThixo kaSirayeli.
Ndiya kuzikhupha iintlanga phambi kwakho, ndiyindise ilizwe lakho; akukho namnye oza kuzama ukuthatha ilizwe lakho, xa unyuka uvele phambi koYehova uThixo wakho amaxesha amathathu ngonyaka.
Musani ukunikela igazi lomnqophiso wam kunye nantoni na eyenziwe ngomxube wesonka; akukho nto yesonka somthendeleko wePasika eya kugcinwa kude kube kusasa.
Izinto ezilungileyo zeziqhamo zokuqala zelizwe lakho uza kuzizisa endlwini kaYehova uThixo wakho; awuyi kupheka inkunzi yeegusha emlilweni womntwana wayo.
Wathi ke iNkosi kuMoses, Bhala wena la mazwi; kuba ngamazwi la magama ndenze umnqophiso nawe, namaSirayeli.
Wahlala khona uMoses noYehova iintsuku ezimashumi mane, nemini emashumi mane, engadla nasonka, angasela namanzi; wabhala phezu kwezitye amazwi omnqophiso, imiyalelo emihlanu.
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses ehla emnqamlezweni waseSinayi, iitoti ezimbini zomnqophiso zisesandlani sakhe; uMoses akazange akwazi ukuba ubuso bakhe bukhanya, ngenxa yokuba wayethetha naye.
Ke kaloku, uAron nabazalwana bonke bakaSirayeli bakubona uMoses, bona, ubuso bakhe buqaqamba; baboyika ukuba bamfihle.
Ke kaloku uMoses wababiza; wabuya ke kuye uAron namadoda amakhulu onke ebandla, wathi kubo.
Ke kaloku, emva koko, bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli bafikelela kuye; wabawisela yonke imimiselo kaYehova awayemwiselayo emnqamlezweni waseSina.
Ke kaloku, xa uMoses egqibile ukuthetha nabo, wabeka isigqubuthelo phezu kobuso bakhe.
Ke kaloku, xa ephuma uMoses ukuba athethe naye iNkosi, wayewukhupha umgquba, de waphuma; ke kaloku, ephumayo, wabaxelela oonyana bakaSirayeli izinto awagunyaziwe ngazo.
bakubona ukuba ubuso bakhe bukhanya; ke uMoses wabeka kwakhona isigqubuthelo phezu kobuso bakhe, de afike ethetha naye.
UMoses wathabatha ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli, wathi kubo, Ezi zizinto iNkosi awawisela umthetho ngazo ukuba nizenza.
Kuba iintsuku ezintandathu kunokwenziwa umsebenzi; kodwa umhla wesixhenxe ungcwele kuni, yiSabhati yokuphumla kaThixo. Wonke umntu owenza ntoni na imisebenzi ngaloo mini, kufuneka aphele.
Musani ukutshisa umlilo nakweyiphi na indlu yenu ngemini yeSabbath.
Wathetha ke uMoses kwintlanganiso yonke yamaSirayeli, esithi, Yiyo loo nto iNkosi wamwisela umthetho ngayo.
Kuzo zonke izinto ezikhoyo kuni, nizinike umnikelo kuYehova; wonke umntu onqwenela ukuninika umnikelo kuYehova, athabathe igolide, nesilivere, nentsimbi;
intambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, neyombala ongwevu nomthubi; impahla emfutshane yelinen; inwele yenkomo;
iinwele zebhokhwe ezibomvu; isikhumba esihle; imithi ye-acacia;
ioli yeolivini, esetyenziswa kwizibane; iziqhamo, ezisetyenziselwa ioli yokupheka, nefuthe elimnandi;
namatye e-onyx, nezinye izinto eziluncedo, ukuze zifakwe kwi-ephod nakwisakhelo.
Wonke umntu ozimeleyo phakathi kwenu uya kungena, ayenze yonke into iNkosi abewisela umthetho ngayo:
itentile engcwele, netentile yayo, nesikhuseli sayo, nezikhonkwane zaso, neetafile zayo, nezikhonkwane ezithe nkqo, nezitulo zazo;
itekisi, nemibhobho yayo, nesikhuseli sayo, nesitayile esiyifihlayo;
netafile, nemibhobho yayo, nezithuthi zayo zonke, nesonka esilungiselelweyo;
isiseko selanga sokukhanya, neempahla zayo, nezibane zayo, neoli yokukhanya;
isibingelelo sefuthe, nezikhonkwane zaso, neoli yokupheka, nefuthe elinomphunga omnandi, nesikhuseli somngxunya wesingeniso setentile engcwele;
isibingelelo sesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, negridi yayo yentsimbi, neentonga zayo, nezithuthi zayo zonke; ibhotile yokuhlambela nesiseko sayo;
iithayile zendlu yangasemva, nezingcango zazo, neziseko zazo, nomgquba wokungena endlwini yangasemva;
izikhonkwane zeentyatyambo zesibingelelo, nezikhonkwane zentlango;
nezigqoko ezithe tyaba, zokukhonza endlwini engcwele; izigqoko ezingcwele zikaAron umbingeleli, nezigqoko zabantwana bakhe, ukuba basebenze njengeempawu zo priester.
Ke kaloku ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli lisuka kuMoses.

Ke kaloku bonke abo intliziyo yabo yabakhuthazayo, nabo umphefumlo wabo wabavumelayo, bafika benika umnikelo kuYehova wokwenza umsebenzi wetentാസ yokuhlangana, nomsebenzi wayo onke, nempahla engcwele.

Ke kaloku bonke abo banqwenela, amadoda nabasetyhini, bafika benikela ngezinto zegolide, ngazo zonke iintlobo; izikhonkwane, nezihlangu, neziseko, neengxowa-mali. Wonke umntu wanikela igolide yakhe njengomnikelo oqhutywa ngomlilo kuYehova.
Wonke lowo ubenoboya obubomvu, noboya obumnyama, noboya obungwevu, nelinen ethambileyo, nenwele yeentyatyambo, nesikhumba sebhokhwe esibomvu, nesikhumba esingwevu, bazisa.
Wonke umntu okwaziyo ukunika isilivere, nobhedu, wazisa njengomnikelo kaYehova. Wonke umntu onemithi ye-acacia yokwenza nantoni na eyenziwayo, wazisa.
Ke kaloku wonke umfazi owaziyo, wajika intambo ngezandla zakhe, waza wazisa into awayeyenzayo, intambo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nengwevu, nengwevu emnyama, nelinen emhlophe.
Ke kaloku bonke amadoda, abo banqwenela, abakwaziyo ukuzoba, bajika iinwele zeentyatyambo.
Bathi ke abathetheli bathabathe iithayile ze-onyx, nezinye izinto ezityebileyo, ukuba zifakwe kwi-ephod nakwisakhelo.
Bathi ke nabo, bathabathe iziqhamo, neoli yeolivini, ukuba ibe ngukukhanya, nokuba ibe yioli yokupheka, nokuba ibe yifuthe elimnandi.
Bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, amadoda nabasetyhini, abo banqwenela ukunikela ngesandla sabo umnikelo kaYehova, bazisa isipho esithandekayo, sazo zonke izinto awiselayo iNkosi ngoMoses.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, Yabona, iNkosi ukhethe uBezeleli, unyana kaUri, unyana kaHuri, wesizwe sikaYuda.
Wamgcwalisa ngomphefumlo kaThixo, ngobulumko, nokuqonda, nolwazi, nokukwazi ukwenza zonke iintlobo zemisebenzi.
Uyakwazi ukwenza imifanekiso emihle, nokusebenza ngegolide, nesilivere, nobhedu;
ukusika iithayile, nokuzibeka kuzo, nokwenza umzobo wemithi, nokwenza zonke iintlobo zemisebenzi yobugcisa.
Ke kaloku iNkosi wamnika yena noOholiyabi, unyana ka-Ahisamaki, wesizwe sikaDan, ingqondo yokufundisa.

Wabagcwalisa ngolwazi, ukuba benze yonke imisebenzi yokusika, nokwenza imifanekiso eqingqiweyo, nokwenza imizobo emihle, ngeentambo ezibomvu, nezingwevu, nezingwevu, nelinen ethambileyo, nokwenza uboya; ukuze bakwazi ukwenza zonke iintlobo zemisebenzi, nokwenza imifanekiso emihle.

Ke kaloku, uBesaleyeli noAholiyabi, nalowo nalowo owaziyo into, owabeka kuye iNkosi ubulumko nokuqonda, ukuba akwazi ukwenza yonke imisebenzi yokwakha indawo engcwele, bayenze loo msebenzi, njengoko iNkosi abewisela umthetho.
Wabiza ke uMoses uBesaleyeli, noAholiyabi, nabantu bonke abanobunjineli, abo iNkosi wabeka kubo ubulumko, bonke abathunyelwe yintliziyo yabo ukuba bafike bayenze loo msebenzi.
Bazifumana kuMoses zonke izipho, abazenzayo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ukuze kwenziwe umsebenzi wokwakha indawo engcwele; abantu ke baqhubeka bezisa umnikelo wabo kusasa.
Ke kaloku bonke abasebenza kakuhle, abasenza umsebenzi wendawo engcwele, bamisa umsebenzi wabo;
bathi kuMoses, Abantu bazisa okuninzi kakhulu, ngaphezu komsebenzi iNkosi awawisela umthetho wona ukuba siwuyenze.
Ke kaloku uMoses wamisa, kwathiwa emkhosini wonke, Akukho mntu, nokuba ngumfazi na, oza kwenza nantoni na, ibe yindawo engcwele. Baye ke abantu bagwetywa ukuba bangabikho benikela.
Kuba oko babenakho kwakukho ngaphezu kokuthe tyaba, ukuba bakwenze umsebenzi wonke.

Bonke oomatshini abaqeqeshiweyo phakathi kwabo bayenza itentyatyambo engcwele, ibe ziimiqadi ezilishumi zelinen ethe tyaba, nelinen eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nelinen eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, nelinen emthubi, zibe nezikherubi ezizigqobhoza ngazo, yenziwe ngumenzi oqeqeshiweyo.
Zonke iziteyibhile zazinomlinganiselo owodwa, ubude babo bumalunga nemitha ezilishumi elinambini, ububanzi babo bumalunga nemitha ezimbini.
Wazidibanisa iithayile ezilishumi elinambini nganye nenye, wazenza njalo nakwiitafile ezilishumi elinambini.
Wazenza iziqhoboshi eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka kumngxunya wesitayile esiphelweni sothungelwano olunye, waza wakwenza njalo kumngxunya wesitayile esiphelweni sothungelwano lwesibini.
Wazenza iziqhoboshi ezimashumi mahlanu kumthi omnye, neziqhoboshi ezilishumi elinambini ekugqibeleni komthi wesibini odityanisiweyo; iziqhoboshi zazijongene nganye nenye.
Zazenza iziqhoboshi zegolide ezilishumi elinambini, zazidibanisa ngazo iindonga ezimbini ezidityanisiweyo nganye nenye; ibe le tabernakele ingcwele.
Wazenza iziteyibhile zolusu lweenkomo, ukuba zibe yitente phezu kwetenki engcwele; zonke eziteyibhile zazilishumi elinanye.
Zonke iintyatyambo ezilishumi elinanye zazinomlinganiselo owodwa, ubude babo buyimitha emashumi mathathu anesibhozo neshumi elinesithoba; ububanzi bazo bemitha emibini.
Zazidibanisa iziteyibhile ezintlanu nganye ngenye, neziteyibhile ezintandathu nganye ngenye.
Zazenza iziqhoboshi ezimashumi mahlanu kumngca wokuphela kwethayile, kuhlangatyezwana lokuqala; zazenza iziqhoboshi ezilishumi elinambini kumngca wokuphela kwethayile, kuhlangatyezwana lwesibini.
Wazenza iziqhoboshi zentsimbi ezimashumi mahlanu, ukudibanisa itente nganye nenye, ibe yintloko enye.
Yayenza ifenitshala yetentile, eyenziwe ngeenwele zebhokhwe ezibomvu; yayenza phezu kwayo ifenitshala yesikhumba esintle.
Wazenza iithayile ezithe nkqo zokhuni lwesikayithi, ukuze zibe yindawo engcwele.
Umgca ngamnye waba malunga neemitha ezine ezilishumi elinambini ubude nobubanzi besentimitha ezingamashumi asixhenxe
Intonga nganye ibenezikhonkco ezimbini, ukuze zidityaniswe ngazo. Ngale ndlela wazenza zonke iintambo zetentile engcwele.
Wazenza iithayile ezimashumi mabini kwicala lasempumalanga lendawo engcwele.
Wazenza iziseko zesilivere ezimashumi mane phantsi kweebhodi ezilishumi elinambini; iziseko ezimbini ngaphantsi kwebhodi nganye, isiseko ngasinye phantsi komthi.
Ngecala elinye, elikwicala lasempuma lendawo engcwele, wazenza iibhodi ezimashumi mabini;
neziseko zesilivere ezimashumi mane, zibini phantsi komthi ngamnye.
Wazenza iithayile ezintandathu ngaphambili kwetenki engcwele, ngasemva kwayo, kwicala lasekhohlo.
Wayenza iithayile ezibini, zibe ziikona zendawo engcwele ngasemva.
Kuzo zonke ezi ndawo zintathu, iithayile zazibini, zisuka ezantsi ziye phezulu, zidityanisiwe ngeringi enye. Izinto zazo zonke ezo ndawo zintathu zazinjalo.
Kwaba ziibhodi ezisibhozo, neziseko zesilivere ezilishumi elinamithandathu, iziseko ezimbini phantsi kwebhodi nganye.
Wazenza iziqhoboshi zokhuni lwesitayile se-acacia, ezilishumi elinambini zezinto ezibekwe ngaphaya kwetenki engcwele;
ezilishumi elinambini zezinto zodonga ecaleni elinye, nezilishumi elinambini zezinto zodonga ecaleni lasentshonalanga.
Wayenza intambo enkulu ephakathi, ibe isuka kwisiphelo esisodwa iye kwisiphelo esinye, ifike emazantsi eebhodi.
Wazigubungela iithayile ngegolide, wazenza iziqhoboshi zegolide, ukuze zibekwe kuzo izikhonkwane; wazigubungela izikhonkwane ngegolide.
Wayenza intyatyambo yesitayile segolide, nesingwevu, nesibomvu, nelinen ethambileyo ethe tyaba; wazenza kuyo iikerubi, eziqotywe ngumzobi owaziyo.
Yayenza imiqadi emine yemithi ye-acacia, yazigubungela ngegolide; wazenza izikhonkwane zayo zegolide, waza wayitywina isiseko sazo sesilivere esine.
Yakwenza, ekungeneni kwetentile, isikhuselo esingwevu, nesibomvu, nesingwevu, nelinen ethambileyo esongiweyo, yomsebenzi womzobi owenza izimbo.
Wayenza imiqadi emihlanu, neengcango zayo, ukuze ifane nesitayile; wazigquma ngegolide iziqhoboshi zemiqadi, nezibophelelo zazo; waza wenza iziseko zazo ezilishumi elinambini zentsimbi.
UBesaleyeli wayenza inqanawa ngentsimbi yesitayile se-acacia; ubude bayo buyimitha enye, ububanzi bayo buyimitha emashumi asixhenxe, ubude bayo buyimitha elishumi.
Wayigubungela ngegolide ecacileyo, yangaphakathi nangaphandle; wayenza umngxunya wegolide phezu kwayo yonke.
Wayenza iziqingatha ezine zegolide, waza wazisa ezizingcengeni zayo ezine: iziqingatha ezimbini ngasecaleni elinye, neziqingatha ezimbini ngasecaleni elinye.
Wazenza iintonga zemithi ye-acacia, wazigubungela ngegolide.
Wazibeka iinkunzi zeenkomo kwiiringi ezisecaleni zesithuthi, ukuze ziyithabatha.
Wayenza isakhelo, indawo yokuxolela, yegolide ecocekileyo; ubude bayo buyimitha enye, ububanzi bayo buyimitha ezisixhenxe.
Wazenza iikerubi ezimbini, zegolide ethe tyaba, ukuba zibe ziinqanawa ezibini ezincinane zomngxunya.
ikekerubi enye kwisiphelo esinye, nekekerubi enye kwisiphelo esisekunene; wazenza zonke ezi kerubhi nezikhuselo zibe sinye.
Iikerebhu zazisa iinwele zawo phezulu, zigubungela isikhuselo ngeempawu zazo; zijongena nganye nenye, zijonge phantsi kwisikhuselo.
Wayenza itafile yokhuni lwe-akati; ubude bayo buyimitha ezimashumi asixhenxe, ububanzi bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini, ubude bayo buyimitha ezisibhozo.
Wayigubungela ngegolide ecacileyo, wayenza umgca wegolide phezu kwayo.
Wayenza imingxunya ejikeleze kuyo, ububanzi bayo bufana nesandla; wamenza umgca wegolide kumngxunya.
Wayenza iziqingatha ezine zegolide, waza wazisa ezi ziqwengane ezintandathu, apho zibekwe khona iintloko zayo ezine.
Iiringi zazifutshane nomngxunya, ukuze zibekwe kuzo iintonga zokuthwala itafile.
Wazenza iintonga zentsimbi yesitayile se-acacia, wazigquma ngegolide, ukuze zithwale itephu.
Wazenza izinto zetafile zegolide ecocekileyo, izitya zazo, neziqulatho zazo, neziqulatho zazo, neziqulatho zokufaka isonka.
Wayenza intonga yelanga ibe yigolide ecocekileyo; wayenza ngentsimbi engenasici, isiseko sayo nesiqhamo sayo; iziqulatho zaso, neentyatyambo zazo, neziqhamo zazo, zonke zaba ngasinye.
Iziqhamo ezisithandathu zaphuma emacaleni alo, iziqhamo ezintathu ngaphaya kwelinye icala, neziqhamo ezintathu ngaphaya kwelinye icala.
Kwabakho iziqholo ezintathu, ezifana neentyatyambo ze-almond, ngazo zonke iziqhamo ezintandathu, ngazo zonke iziqhamo ezintandathu, ngazo zonke iziqhamo ezintandathu.
Ke kaloku, kwisibambo samandlalo kwakukho iziqhoboshi ezine ezifana neentyatyambo ze-almond, neziqhamo zazo neziqhamo.

Kwakukho isiqhamo phantsi kwesibini seentyatyambo, kwakukho isiqhamo phantsi kwesibini seentyatyambo, kwakukho siqhamo phantsi kwesibini seentyatyambo; zonke iziqhamo ezisibhozo zaphuma kwisibambo sokukhanya.
Iziqhamo zazo, neentyatyambo zazo, zonke zaba nganye inxalenye yaloo mkhenkcethi, zigqityiwe ngegolide ecacileyo.
Wazenza izibane zayo ezisixhenxe, neziqhamo zazo, namatye ayo, ngegolide ecocekileyo.
Wasebenzisa ikhilogram ezilishumi elinambini zegolide ecacileyo, ukuba ayenze intonga yelanga, nezixhobo zayo zonke.

Wayenza isibingelelo sefuthe, eyenziwe ngomthi we-acacia; ibe yimilinganiselo emihlanu ubude bayo, nemilinganiselo emihlanu ububanzi bayo, ibe yimilinganiselo emihlanu ubude bayo. Iindlebe zayo zaba ngazo.
Wayigubungela ngegolide ecocekileyo, iphezulu yayo, neziqithi zayo zonke, nezikhonkwane zayo; wayenza umgca wegolide phezu kwayo.
Wayenza imisonto emibini yegolide phantsi komngxunya, emacaleni amabini ajongeneyo, ibe ziindawo zokubeka izibambo zokuyithwala.
Wazenza iintonga zentsimbi yesitayile se-acacia, wazigquma ngegolide.
Wayenza ioli engcwele yokupheka, nefuthe elicocekileyo elinomphunga omnandi, njengomsebenzi wokwenza uvumba.

Wayenza isibingelelo sesonka esiqhutywa ngamanzi, eyenziwe ngomthi we-acacia; ibe yindibaniselwano, ubude bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini, ububanzi bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinambini, ubude bayo buyimitha ezilishumi elinanye.
Wayenza iinkunzi zeenkomo, ngazo zonke iikona zayo ezintandathu; zathi iinkunzi zeenkomo nesihlalo somlilo ziyinto enye; wayigubungela isihlalo somlilo ngobhedu.
Wazenza zonke izinto ezisetyenziswa kwisibingelelo, zibe zentsimbi; izitya zayo, neziqulatho zazo, neziqulatho zokutya, neziqulatho zomnqumo.
Wayenza imingxunya yesibingelelo, intsontelo yentsimbi; wayibeka phantsi komngxunya wesibingelelo, ibe ifike kwisiqingatha sayo.
Wathisa iziqingatha zentsimbi ezine, zibe ziindawo ezintandathu zomgca wentsimbi engenasici, ukuze zibekwe kuzo iintonga.
Wazenza iinkunzi zeenkomo zibe ngumthi we-acacia, wazigquma ngentsimbi.
